Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei fosters ties despite official freeze - Focus Taiwan
Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei fosters ties despite official freeze
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Visitors browse stalls at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar at Huashan 1914 Creative Park in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 8 (CNA) A Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei this weekend brought immigrants and Taiwanese visitors together, highlighting ongoing ties between people from Hong Kong and Taiwan amid dwindling official contacts.
The fourth annual event, held Saturday and Sunday at Huashan 1914 Creative Park by the government-funded Taiwan-Hong Kong Economic and Cultural Co-operation Council (THEC), featured 70 stalls selling Hong Kong-style food and creative products.
Jojo Man, a Hongkonger who moved to Taiwan four years ago and now works as a florist, said she returned for a third year to reconnect with fellow immigrants.
Hong Kong immigrant Jojo Man poses with handmade flowers and packaged soup ingredients at her stall at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
"For us, making money comes second," said Man, who sold flowers and Hong Kong-style soups.
She said Taiwanese customers' curiosity about unfamiliar soup ingredients also created opportunities for sharing different cultures.
"I find such exchanges quite interesting," said Man, who encouraged Hong Kong immigrants to understand local customs and find a balance rather than constantly complain about differences.
Ian Yip, a Hong Kong-born software engineer in his 40s who has lived in Taiwan for over two decades, said Taiwanese have become more accepting of Hongkongers.
Ian Yip shares his experiences as a Hongkonger who has lived in Taiwan for more than two decades at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
He recalled that during his early years in Taiwan, some customers at a golf course where he worked part-time told him not to approach because they "didn't like Hongkongers." Some Taiwanese saw Hongkongers as impatient and overly concerned with money, he said.
Yip said such stereotypes had gradually faded over the years, and he hoped events like the bazaar could help Taiwanese better understand Hongkongers through direct interaction.
Official exchanges between Hong Kong and Taiwan have dwindled in recent years, particularly following mass pro-democracy protests in 2019 and Beijing's imposition of a national security law in 2020.
Hong Kong suspended operations at its representative office in Taipei in 2021, while Taiwan's office in Hong Kong continues to operate with locally hired staff after Taiwanese officials left over a visa dispute involving Beijing's "one China" principle that began in 2018.
Against this backdrop, Yip emphasized the importance of people-to-people ties and encouraged Hongkongers to bring Taiwanese friends to the bazaar rather than only take part themselves.
"That's how exchanges can really happen," he said.
Taiwanese visitor Bill Tai, 33, who has visited Hong Kong five times this year, said he was drawn to the bazaar by its food offerings and his interest in Hong Kong culture, particularly Cantonese, which he is learning.
Taiwanese visitor Bill Tai shows off his backpack featuring Taiwan and Hong Kong-themed decorations at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
Tai said political changes in Hong Kong had made it difficult for residents to "speak freely," and welcomed Hongkongers seeking to build new lives in Taiwan, which he described as a relatively freer society.
THEC Secretary-General Lu Chang-shui (盧長水) said the bazaar aimed to encourage people to "respect one another's differences" and help immigrants put down roots in Taiwan.
More than 13,000 Hong Kong and Macao immigrants have obtained Taiwanese citizenship since 2019, said Lu, who also heads the Mainland Affairs Council's Department of Hong Kong, Macao, Inner Mongolia and Tibet Affairs.
According to Lu, the event recorded nearly 67,000 visits Saturday, compared with nearly 90,000 across last year's two-day event.
THEC Secretary-General Lu Chang-shui gives two thumbs-up at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026

content:
Fundraiser by Boston Standswithhk : US Hong Kong Safe Harbor Postcard Campaign
Boston Standswithhk is organizing this fundraiser.
***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***
While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.
11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。
In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):
鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):
The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)
《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)
The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)
《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)
In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. We desperately call for your contribution again to help us deliver these postcards to Congress, to remind them of Hong Kong’s urgent situation and urge them to take immediate action. Your contribution would support our printing and delivery costs. Thank you so much!
在上一次推動《香港人權與民主法》的明信片運動中，我們向國會送出了超過3000張的明信片。我們不是任何正式組織的成員，也沒有運營資金，所以我們竭誠呼籲您為我們提供資金，並幫助我們將這些明信片送交您們所屬的國會議員，提醒他們香港的緊急狀況，並呼籲他們立即採取行動。所有受到的捐款將支持我們的打印和交付成本。萬分感謝！

content:
Fundraiser by Heather Liu : Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case
Heather Liu is organizing this fundraiser.
What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.
（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）
With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.
（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）
In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.
（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）
Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.
（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。）
Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States.
（多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。）
Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.
（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）
After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.
（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。）
Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.
（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）
He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.
（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。）
The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.
（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）
We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.
（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）
The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. What is at risk is Charlotte's right to a quality education, along with the legally binding acknowledgement of his paternity.
（儘管我們掌握活生生的證據，但如果籌不到聘請律師的費用，單憑我們自訴，將無法應對複雜的陪審團庭審程序。立案至今一年多來，被告採取躲和拖的戰術，先是躲傳票，然後提出「司法管轄權」爭議逼我們撤案，一計不成又援引「多國籍」條款，將案子從特區高等法院轉移到聯邦法院。）
With your assistance – with your contributions – we intend to hire an attorney who is experienced in sexual assault and paternity cases. We hope to win this #MeToo case and pursue respectful, equal and democratic human relationship in Chinese community.
（您的捐助將幫助我們聘請到專攻性侵案和親子案官司的律師，幫我們贏得這場事關尊嚴、平等、人權以及人性的人身傷害官司，並藉此推動美國的華人社區乃至全球華人的觀念進步與行為的現代化。）
Here are some online stories and commentary about this, in Chinese:
https://www.storm.mg/article/2891777?mode=whole
(by Liao Yiwu, award winner of Human Rights Watch Hellman-Hammett Grant 2003, the German Geschwister-Scholl-Preis 2011 and the Peace Prize of the German Book Trade 2012.)

content:
欧洲军队将在波兰为战后部署乌克兰进行训练 - 防务新闻
欧洲军队将在波兰接受战后乌克兰部署训练

2025 年 9 月 17 日，波兰士兵在波兰奥日什举行的演习中发射“Piorun”便携式防空导弹。（Wojtek Radwanski/法新社，盖蒂图片社）
乌克兰基辅——欧洲官员本周宣布，数千名欧洲军队将于下周聚集在波兰，参加自愿联盟的首次大型军事演习，这是在与俄罗斯的战争结束后向乌克兰部署多国部队的预演。
特使史蒂夫·威特科夫周一表示，此次演习正值美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰谈判代表定于 11 月 10 日至 11 日在阿布扎比举行会议。这次会议为乌克兰和平谈判动荡的一年画上句号。自二月份美国和以色列开始袭击伊朗后，谈判陷入僵局，直到九月份维特科夫和特使贾里德·库什纳在莫斯科会见了普京，然后才以谈判代表身份前往基辅进行首次访问时，谈判才得以恢复。
英国和法国将于 11 月 9 日至 22 日联合领导 KOALICJA 26.2，汇集来自 11 个国家的 2,800 名士兵，在联军的军事力量乌克兰多国部队 (MNF-U) 的领导下，在波兰、法国和土耳其开展协调活动。美国军队不会参加。
英国国防部声明称，演习将联合空中、陆地和海上力量，“测试如何调动、保护和补给一支部队，以便在战斗结束后帮助重建乌克兰武装部队”。
比利时、爱沙尼亚、法国、德国、立陶宛、荷兰、西班牙、瑞典、土耳其和英国也参与其中。
法国外交部的声明称，此次训练将为部队的最终任务做好准备，其中可能包括保护关键基础设施、训练乌克兰军队、帮助保护天空和清除黑海的地雷，这是乌克兰更广泛的安全保障计划的一部分。
英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷在国防部新闻稿中表示：“这次演习表明，英国正在加紧与法国和我们的盟友一起，为乌克兰和平到来的那一天做好准备。这不是一个假设的计划；它是一支真正的力量，准备在战斗停止后帮助乌克兰。”
据报道，多国部队将不承担维持和平或停火监督任务，也不接受北约指挥。只有在停火后并应基辅的要求，它才会进入乌克兰。
前法国驻乌克兰大使盖尔·韦西埃尔 (Gaël Veyssière) 在四月份对《军事时报》表示，停火监测“将是一项与多国部队不同的任务，多国部队的目标本质上是不同的，因为它的目的是支持乌克兰军队的能力得到加强”。
据英国发布的消息称，演习还将测试“部队的指挥和控制安排”，并评估“不同组成部分如何作为一支多国部队进行整合和有效运作”。
英国正在派遣 300 名人员，包括来自被称为“沙漠老鼠”的英国陆军第七轻型机械化旅的士兵，来演练后勤行动。华沙将在战后管理多国部队的调动，但不会派遣其部队

European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment

Polish soldiers fire a “Piorun” MANPAD during exercises in Orzysz, Poland, Sept. 17, 2025. (Wojtek Radwanski/AFP via Getty Images)
KYIV, Ukraine — Thousands of European troops will gather in Poland next week for the Coalition of the Willing’s first major military exercise, a rehearsal for deploying a multinational force to Ukraine once the war with Russia comes to an end, European officials announced this week.
The exercise comes as U.S., Russian and Ukrainian negotiators are set to meet in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10 and 11, special envoy Steve Witkoff said Monday. The meeting caps a tumultuous year for Ukraine’s peace talks, which stalled after the U.S. and Israel began striking Iran in February and revived only in September, when Witkoff and fellow envoy Jared Kushner met Putin in Moscow before traveling to Kyiv for their first visit as negotiators.
Britain and France will jointly lead KOALICJA 26.2 from Nov. 9 to 22, bringing together 2,800 troops from 11 nations for coordinated activities in Poland, France and Turkey under the coalition’s military arm, the Multinational Force-Ukraine (MNF-U). American troops will not participate.
The drills will combine air, land and sea forces to “test how to move, protect and supply a force that would help rebuild Ukraine’s Armed Forces once the fighting ends,” according to a British Ministry of Defence statement.
Belgium, Estonia, France, Germany, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, Turkey and Britain are also taking part.
The training will prepare troops for the force’s eventual missions, which could include securing critical infrastructure, training Ukraine’s military, helping protect the skies and clearing mines from the Black Sea, as part of a broader package of security guarantees for Ukraine, according to the French ministry’s statement.
“This exercise shows the UK is stepping up, alongside France and our allies, to prepare for the day peace comes to Ukraine. This isn’t a hypothetical plan; it’s a real force, ready to help Ukraine once the fighting stops,” British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said in the ministry’s release.
The MNF-U will reportedly not have a peacekeeping or ceasefire-monitoring mandate or operate under NATO command. It would move into Ukraine only after a ceasefire and at Kyiv’s request.
Ceasefire monitoring “would be a different task from that of the multinational force, whose aim is different in nature because it is meant to support the Ukrainian army in its ability to be beefed up,” former French Ambassador to Ukraine Gaël Veyssière told Military Times in April.
The drills will also test “command-and-control arrangements for the force” and assess “how different components can integrate and operate effectively as one multinational force,” according to the British release.
Britain is sending 300 personnel, including soldiers from the British Army’s 7th Light Mechanised Brigade, known as the “Desert Rats,” to rehearse logistical movements. Warsaw will manage the movement of MNF-U troops after the war but will not send its own soldiers into Ukraine. Nearly 2,000 Polish soldiers will take part in addition to the foreign forces, the Polish ministry said.
France is sending “hundreds” of troops, including a unit equipped with about 50 “contact drones,” the second of its kind after one deployed to Romania, Army Chief of Staff Gen. Jacques de Montgros’s told lawmakers last month.
Turkey will not send troops to Poland, the French ministry said, but will stand up the MNF-U’s maritime element in Istanbul, “testing arrangements for maritime mine clearance to allow commercial shipping to safely return to Ukraine’s ports,” according to the British release.
“This exercise will show that the Multinational Force-Ukraine is a real, capable, readily deployable force that represents a serious commitment from Coalition of the Willing nations to Ukraine’s long-term stability and security,” said the commander of MNF-U, British Lt. Gen. Tom Bateman.
The exercise announcements do not specify the final size of a force that could deploy to Ukraine, but Britain and France said earlier this year that they were prepared to contribute roughly 5,000 troops each.
Even a minimal “tripwire” presence would require 10,000 to 25,000 troops, the Center for Strategic and International Studies assessed last year. Because only a third of any force is frontline-ready at a given time, rotations push that number far higher, Ed Arnold, a senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute and a former British military officer, told Military Times.
Russian President Vladimir Putin has rejected allowing a foreign troop presence in Ukraine, and he warned in September 2025 that Western forces deployed there would be legitimate targets.
Although the MNF-U is not a peacekeeping force, Polish defense officials said its presence is meant to ease Ukrainian fears of a renewed Russian attack once the war ends.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pressed allies on Wednesday to move quickly, pointing out that Russian forces continue to batter Ukraine’s power grid and other critical infrastructure as the country braces for its fifth winter of full-scale war.
“Peace has no alternative, and postwar security guarantees must be truly cast-iron,” he said.
Katie Livingstone is the Ukraine correspondent for Defense News and Military Times. Based in Kyiv, she has covered Russia’s full-scale invasion since its first days. She is a former Fulbright fellow whose award-winning work has appeared in outlets across Europe and the U.S.

content:
美國中期選舉：共和黨失去兩院，對華政策與對台軍售會轉向嗎？ - BBC News 中文
圖像加註文字，學者向BBC中文分析，會談最重要的成就在於展示兩國關係「正面友好的氛圍和形象」。
美國中期選舉結果出爐，民主黨在參眾兩院同時翻盤，共和黨總統特朗普（Donald Trump，又譯川普）的第二任期後半段將在「跛腳」狀態下展開。這場選舉不只改變華盛頓的權力版圖，也可能牽動美中關係與台灣議題的走向。
時機尤其敏感。11月18至19日，亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人峰會將在深圳舉行；12月中，特朗普與習近平還可能在邁阿密G20峰會再度會面。價值140億美元的對台軍售案正卡在特朗普手中，他今年5月曾公開稱這筆軍售是「很好的談判籌碼」。民主黨掌控國會後，出口管制、晶片限制與軍售節奏會否出現新的拉鋸，成為觀察焦點。
多位專家向BBC中文分析，美國兩黨在對華問題上的共識深厚，總統仍是政策主導者，大方向不會因國會易主而改變；真正的變化在於監督力度，民主黨將透過聽證會、傳票、《國防授權法》與撥款法案，嚴格審視特朗普與北京達成的貿易休戰。
與此同時，多位長期支持台灣的共和黨「台灣連線」議員落馬，也意味著台北必須重新經營與新生代民主黨議員的關係。
「特習會」後兩架美國 F-16V 抵台 「雖遲但到」的時機與信號2026年10月5日
詳解美國破紀錄對台軍售：價值111億美元的非對稱式防禦藍圖2025年12月19日
美國智庫太平洋論壇（Pacific Forum）兼任研究員藍若思（Elizabeth Larus）向BBC中文表示，無論國會由哪個黨派掌握多數，美國對台灣的支持及對華政策都不會改變，兩黨都會試圖推動特朗普批准桌上那筆140億美元的對台軍售案。
「自1979年以來，每一任美國總統都維持了《台灣關係法》、『六項保證』以及美國的『一個中國』政策，這些都不會因為民主黨掌控國會而改變。」她說。
美國智庫德國馬歇爾基金會（German Marshall Fund, GMF）亞洲計畫主任葛來儀（Bonnie Glaser）預測，民主黨將掌控撥款程序與參議院議程，很可能在《國防授權法》（NDAA）與撥款法案中加入多項要求：加速交付已核准的對台武器、新的對外軍售（FMS）案件通報、對台使用外國軍事融資（FMF），以及台灣安全合作倡議（Taiwan Security Cooperation Initiative）資金。《六項保證法案》（Six Assurances Act）也可能獲得更多推進動能。
葛來儀還指出，民主黨大勝後，美國可能加強對中國取得先進晶片的限制，《安全晶片法案》（Safe Chips Act）有機會通過。但特朗普擁有否決權，民主黨票數不足以推翻，除非部分共和黨議員倒戈支持。
新加坡南洋理工大學公共政策與全球事務副教授駱明輝（Dylan Loh）對BBC中文表示：「美國對中國存在廣泛共識，整體關係的塑造仍主要由總統主導。」
新加坡獨立分析師鄧銘杰也不認為民主黨大勝會帶來更溫和的對華政策。兩大黨在出口管制、晶片限制與供應鏈措施上立場一致，實際變化在於監督力度：民主黨將透過聽證會與傳票，嚴格審視貿易休戰和「建設性戰略穩定」框架。
此文包含Google YouTube提供的内容。由於這些内容會使用曲奇或小甜餅等科技，我們在加載任何内容前會尋求您的認可。 您可能在給予許可前希望閲讀Google YouTube曲奇政策和隱私政策。希望閲讀上述内容，請點擊“接受並繼續”。
中國近年對特朗普的戰略，核心是「以經貿換穩定、以個人關係控風險」。第一任期時，北京透過貿易談判與大規模採購美國農產品，換取特朗普在台海議題上的相對克制。
專家認為，第二任期北京更進一步，把對台軍售直接納入美中高層談判，並以貿易休戰、稀土與供應鏈議題作為槓桿，試圖讓特朗普把台灣問題「交易化」。
習近平多次強調台灣是「最重要議題」，並在此前的峰會上要求美方明確反對台灣獨立，同時暗示穩定關係取決於限制對台支持。北京判斷特朗普重視交易成果多於長期承諾，因此採取「耐心施壓、避免正面衝突」的策略，等待他任期內的窗口，同時為「後特朗普」時期預做準備。
至於中期選舉本身，駱明輝認為，北京自然會關注結果，但不會過度在意誰勝誰負：無論牌局如何發展，中南海都會積極規劃，並把戰略目光放在特朗普任期結束之後。
圖像加註文字，台灣向美國訂購的 66 架 F-16V 戰機中，首批 2 架在10月2日抵台。這是台灣自1990 年代以來首次採購新戰機，也是這筆延宕多年的軍售案首度有實機落地。
特朗普任內的對台軍售呈現「先放後卡」的節奏。第一任期他多次批准軍售，規模與頻率高於前任，涵蓋戰機、坦克與飛彈系統，並強化高層軍事交流；2025年12月，他更批准約111億美元的大規模軍售案，創下紀錄。
轉折出現在2026年初。涉及愛國者飛彈、雷達與指揮系統、用於台灣「T-Dome」防空體系的140億美元新案被長期擱置，特朗普在與習近平會談後持續延遲。
美國前外交官、捍衛民主基金會（Foundation for Defense of Democracies, FDD）中國項目主任辛格頓（Craig Singleton）本週在
警告，延遲對台軍售正在製造「危險的誤解」，「今天為避免摩擦而擱置，可能為明天更危險的對抗創造條件」。他認為，數十年來美中靠精心拿捏的語言和戰略模糊處理台灣問題，但如今習近平可能將延遲軍售解讀為華盛頓默認「穩定美中關係取決於限制對台支持」的前提。軍售拖得越久，北京越可能把未來任何推進視為背叛，反而引發特朗普試圖避免的不穩定。
除了軍售，美台在情報分享、聯合演訓、不對稱戰力與無人機上的合作仍在持續，但節奏受白宮與北京談判牽制。
第一個觀察點，鄧銘杰向BBC中文透露，有美國官員早前表示，此案被「拆包」成較小規模方案的機率已大幅上升；布魯金斯學會的何瑞恩（Ryan Hass）也預期，APEC與G20之後會出現較小規模的軍售案。
年底的《國防授權法》是第二個觀察點。參議院版本加入了對台戰爭儲備庫存，並將台灣納入涵蓋菲律賓的更廣泛「第一島鏈」倡議。鄧銘杰認為，這些條款能否在最終版本中保留，值得關注。
第三則是政治修辭。特朗普今年5月曾說他「不希望有人走向獨立」，若類似表述出現在深圳或邁阿密峰會的書面聲明中，將是真正的轉變。
此次選舉中，多位「台灣連線」的共和黨議員遭淘汰。這些友台議員長期推動對台軍售、加強軍事合作並監督行政部門，每年都有成員拜訪台灣；取而代之的，是許多首次進入眾議院的年輕民主黨人，他們對台灣乃至中國事務是否熟悉，都是問號。
台美關係研究社群「美國台灣觀測站」分析指出，勝選的新生代議員多數對國際議題鮮少著墨，或強調外交優先、減少軍事干預，民主黨內年輕「進步派」是否會走更多元的外交路線，值得觀察。
藍若思則提醒另一層矛盾：特朗普呼籲增加支出以重建美國海軍，應對中國海軍的擴張；但民主黨更關注「奶油」而非「槍砲」，民主黨主導的國會將優先擴大醫療補助與氣候政策等福利支出，進而壓縮國防預算，使軍事科技投資更難推動。
「美國台灣觀測站」也分析，從歷史經驗看，歷屆總統任期最後幾年常把重心轉向海外事務，白宮自今年4月起已開始盤點移民、關稅、住房等不需國會的行動，特朗普更自稱「否決先生」（Mr. Veto）。外交仍主要由行政權主導，因此即便特朗普「跛腳」，對台美關係影響有限。
台灣國防安全研究院助理研究員鍾志東早前在台北一場會議上提出類似判斷：當前的中美關係可用「短多長空」理解。他強調，台美關係必須放在中美關係的整體結構中看待，1979年美國即便需要聯合北京抗衡蘇聯，也未接受停止對台軍售的要求；在中美戰略競爭持續升溫的今天，美國在此議題上讓步的空間反而更低。即使短期內不會宣布大手筆軍售，也不代表美國正在台灣議題上向中國妥協。
中期選舉改變的是華盛頓由誰來提問，但關於台灣的最終答案，仍掌握在特朗普手中。鄧銘杰向BBC中文強調，台灣最大的風險在於優先順序的落差：北京幾乎把台灣置於一切之上，而特朗普同時在處理貿易、稀土與其他議題。
接下來，台北必須同時與新國會和白宮打交道。在島內「疑美論」不斷發酵的背景下，不同政黨對美國的期待本就分歧，華盛頓的權力重組，只會讓台北的說服工作更加複雜。

content:
资料照片：澳门民主派前立法会议员区锦新。(2024年10月7日)
澳门初级法院星期五(11月6日)就首宗《维护国家安全法》案件判刑，民主派原立法会议员区锦新被控“颠覆国家政权”等罪名成立，判刑12年半。人权活动人士质疑澳门当局的重判，把民主派人士最后发声的机会都剥夺了，“以后澳门除了博彩业、赌场，还剩下什么？”
现年69岁的区锦新预计将服刑到2039年，出狱时已年届82岁。
区锦新曾任教师，并从2001年至2021年担任澳门立法会议员。当时是议会内极少数民主派议员之一。他卸任议员后，仍经常撰文评论澳门当局的施政。他也是少数愿意公开接受外国传媒采访的当地政界人士。
身在日本的香港人权活动人士潘嘉伟对美国之音表示，根据法院的文件，区锦新显然是因为长期接受外媒采访而遭重判。
潘嘉伟说：“区锦新是澳门最有分量、最有影响力的其中一个政界人士，也是澳门民主的代表人物。在澳门，没有人像区锦新那样勇于公开发言，在困难的环境下接受媒体采访。”
潘嘉伟表示，区锦新已年近70，12年后出狱时已是年迈的老翁。他原是公民社会一个重要的角色，当局却采取高压、恐怖手段，把一个前议员最后发声的机会都剥夺了。“以后澳门除了博彩业、赌场这些，还剩下什么？”他说。
区锦新去年7月底被捕，案件今年9月起闭门审讯，法院以避免损害国家安全为由禁止公众旁听。法院的判决摘要称，由多名法官组成的合议庭认定，尽管区锦新为初犯，而且承认相当部分的犯罪实施，但其故意程度极高，不法性程度及可能造成的后果十分严重。
法院裁定区锦新一项“颠覆国家政权罪”、两项“与澳门以外的组织、团体或个人建立联系作出危害国家安全的行为罪”、一项“违反保密罪”罪成，判囚12年半。
判决摘要称，区锦新长期“亲身协助和配合境外敌对组织，收集和散布颠覆国家政权的政治主张”，“勾连境外敌对组织，共谋煽动澳门居民对中央人民政府的仇恨”，相关颠覆行为在《国安法》于2023年修订生效后仍然持续。
法院也认定，区锦新在2023至2024年期间与多个境外组织勾连，散布虚假消息，以图致使外国作出针对中国及澳门特区的敌对行动，破坏澳门第六任行政长官选举进行。
1989年六四天安门事件后，区锦新参与筹组“澳门民主发展联委会”(简称“民联会”)，往后30年定期举办“六四”烛光晚会及相关声援活动。
2021年，澳门警方首次禁止举办“六四”烛光晚会。 2023年澳门修订《国安法》，“民联会”随即解散。
英国港侨协会董事、前澳门社运人士周庭希曾协助区锦新竞选议员。他接受美国之音专访时表示，重判区锦新与他过往举办“六四”纪念活动有关。
周庭希说：“2019年澳门举办了最后一次公开合法的‘六四’烛光晚会，其后当局逐步把‘六四’集会裁定为违法。还记得很久以前，区锦新除了筹办烛光晚会，每年到了‘六四’之前一个月，他都会亲自上街布置‘六四’图片展，近年则会把相关图片放上网。这些图片的内容全都是事实，怎么会是‘虚假’呢？”
周庭希表示，随着澳门修订《国安法》，近年来当地的言论、新闻自由大幅缩小，现在就连被认为最敢言的区锦新都失去自由，恐怕往后再也没有人会公然批评政府。
这是澳门首宗涉及违反《维护国家安全法》的案件。法院表示，区锦新接受法院指定代表律师，并与律师保持紧密沟通，家属申请定期探视也获法院批准，但据了解，自区锦新去年7月被捕后，家属无法与他正常联系，也无法为他委托辩护律师。
美国之音尝试联系他身在英国的女儿区翰怡，以了解区锦新是否提出上诉，但到截稿时尚未收到回复。
周庭希说：“根据我对澳门的认知，澳门当局的陈述往往不尽不实。。。表面上，区锦新有自由去选择律师，也可以和家属保持联系，但据了解，区的女儿有很长一段时间无法与父亲联络。”
台湾陆委会星期五表示，区锦新案审理过程欠缺公开透明，当事人无法自行选任辩护律师，相关做法严重影响司法人权及程序正义，并加深外界对于澳门司法独立及法治环境的疑虑。陆委会对此表达高度遗憾。
陆委会担忧，此案可能进一步压缩澳门民众的政治权利、言论自由及基本人权，呼吁澳门政府落实澳门《基本法》相关规定，维护司法程序正义，保障人民的基本权利。
在区锦新判决前一天，香港民主活动人士黄之锋被以“串谋勾结外国势力”罪名加判10年徒刑。人权活动人士潘嘉伟认为，国际社会不应对中国再存任何幻想。
潘嘉伟说：“澳门、香港两宗指标性的判刑发出了一个重要信息：国际社会不该对中国再存任何幻想，憧憬中国会自行改变。若没有国际压力，中国只会越来越差。若接受外媒采访就等同‘勾结’，是否以后大家都不能接受媒体采访了？港澳是否与中国大陆一摸一样，处于完全噤声的状态?”
中国国务院港澳办公室星期五就区锦新案的判刑发表回应说，该案作为澳门《国安法》制定实施以来的第一起案件，侦办、审理过程和判决结果，标志着澳门维护国安法律制度和执行机制“落地见效”。
中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在星期五的例行发布会上表示，“澳门回归以来，‘一国两制’实践取得举世公认的伟大成就。。。澳门居民依照《基本法》享有的广泛权利和自由得到充分保障，这是有目共睹的事实。”
郭嘉昆还表示，“坚决反对任何外部势力借司法个案干预澳门内部事务，干涉中国内政。”
澳门前终审法院院长岑浩辉以得票率98.99%当选澳门特首

content:
资料照片：一群中国工人在北京中央商务区一个施工现场的围墙外休息，围墙上描绘着中国首都的天际线。(2018年6月26日)
中国为扩大社会保险(社保)的覆盖面和基金规模，11月再推新制，对欠缴保费的用人单位祭出1-3倍的罚款，这是继去年9月将劳资私签“自动弃保”协议认定无效后，再度加大社保的征管力道。
“强制纳保”原具提高劳工保障的美意，但当局选在景气下行期全面落地，再加上社保基金频传遭挪用或贪腐等丑闻，让勒紧裤袋过日子的企业和劳工纷纷大叹: 缴不起、不愿缴、更怕领不到。
专家说，中国社保改革势在必行，但挑战也多，中共得“杀出一条血路”，才能解决人口快速老化、养老保障不足的社会和执政隐患。
中国国家税务总局自11月1日开始施行最新版的《全国税务行政处罚裁量基准》，首次将社保缴费违法行为纳入全国的税务裁罚体系，以“全国一把尺”终结过去各地执法不一的乱象。
一般档: 欠缴50万元人民币以下，或欠缴50万-500万元但占比未满30%者，罚1倍。
较重档:欠缴50万-500万元且占比逾30%，或欠缴逾500万元但占比未满30%者，处1-2倍罚款。
严重档：欠缴逾500万元且占比逾30%，或其他严重情节者，处2-3倍罚款。
至于劳资双方私下签订的“自愿放弃社保”协议，早于去年9月就已经依据最高人民法院做出的司法解释，一律认定为无效，且人力资源社会保障部(人社部)还强调，将启动大数据，催缴欠费者或找出更多灵活就业等新职工来扩大参保率。
社保改革一波接着一波，但中国劳动阶层对新制多反应冷淡、贬多于褒。
位于安徽的微博网民“O_o拾玖”贴文称:“我们公司要给俩选择，降薪交社保，要不转临时工。”
浙江微博网民“傲娇实习生”也感叹:“企业用人意愿会进一步下降。”
福建微博网民“daybeyday”则附和道:“一大堆人失业。”
江西微博网民“叶露悲伤”抱怨：“去查查多少公司都不交社保，还有只交三险的。”
云南网民“夜的星空不再繁华”质疑：“养老金等到几十年后我们老那天真的还能发出来吗？”
位于内蒙古的微博博主“我观我行”贴文称:“这一招大力支持… 要实现全民社保，必须进行企业端的强力调节。”
不过，香港智易东方证卷有限公司行政总裁蔺常念担心，社保新制后续恐引发企业倒闭潮。
蔺常念告诉美国之音:“我看那很难(催缴)，因为绝大部分的小型公司都在破产边缘。”
一位在北京、因议题敏感不愿具名的企业高管在接受美国之音采访时分析，新制是“一次性清算”过去20年间“高费率+低基数”的制度性妥协，亦即，多数民企过去为压低成本、削价竞争，其生存潜规则是：不论薪水高低，一律按最低基数缴社保，或是以薪水补贴当诱因，让员工自愿弃保，但现在税务系统有了数据比对能力，这个灰色平衡就被打破了。
他说，劳资双方反弹的逻辑不在违法或理亏，而是“成本突然显性化”，关键也不在企业该不该合规，而是当局选在2026年这个内需收缩、利润承压、出口不确定性高企的时间点，要求全行业“一次性把历史欠账补上”，而且“毫无缓冲期”，企业承压之大恐难想像。
在此前提下，这位高管预测:“企业的本能反应将是降薪、缩编、用劳务派遣或灵活用工替代正式岗、把一人活压给两人。”
总部位于美国纽约的非政府组织“中国劳工观察”执行主任李强在接受美国之音采访时表示，中国制造追求低价，代价却由劳工在扛，因为他们是遭剥削越来越严重的一群人。
他举例说，不少中国劳工现在一周工作7天，每天12小时，工时早就超过996(早9上班、晚9下班，每周工作6天)，都还拿不到最低工资，却还得按最低基数来参加社保，因此，缴不起社保是他们的真实心声。另外，除了“经济确实受影响”，对“国家缺乏信任”怕退休后领不到养老金，也是劳工普遍排斥社保的原因之一。
李强还说，中国改革开放40年，当年进城打工的农民工现多届龄50-60岁，是即将退休的老人，但他们的养老金不足是很大的社会隐患。他归咎原因，一是多数城市当年透过免除企业社保来吸引投资，二是地方“欺负这群异地来的农民工”无法落户参加社保，因此，多数农民工回到农村后，现只能月领200多元的养老金，根本无法过活，也间接对地方财政造成负担，而且相较于公务员平均月领高达6,000元的退休金，差距之大也是另一个不公平处。
李强说，中国社保改革迟早都要做，因其有积极面，例如，包括退休金在内的社会福利未来若进一步完善，会让消费者更敢花钱，可进一步刺激中国内需；再者，劳动成本提高虽不利于中国的出口价格竞争力，但或可因此降低中国对外的贸易顺差，更重要地，中国人口快速老化下，养老保障缺口若无法补足，对中国社会和中共的执政都构成隐患，因此，挑战虽多，中共仍得一一克服“杀出一条血路”。
中国社保包含养老、医疗、失业、工伤和生育五大保险(五险)，前三项由劳资双方按比例分担，后两项由资方缴纳。虽法律早就规定强制纳保，但截至近一年来，才获得严格执行。
据中国财政部的统计，截至2025年底，全国五险的渗透率不算低，其中，共10.8亿人加入养老保险，参保率逾95%，实际领取待遇者已逾3.2亿人。另医保总人数为13.3亿人，参保率也逾95%，而参加失业、工伤和生育保险者分别为2.5亿人、3.1亿人和2.6亿人。
另外，社保基金2025年度的整体收入和支出分约达12.6万亿和11.1万亿元人民币，年度结馀仅1.46万亿，逐渐入不敷出，虽然年末滚存结余近16万亿，但中国退休人口预计年增2,000万人，养老支出压力越来越大，中国社会科学院就曾预估过，城镇职工退休保险基金的累计结余恐于2035年耗尽。

content:
2026年11月3日，一艘集装箱船停靠在中国山东烟台市的烟台国际港。
中国商务部宣布，将继续对原产于美国的正丙醇进口产品征收反倾销税和反补贴税，期限为五年。对这样一个相对小众的化工产品维持关税究竟为了什么？另外，中国商务部表示对扩大自美采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方达成的对等降税安排落地。美国驻华大使庞德伟同日表示，美国并不寻求与中国脱钩，但是美方要争取一个公平的竞争环境。
中国商务部星期四(11月5日)发布两份公告称，自星期五(11月6日)起，将继续对原产于美国的正丙醇(NPA)征收反倾销和反补贴税税，实施期限为五年。
公告公布了对美国进口正丙醇所适用的反补贴和反倾销措施的期终复审裁定，裁定如果终止反倾销和反补贴措施，美国进口正丙醇的倾销和补贴可能继续或再度发生，对中国正丙醇产业造成的损害可能会持续或再度发生。
2020年11月18日，中国商务部决定对美国的进口正丙醇征收反倾销和反补贴税，实施期限为5年。2025年11月18日，中国商务部决定对上述措施启动期满复审。
11月5日的公告即是复审后的裁定。根据新裁定，“双反”税率保持不变，反倾销税率为254.4%至267.4%，反补贴税率则为34.2%至37.7%。
正丙醇广泛应用于食品包装生产，同时也是新能源汽车锂电池电解液的重要组成部分。
美中贸易分析人士普遍认为，正丙醇是一个相对小众的化工产品，在美中贸易中的规模其实很小，但却可以在中国享有高额且长达多年的关税保护，似乎有点不太合理。但是如果从政治经济学角度来看，便不难理解了。
南卡罗来纳大学艾肯商学院讲座教授谢田(Frank Xie)在接受美国之音(VOA)采访时表示，在当前美中经贸竞争仍然持续的背景下，贸易救济措施实际上也具有一定的战略和谈判含义。
谢田告诉美国之音：“从政策逻辑上看，这是中国近年来更加重视产业安全和关键供应链自主可控的延续。由于正丙醇不仅用于食品包装，也涉及新能源电池产业链，因此中国政府更倾向于维持对本土生产商的保护措施。”
中国延续正丙醇“双反”税将继续影响一些生产和出口正丙醇的美国公司，比如在反倾销税率上，陶氏化学公司(The Dow Chemical Company)和OQ化学公司(OQ Chemicals Corporation)的税率仍然维持在254.4%和267.4%。
加州州政府研究首席、加州大学戴维斯分校经济系客座教授廖启宏(Charles Liao)在接受美国之音采访时指出，如此高的反倾销与反补贴税率，将大幅削弱美国产品在中国市场的价格竞争力，但是对美国整体经济影响会相当有限。
廖启宏告诉美国之音：“正丙醇毕竟只是化学产业中的特定产品，而且相关关税已经实施多年。因此，这次延长措施所造成的新增冲击，应该远小于2020年最初实施时的影响。”
南卡罗来纳大学的经济学者谢田认为，这反映出美中贸易摩擦已经从传统制造业扩展到了新能源和化工原材料领域，增加了美国企业进入中国市场的不确定性，不过其象征意义可能大于实际的贸易规模。
截至发稿，美国商务部尚未回复美国之音关于正丙醇“双反”税的置评请求。
与此同时，中国商务部发言人黄玲在11月5日的例行新闻发布会上，被问及11月2日，中国国际贸易谈判代表李成钢会见美国农产品贸易代表团时，双方在中方进口更多美国农产品方面是否有达成任何共识。
黄玲表示中方“一直对扩大自美采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方达成的‘300亿对300亿’对等降税安排落地”。
9月份中国国家主席习近平访美、并与唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统举行会晤后，双方提出了一项总额为600亿美元的互惠关税削减方案，涉及的商品涵盖农产品、家用电器及医疗设备。不过，该方案尚未最终敲定。
美中贸易观察人士普遍认为，600亿美元的关税削减方案最终达成部分协议的可能性是存在的，但落实仍面临挑战，尤其在中期选举后，前景可能更不明朗。
经济学者谢田告诉美国之音：“中期选举共和党失利，特朗普未来的政策措施可能更加不确定。还有，美中之间的关税问题已经与技术竞争、产业政策和国家安全议题交织在一起，很难单独处理。”
谢田指出，即使出现阶段性降税，也更可能是一种有限和可逆的安排，而不是美中贸易关系全面回归自由化。
美国驻华大使庞德伟(David Perdue)11月5日在社媒平台X发文，表示他在美中贸易全国委员会举行的2026中国年度运营大会上发表的讲话中强调，美国政府专注于在公平、对等的基础上重新平衡贸易。
他写道：“我们不是要脱钩。我们是在为美国企业和工人们争取公平的竞争环境，让他们能够竞争并且胜出。”
加州大学经济学者廖启宏表示，庞德伟的讲话反映出美国对中国的经济政策，正在从单纯追求自由贸易，转向更加强调对等与公平竞争。
廖启宏告诉美国之音：“我认为(庞德伟要传达的)最重要的信息是：美国不是要停止与中国做生意，而是希望重新制定做生意的条件。”
南卡罗来纳大学的经济学者谢田指出，虽然庞德伟向中国市场和美国企业同时释放一个明确的信号，即美国希望调整与中国的经济关系，而不是彻底切断这种关系，但从中共的角度看，即使美国不使用“脱钩”这一表述，美国采取的出口管制、投资和技术限制等措施仍然会被视为某种程度上的经济分离。

content:
“保护卫士”：中国境外干预与镇压规模持续扩大；多国立法人员直指“侨联”为中共白手套
“保护卫士”：中国境外干预与镇压规模持续扩大；多国立法人员直指“侨联”为中共白手套
“保护卫士”：中国境外干预与镇压规模持续扩大；多国立法人员直指“侨联”为中共白手套
“保护卫士”发表的“镇压配方：中国的全球社区管控网格”(A Formula for Repression - China's Global Grid for Community Control)报告封面和内文。(2026年11月6日)
人权组织“保护卫士”(Safeguard Defenders)星期五(11月6日)表示，继四年前中国海外警察站曝光后，中国更加肆意地通过其公安、法院、检察院等机关将“触角”伸往世界各地。对此，来自欧洲、美洲和亚洲等26国的立法人员呼吁采取紧急措施，打击中国的境外干预和跨国镇压。这些国会议员还直指“中华全国归国华侨联合会”(侨联）为中共跨国镇压体系的“白手套”。
“保护卫士”星期五在X上发表题为“镇压配方：中国的全球社区管控网格”(A Formula for Repression - China's Global Grid for Community Control)的最新报告。“保护卫士”指出，该报告完全基于中国党政机关公开发布的资料，详细说明中国共产党控制和监视全球华人社区的策略和手段，且在中国国家主席习近平的亲自指导下快速扩张，其中的核心就是一个由中共统战人员组成的全球行动网络，目的是控制人们的思想、言行，无论他们身在何处。
2022年，“保护卫士”发布了两份记录中国海外警察站活动的报告，《海外110》(110 Overseas)和《巡逻与劝返》(Patrol & Persuade)，其中记录了在50多个国家运作的100多个中国海外警察站的活动。报告发布后，许多受影响国家谴责这些警察站的非法运作，一些国家启动了刑事调查。
时隔四年，“保护卫士”的最新报告发现，中国当局对海外华人社区的管理，不仅规模扩大到至少91个国家，1247个中国官方指定的海外联络点，其范围也从早期的“海外警察服务站”扩展成更广泛也更制度化的跨部门网络。同样的工作不仅继续，还越来越多地以“侨联”(全名：中华全国归国华侨联合会)的名义进行。
报告进一步说明何谓管控网格。在中国境内，每座城市、乡镇和村庄都被划分为数百户一格的网格，每格配有网格员，负责采集信息并向“社会治安综合治理中心”(综治中心)报告。综治中心是结合公安、检察院、法院和司法局的联合办公机构，2014年起，中共开始在海外设立同样的网格。
报告将海外华人社团、侨务组织和统一战线相关网络视为该网络的重要节点，它们被用来联系、影响和管理海外华人社群，对异议人士的施压、监控和劝返也是通过这些节点展开。报告引用中国官方关于公安、法院、检察院和司法部门加强“侨务”协作的表述，认为相关工作正在从少数警察站试点，发展为覆盖多个政府部门的整体性做法。
“保护卫士”中国事务主任劳拉·哈斯(Laura Harth)在X上发文表示，中共利用统战渠道，比如同乡会和商会，来扩大对海外华人社区的控制。“2022年之后唯一的变化就是，他们不再傻到在国外的墙上贴真正的警察标志。”她说。
中国境外干预的做法不仅锁定海外华人，美国官员也经常成为目标。
在“保护卫士”报告发布前一天，美国国务院负责外交公共事务的副国务卿萨拉·罗杰斯(Sarah Rogers)在X上发文，谴责中国政府对美国公职人员的干预。
“美国民选官员是对他们的选民负责，而不是对中国共产党负责。这也包括印第安纳州的州财政官员。北京没有权利试图指挥美国人如何处理合法事务。”罗杰斯副国务卿说。
事件起因于10月下旬，中国驻芝加哥总领馆致函印第安纳州财长(State Treasurer)丹尼尔·埃利奥特(Daniel Elliott)。信中指埃利奥特在芝加哥参加台湾的双十酒会，是“错误地把台湾当作国家”，“侵犯中国主权和领土完整”，总领馆对此“强烈谴责”，并要求其不得与台湾当局进行任何官方往来。
埃利奥特在X上将中国总领馆信件公开，并表示，拒绝任何外国政府的政治要求指导印第安纳州官员合法行为的建议。
“在印第安纳州，政府是为人民工作的。人民不是为政府工作的。中国共产党搞错了，而且已经错了很久了。”他说。
今年7月，中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆也曾两度致函亚利桑那州州长凯蒂·霍布斯(Gov. Katie Hobbs)，敦促她反对台湾在亚利桑那州凤凰城设立新办事处。霍布斯无视中国施压，10月初与台湾外交部长林佳龙共同出席台湾办事处的揭幕仪式。
针对“人权卫士”的最新报告，由全球多国议会跨党派议员组成的对华政策跨国议会联盟(Inter‑Parliamentary Alliance on China，简称IPAC)发出紧急警示，呼吁全球民主政府果断采取行动，打击中共的渗透干预和跨境镇压。
IPAC在X平台的声明中说，中共的这套系统是以统战部主导，由“侨联”等白手套机构执行。
IPAC呼吁全球民主政府采取六项措施，抵御中共威胁。包括：指定具刑事责任的“外国代理人登记法”；强制登记与中共统战部的关联；发布有关中共统战部的政府警示；发布“中国干预”国家年度报告；为受害海外社群建立完善的举报渠道；以及直接与遭中共孤立的群体和社群互动。
2018年遭中国政府以涉嫌“危害国家安全”和“间谍”罪逮捕，并关押近三年的加拿大前外交官康明凯(Michael Kovrig, 迈克尔·科夫瑞格)，星期五在X上贴文表示，中国当局的做法不仅威胁海外华人社群的权利，也威胁到他们所居住国家的主权。
“世界各国要与北京建立更紧密的外交关系，不能以对本国领土上的监控、审查、胁迫或颠覆视而不见为代价。”康明凯说。

title: 美国中期选举后，140亿美元对台军售案再受关注

content:
在台湾新北市举行的年度“汉光”军事演习期间，台湾军方的一套“爱国者”导弹系统部署在当地一座公园内。(2026年8月6日)
美国民主党预计在中期选举赢得国会参众两院控制权后，一笔仍待美国政府批准的140亿美元对台军售案再度受到关注。台湾国防部长顾立雄星期四(11月5日)表示，将持续与美国国会议员及战争部保持沟通，确保相关军售按计划推进。
曾任兰德公司台湾政策倡议创始主任的国际安全专家郭泓均(Raymond Kuo)对美国之音(VOA)表示，民主党主导的新国会可能加强对行政部门的制约，为推动这笔军售带来新的压力。不过，国会选举结果是否能够转化为军售进展，仍有待观察。
顾立雄当天赴立法院出席追加预算案审查前接受媒体联访时说：“美国国会一向以来就不分党派都会支持台湾增强防卫力量，我们也会持续来跟这些国会议员进行沟通，当然我们也会跟美国战争部保持密切联系，来确保我们的相关军售都能够如计划进行。”
新一届国会将于2027年1月就职。民主党赢得两院多数席位，意味着届时将掌握相关委员会的议程与监督工具，但军售案的推进仍涉及行政部门的批准及国会审查程序。
“与选前相比，我现在对特朗普政府推进这笔军售方案抱有更大的希望，”郭泓均在电邮采访中说。
他认为，唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统将对台军售视为与中国谈判的筹码，而民主党取得国会控制权后，可能更积极运用拨款和监督权，要求行政部门落实国会确定的政策优先事项。
“国会的核心权力是财政权：它通过决定资金用于哪些事项，以及投入多少，来确定联邦政府的优先事项，”他说。
郭泓均批评，过去两年，特朗普政府通过扣留资金推动自身政策重点，有时绕过或违背国会意愿。他认为，特朗普在共和党内的影响力，使其较少受到本党议员制约，民主党则不太可能接受同样的做法。
今年5月，参议院两党议员也曾敦促特朗普正式向国会通报这笔军售，强调美国对台湾的支持不应成为与北京谈判的筹码。这些行动显示，推动军售并非只有民主党议员支持。
尽管美国与台湾没有正式外交关系，《台湾关系法》规定，美国向台湾提供维持足够自卫能力所需的防务物资和服务。
特朗普政府去年12月批准了总额约110亿美元的对台军售。另一批约140亿美元的军售方案则仍未获批准。特朗普今年5月与中国领导人习近平会晤后表示暂缓推进，并将其称为“谈判筹码”。
除军售审批外，国会议员更替也将影响台湾在华盛顿的关系网络。
美国台湾观测站(US Taiwan Watch)星期四发表分析指出，本届国会“台湾连线”(Taiwan Caucus)的多名共和党成员将在换届后离任，包括参议员约翰·科宁(John Cornyn)、苏珊·柯林斯(Susan Collins)及乔尼·恩斯特(Joni Ernst)。
众议院方面，离任成员包括麦克·劳勒(Mike Lawler)、布莱恩·菲茨帕特里克(Brian Fitzpatrick)、罗伯·惠特曼(Rob Wittman)、安迪·比格斯(Andy Biggs)和汤姆·蒂凡尼(Tom Tiffany)等。
与此同时，一些具有支持台湾记录的政治人物赢得选举。民主党籍前参议员、参议院台湾连线共同创办人谢罗德·布朗(Sherrod Brown)将重返参院；共和党籍众议员、台湾连线成员安迪·巴尔(Andy Barr)成功转战参院；共和党参议员皮特·里基茨(Pete Ricketts)也赢得连任。
“面对多位台湾连线成员离开国会或退休，台湾仍需要积极接触新一代国会议员，延续并拓展跨党派支持，”美国台湾观测站的文章说。
此次选举也使众议院的台裔议员增加至三人。民主党人、儿科医生及前加州州参议员潘君达(Richard Pan)首次当选联邦众议员，加州的刘云平(Ted Lieu)和纽约州的孟昭文(Grace Meng)则赢得连任。
潘君达的父母来自台湾。他在竞选网站的声明中表示，将致力于强化美台伙伴关系，维护台海和平与稳定。刘云平和孟昭文也是台湾连线的民主党成员。
台湾寻求推进军售之际，中国继续在台湾周边开展军事活动。
台湾国防部星期四通报，截至当天上午6点的24小时内，侦获21架次解放军军机、8艘军舰及8艘公务船在台海周边活动，其中19架次军机越过海峡中线，进入台湾北部、中部、西南及东部空域。台湾军方派遣军机、军舰，并运用岸置导弹系统监控和应处。
美国智库战略与国际研究中心(CSIS)中国实力项目今年2月发布的分析显示，2025年解放军军机进入台湾防空识别区的活动达到3,764架次，比2024年增加22.4%，创下纪录。

summary: 香港敦促成为可持续航空燃油认证中心|中国劳工布告栏 星期一, 2026 年 11 月 9 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港敦促成为可持续航空燃油认证中心 商业环境委员会领导人表示，香港可以利用其法律基础设施和金融声誉，成为可持续航空燃油认证提供商和贸易中心，支持政府到 2026 年香港国际机场 SAF 消耗量达到 1-3% 的目标。香港可以确立其作为可持续航空燃油认证中心的角色
content:
香港敦促成为可持续航空燃油认证中心|中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港促成为可持续航空燃油认证中心
商业环境委员会领导人表示，香港可以利用其法律基础设施和金融声誉，成为可持续的航空燃油认证提供商和贸易中心，支持政府到 2026 年将香港国际机场的 SAF 消耗量提高 1-3% 的目标。
商业环境委员会的执行领导人在接受《标准报》独家专访时表示，香港可以在整体生态系统中确立其作为可持续航空燃油认证提供商以及 SAF 贸易中心的角色。
BEC行政总裁吴家荣表示：“香港拥有提供SAF认证的能力、法律基础设施和国际声誉的金融中心，并成为更广泛的绿色生态系统的一部分，甚至在获得认证后成熟为区域贸易中心，为未来绿色金融注入新能源做出贡献。”吴强调，采用SAF不仅仅是为了减少碳排放，而是利用香港的固有优势，提升其全球金融地位和竞争力。
BEC政策与研究主管Merlin Lao Man-chi指出，未来的验证框架将提振市场信心。与政府在最新施政报告中实现从香港国际机场出发的航班的SAF消耗率达到1%至3%的承诺相一致，吴建议采取市场驱动的激励措施（例如向积极采用SAF的航空公司授予优先机场停车位），而不是长期的货币激励措施，因为政府面临紧张的财政限制。
虽然从长远来看，类似新加坡起始模式的税收适合香港，但老挝警告称，短期内不要仓促实施，因为去年离境税提高至200港元后，香港的航空旅行费用已经高于附近地区。他补充说，过境航班和国际货物中转应首先获得豁免，以保持香港的竞争力。 Lao 还对要求航空公司使用 SAF 的严格法律强制性指导方针提出警告，并警告说，这可能会造成成本上涨，从而对航空公司和乘客产生适得其反的影响。
吴强调大湾区内建立区域供应链的必要性，并解释说，一个不错的选择是通过政府补贴在内地设厂，这有助于确保原材料成本低廉，从而有利于SAF的最终价格。此外，他强调了教育对于提高公众对 SAF 的了解的重要性，并指出，从长远来看，广泛的理解有助于为未来 SAF 的采用奠定坚实的基础。

Hong Kong urged to become sustainable aviation fuel certification hub | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong urged to become sustainable aviation fuel certification hub
Business Environment Council leaders say Hong Kong can leverage its legal infrastructure and financial reputation to become a sustainable aviation fuel certification provider and trading hub, supporting the government's target of 1-3 per cent SAF consumption at HKIA by 2026.
Hong Kong can establish its role as a sustainable aviation fuel certification provider as well as a trading hub for SAF within the holistic ecosystem, executive leaders at the Business Environment Council said in an exclusive interview with The Standard.
BEC chief executive Simon Ng Ka-wing said: "Hong Kong has the capacity, legal infrastructure, and international reputation as a financial center to provide SAF certification and function as part of the broader green ecosystem, or even mature into a regional trading hub following certification, contributing to how green finance can be injected into new energy in the future." Ng emphasised that SAF adoption is not merely about reducing carbon emissions, but leveraging Hong Kong’s inherent advantages to elevate its global financial standing and competitiveness.
Merlin Lao Man-chi, head of policy and research at the BEC, noted that future verification frameworks would boost market confidence. Aligning with the government’s commitment in the latest policy address to achieve a SAF consumption ratio of 1 to 3 per cent for flights departing from Hong Kong International Airport, Ng suggested market-driven incentives – such as granting priority airport parking slots to airlines actively adopting SAF – rather than long-term monetary incentives, as the government faces tight financial constraints.
While a levy similar to Singapore’s starting model fits Hong Kong in the long run, Lao warned against rushing it in the short term, as Hong Kong’s air travel expenses are already higher than nearby regions following last year's departure tax increase to HK$200. He added that transit flights and international cargo transfers should be exempted initially to maintain Hong Kong’s competitiveness. Lao also cautioned against strict legal mandatory guidelines that require airlines to use SAF, warning that it could create cost markups that backfire on carriers and passengers.
Ng highlighted the necessity of a regional supply chain within the Greater Bay Area, explaining that a good option would be to set up factories in the mainland through government subsidisation, which can help ensure raw materials at a low cost, benefiting final SAF prices. Additionally, he stressed the importance of education to raise public knowledge of SAF, noting that widespread understanding helps lay a robust foundation for future SAF adoption in the long run.

[Nvidia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nvidia/) 董事会周日表示，正在对有关首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 成为“外国情报工作目标”的报道展开[调查](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/investigation/)。

据《纽约时报》(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/the-new-york-times/)报道，黄向董事会承认，他与一名[企业](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/business/)高管关系密切，美国情报部门确定该高管正在为[北京](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/beijing/)收集信息。

据《泰晤士报》报道，黄在给该公司的信息中道歉。 “我对我的妻子不忠，”他说。 “我的行为伤害了她和我们的[孩子](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/children/)。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

英伟达董事会在一份声明中表示，“没有理由相信”国家安全或英伟达机密遭到泄露，但其调查将检查所有可用信息。董事会表示，黄“完全支持审查并承诺配合审查”。

63 岁的黄在调查期间将继续担任首席执行官。
英伟达已成为全球人工智能开发竞赛的核心参与者，其芯片为许多用于训练和运行人工智能模型的数据中心和计算系统提供支持。其先进处理器也一直是美国出口限制的重点，旨在限制中国获得尖端半导体技术。

《泰晤士报》上个月报道称，美国情报机构发现黄与中国公民、芯片买家 Alice Huang 建立了密切关系，并确定她直接向北京提供信息。据《泰晤士报》报道，两者没有关系。

了解更多[Nvidia黄宣布对法国科技行业进行新投资](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261014-nvidia-s-huang-announces-new-investments-in-french-tech-sector)

Alice Huang 曾是[电视](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/television/)驻[中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)记者，之后成为新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的高管，该公司已成为 Nvidia 在东南亚最大的客户之一。据《泰晤士报》报道，Megaspeed 在过去两年购买了价值超过 48 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。
总统[唐纳德·特朗普](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)在他的[万圣节](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/halloween/)派对上发表了这些报告，称情况“非常复杂”，并表示他希望总统科学技术顾问委员会成员黄仁勋一切顺利。总统称黄“聪明”、“了不起”，并坚持让黄陪同他出国旅行。

“我一直发现黄仁勋非常光明正大，”特朗普 10 月 31 日对记者表示，并补充说政府将“非常密切”地调查此事。

美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周日在离开美国前往巴黎参加七国集团 (G7)(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/g7/) 会议时表示，他无法与黄解决这一问题。

“由于其[性质](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nature/)，我无法发表评论，”他告诉记者。 “而且我也无法评论公司内部的情况

【原文 English Original】
[Nvidia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nvidia/) is opening an [investigation](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/investigation/) into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company’s board of directors said Sunday.

The announcement came after Huang acknowledged to the board that he had been intimate with a [business](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/business/) executive whom US intelligence determined was gathering information for [Beijing](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/beijing/), [The New York Times](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/the-new-york-times/) reported.

Huang apologized in a message to the company, according to the Times. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our [children](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/children/). There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”

Nvidia’s board said in a statement it has “no reason to believe" that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, but that its inquiry would examine all available information. Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it,” the board said.

Huang, 63, will remain CEO during the investigation.

Nvidia has become a central player in the global race to develop artificial intelligence, with its chips powering many of the data centers and computing systems used to train and run AI models. Its advanced processors have also been a focus of US export restrictions aimed at limiting China’s access to cutting-edge semiconductor technology.

The Times reported last month that US intelligence agencies had discovered that Huang had developed a close relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, and determined that she was feeding information directly to Beijing. The two are not related, according to the Times.

Read more[Nvidia's Huang announces new investments in French tech sector](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261014-nvidia-s-huang-announces-new-investments-in-french-tech-sector)

Alice Huang was previously a [television](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/television/) reporter in [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/) before becoming a top executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed, which has become one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed bought more than $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia chips over the past two years, according to the Times.

President [Donald Trump](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/) addressed the reports at his [Halloween](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/halloween/) party, calling the situation “very complex” and saying he hoped everything was OK with Jensen Huang, who serves on the president’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. The president has called Huang “smart” and “amazing,” insisting that Huang accompany him on foreign trips.

“I've always found Jensen Huang to be very aboveboard,” Trump told reporters on Oct. 31, adding that the administration would look into the matter “very closely.”

Secretary of State [Marco Rubio](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/marco-rubio/) said Sunday as he was departing the US for a [G7](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/g7/) meeting in [Paris](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/paris/) that he could not address the situation with Huang.

“I just can't comment because of the [nature](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nature/) of it,” he told reporters. “And I also can't comment on an internal corporate matter that's going on with Nvidia.”

Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, has regularly surpassed Wall Street’s earnings expectations in the past three years since its high-end chips emerged as AI’s best building blocks. The Santa Clara, California-based company reported quarterly profits of $59.69 billion in August.

_(FRANCE 24 with AP)_

美国芯片制造商英伟达正在对其首席执行官、亿万富翁黄仁勋进行调查，此前黄仁勋证实自己与一名被指控为中国情报部门工作的女性有亲密关系。

英伟达董事会表示：“虽然董事会没有理由相信国家安全或英伟达机密遭到泄露，但董事会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”
声明称，董事会仍然“对詹森及其领导团队充满信心”。在调查期间，黄仁勋将继续领导英伟达。
此次调查是在《纽约时报》上个月报道称詹森可能是中国间谍阴谋的目标之后进行的。
中国和美国一直在争夺人工智能（AI）等关键技术领域的主导地位。
在人工智能热潮中，英伟达的芯片和编程接口需求激增，导致该公司估值数万亿美元。
多年来，美国一直试图限制向中国出口先进芯片，担心这个亚洲超级大国可能在其技术和军事领域获得优势。
但 10 月 29 日，《纽约时报》称其获得独家消息称，一位名叫 Alice Huang 或黄乐的中国女性试图与黄仁勋建立密切关系，以收集有关 Nvidia 技术的信息。
中国驻华盛顿大使馆否认了此案中的任何间谍指控。
《纽约时报》还报道称，Alice Huang 的雇主 Megaspeed 已成为 Nvidia 最大的买家之一，从这家美国公司购买了约 48 亿美元的设备。
该报告发布后，黄仁勋与没有任何关系的黄爱丽丝的关系引发了美国国会两党的强烈反对。
民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 在一份声明中写道：“几个月来，国会两党议员一直对 NVIDIA 的先进人工智能芯片进入中国表示担忧。”
“NVIDIA 的黄仁勋和 NVIDIA 董事会欠国会一个答案。我们需要通过两党立法，我们已经准备好阻止美国先进技术流入中国。”
众议院共和党议员也呼吁黄于11月18日就此事出庭作证。
共和党人约翰·莫勒纳尔、布莱恩·马斯特和里克·克劳福德在一份声明中表示：“国会确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度至关重要。”
在周日发给英伟达员工的电子邮件中，黄仁勋承认自己有婚外情。
“我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的行为没有任何借口，”黄说。

US chipmaker Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair | Crime News | Al Jazeera

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang delivers an address at the Nvidia Berlin GPU Technology Conference on October 21 [Sean Gallup/Getty Images]
United States-based chipmaker Nvidia is investigating its chief executive officer, billionaire Jensen Huang, after he confirmed he had an intimate relationship with a woman accused of working for Chinese intelligence.
In an announcement on Sunday, Nvidia said the probe would be conducted by a “committee of independent directors” with outside counsel.

“While the board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the board’s inquiry will examine all available information,” Nvidia’s board of directors said.
It said the board continued to have “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team”. Huang will continue to lead Nvidia during the probe.
The investigation follows a report in The New York Times last month that Jensen may have been the target of a Chinese espionage plot.
China and the US have been in competition to dominate key tech sectors like artificial intelligence (AI).
Amid the AI boom, Nvidia has seen demand for its chips and programming interfaces explode, resulting in the company being valued in the trillions of dollars.
For years, the US has sought to restrict the export of advanced chips to China, fearing the Asian superpower could gain an edge over its technology and military sectors.
But on October 29, The New York Times said it had obtained exclusive information that a Chinese woman named Alice Huang, or Huang Le, sought to cultivate close ties with Jensen Huang in an effort to glean information about Nvidia’s technology.
The Chinese Embassy in Washington, DC, has denied any allegations of spying in the case.
The New York Times also reported that Alice Huang’s employer, Megaspeed, had become one of Nvidia’s largest buyers, purchasing some $4.8bn in equipment from the US firm.
Jensen Huang’s ties to Alice Huang, who is of no relation, spurred fierce bipartisan backlash in the US Congress in the aftermath of the report.
“For months, bipartisan members of Congress have raised concerns about NVIDIA’s advanced AI chips going to China,” Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren wrote in a statement.
“NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang and NVIDIA’s board owe Congress answers. And we need to pass bipartisan legislation we have ready to stop advanced American technology from going to China.”
Republican lawmakers in the House of Representatives also called on Huang to appear and testify before Congress about the affair on November 18.
“It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which US national security has been placed at risk,” Republicans John Moolenaar, Brian Mast and Rick Crawford said in a statement.
In an email to Nvidia staff on Sunday, Huang had admitted to having an extramarital relationship.
“I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse ‌for what I did,” Huang said.
Nvidia has grown rapidly in recent years with the rise of AI, producing chips for large language models developed by companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google.
Huang has also been closely working with US President Donald Trump since the Republican leader returned to office in 2025.
In August of that year, the Trump administration announced it would take a 15 percent cut of certain Nvidia chip sales to China.
Trump reportedly bought as much as $1.6m in Nvidia stock and sold about $1m in August, ahead of November’s midterm elections.
After the midterm races last Tuesday, stocks for AI-related companies, including Nvidia, tumbled in reaction to widespread Republican losses.
Trump has pushed back against calls to regulate AI companies, but many Democrats during the midterms campaigned on placing restrictions on the companies, including on the construction of data centres.
Nvidia lost $450bn in market value in a single trading day last week, but it rebounded on Friday, regaining 4 percent of its losses.
When asked by reporters if Huang would accompany him to November’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in China, Trump was noncommittal.
“I don’t know, but I’d certainly take him,” Trump replied from the tarmac in West Palm Beach, Florida. “I haven’t heard he’s done anything wrong. He dealt with somebody, but so does everybody else.”
He added that Huang was a “fine person” and has done an “amazing job for our country”.
“I think he’s an honourable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it,” Trump said of the speculation about Huang’s behaviour.

中新社台北11月7日电 台北市长蒋万安的竞选团队周六呼吁支持者参加11月14日的游行和集会，而民进党挑战者沉伯洋则率领竞选车队穿越台北两个区。
两位台北市长候选人也在高雄分别举行的集会上支持各自政党的候选人，蒋介石亲自出席，而沉在11月28日地方选举前三周则发送了预先录制的视频。
在周六的新闻发布会上，蒋介石的国民党竞选团队公布了一张游行海报，海报上印着他名字中的“安”字，以强调安定和稳定。
游行于周四首次宣布，定于下午 2:30 开始。从南京东路和大安公园两个地点出发，蒋介石的竞选总部。两个团体将在台北市政府外聚集集会。
负责组织蒋介石竞选活动的国民党立委李彦秀告诉中央社，蒋介石将与支持者沿着两条路线之一行走。
体育部长李洋加入沈氏车队，从内湖日出康城扩建部分出发。副总统萧美琴原定在最后一站大湖公园发表讲话。
周六，体育部长李阳（右）加入了彪马沉（左）的车队。中央通讯社照片2026年11月7日
出发前，沉向记者表示，他对李光耀的邀请与他对内湖和南港的政策建议有关，但他没有解释具体原因。
在高雄旗山区，蒋介石与国民党市长候选人柯志恩一起上台，呼吁台北与高雄加强合作。台湾人民党主席黄国昌也发声支持柯。
柯说，自高雄市县合并以来，资源分配不均，她承诺如果当选，将在上任第一个月内设立一个办公室来解决这些不平等问题。
台北市市长蒋万安（左）在南部港口城市旗山区的舞台上为其政党的高雄市长候选人柯志恩（右）竞选。中央通讯社照片2026年11月7日
民进党冈山区集会上，总统赖清德和高雄市长陈其迈现身支持市长候选人赖瑞隆。
沉在台语视频中呼吁群众鼓励台北的朋友投票给他，帮助民进党在两座城市获胜。

Taipei, Nov. 7 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an's (蔣萬安) campaign called on supporters Saturday to join a Nov. 14 march and rally, while Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) challenger Puma Shen (沈伯洋) led a campaign motorcade through two Taipei districts.
The two Taipei mayoral candidates also backed their parties' candidates at separate rallies in Kaohsiung, with Chiang appearing in person while Shen sent a prerecorded video three weeks before the Nov. 28 local elections.
At a press conference Saturday, Chiang's Kuomintang (KMT) campaign unveiled a poster for the march that played on the character "an" (安) in his name to emphasize reassurance and stability.
The march, first announced Thursday, is scheduled to start at 2:30 p.m. from two locations, Chiang's campaign headquarters on Nanjing East Road and Daan Park. The two groups will converge for a rally outside Taipei City Hall.
KMT Legislator Lee Yen-shiu (李彥秀), who oversees organizing for Chiang's campaign, told CNA that the mayor would walk with supporters along one of the two routes.
Sports Minister Lee Yang (李洋) joined Shen's motorcade, which set out from the LOHAS Park extension in Neihu. Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim (蕭美琴) was scheduled to speak at the final stop at Dahu Park.
Sports Minister Lee Yang (right) joins Puma Shen's (left) motorcade on Saturday. CNA photo Nov. 7, 2026
Before setting out, Shen told reporters that his invitation to Lee was tied to his policy proposals for Neihu and Nangang, though he did not explain how.
In Kaohsiung's Cishan District, Chiang joined KMT mayoral candidate Ko Chih-en (柯志恩) onstage and called for closer cooperation between Taipei and Kaohsiung. Taiwan People's Party Chairman Huang Kuo-chang (黃國昌) also spoke in support of Ko.
Ko said resources had been distributed unevenly since the merger of Kaohsiung City and County, and she pledged to set up an office to address those disparities within her first month in office if elected.
Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (left) campaigns for his party's Kaohsiung mayoral candidate Ko Chih-en (right) onstage in the southern port city's Cishan District. CNA photo Nov. 7, 2026
At the DPP rally in Gangshan District, President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) and Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chi-mai (陳其邁) appeared in support of mayoral candidate Lai Jui-lung (賴瑞隆).
In a video message in Taiwanese, Shen asked the crowd to encourage their friends in Taipei to vote for him and help the DPP win in both cities.
(By Chao Yen-hsiang, Sean Lin, Lin Chiao-lien and Chang Yi-lien)

巴拿马议员敦促台湾在巴拿马设立贸易办事处 - 聚焦台湾
专访/巴拿马议员敦促台湾在巴拿马设立贸易办事处
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
巴拿马议员乔纳森·维加。中央通讯社照片2026年11月6日
中新社海牙11月8日电 巴拿马议员乔纳森·维加(Jhonathan Vega)呼吁台湾在巴拿马设立贸易办事处，以加强双边关系并扩大经济合作，以期在2017年正式关系破裂后重建非正式关系。
维加在11月5日至6日于海牙举行的各国议会对华联盟（IPAC）年度峰会期间接受中央社采访时，用西班牙语表示，台湾贸易办事处将为更密切的交流提供渠道，特别是在贸易和创造就业方面。
他还强调了巴拿马运河作为国际贸易重要枢纽和国家间沟通渠道的战略作用。
2017年，巴拿马与台湾断交，转而与中国建交，并断绝了与台北的关系。此后几年直到2025年11月，巴拿马议会代表团都没有访问台湾。
此后，议员们又分别于 2026 年 2 月和 7 月进行了两次访问，这是不到一年的时间里的三次访问，一些人认为这标志着两国关系逐渐升温。
维加表示，中美洲立法者长期以来一直支持与台湾建立更密切的关系。他引用台湾的民主、领导力和技术进步（包括半导体行业）作为巴拿马立法机构支持的理由。
9月，巴拿马国民议会在71个议席中成立了由50名议员组成的跨党派议会小组，以促进与台湾立法院的交流。
当被问及台湾和巴拿马是否可能在对方领土设立代表处时，维加表示，这一决定取决于行政部门。
虽然总统何塞·劳尔·穆利诺表示保留，但维加表示，他相信情况可能会改变，并指出双方之间的贸易仍然活跃。
维加是 2025 年 11 月访问台湾的巴拿马议员之一。当被问及有关中国官员就此次访问向议员施压的报道时，他表示巴拿马是一个民主国家，将自行决定海外访问事宜。
维加还感谢台湾的邀请，表示这次访问让他有机会了解台湾，并看到巴拿马可以借鉴的发展方面。
菲律宾参议员呼吁在中国紧张局势中加强与台湾的关系
菲律宾参议员弗朗西斯·“基科”·邦吉利南呼吁台湾和菲律宾之间加强合作，称在与中国关系日益紧张的情况下，台湾和菲律宾的安全紧密相连。
伯利兹总理布里塞尼奥寻求与台湾深化合作并邀请投资
伯利兹总理约翰·布里塞尼奥呼吁通过投资、技术交流和人文联系与台湾深化合作，并表示希望这些联系将为伯利兹的发展做出贡献。
ECCT新任主席敦促台湾软件、能源领域提高灵活性
台湾以其硬件制造实力而闻名，但台湾欧盟商会（ECCT）新任主席弗兰克·格鲁纳特（Frank Grunert）也看到了软件领域的巨大潜力。

Panamanian lawmaker urges Taiwan to establish trade office in Panama - Focus Taiwan
INTERVIEW/Panamanian lawmaker urges Taiwan to establish trade office in Panama
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Panamanian lawmaker Jhonathan Vega. CNA photo Nov. 6, 2026
The Hague, Nov. 8 (CNA) Panamanian lawmaker Jhonathan Vega has called on Taiwan to establish a trade office in Panama to strengthen bilateral relations and expand economic cooperation amid attempts to rebuild informal ties following a break in formal ties in 2017.
In an interview with CNA on the sidelines of the Nov. 5-6 annual summit of the Inter-Parliamentary Alliance on China (IPAC) in The Hague, Vega said in Spanish that a Taiwan trade office would provide a channel for closer exchanges, particularly in trade and job creation.
He also highlighted the Panama Canal's strategic role as a key hub for international trade and a channel for communication among countries.
Panama switched diplomatic recognition from Taiwan to China in 2017, severing ties with Taipei. No Panamanian parliamentary delegations visited Taiwan in the years that followed until November 2025.
Since then, lawmakers have made two more visits, in February and July 2026, marking three visits in less than a year that some believe signals a gradual warming of ties.
Vega said support for closer ties with Taiwan had long existed among lawmakers in Central America. He cited Taiwan's democracy, leadership and technological advances, including in the semiconductor sector, as reasons for support in Panama's legislature.
In September, Panama's National Assembly established a cross-party parliamentary group comprised of 50 members of the 71-seat assembly to promote exchanges with Taiwan's Legislative Yuan.
Asked about the possibility of Taiwan and Panama establishing representative offices in each other's territories, Vega said the decision rested with the executive branch.
While President José Raúl Mulino had expressed reservations, Vega said he believed the situation could change, noting that trade between the two sides remained active.
Vega was among a group of Panamanian lawmakers who visited Taiwan in November 2025. Asked about reports that Chinese officials had pressured lawmakers over the visit, he said Panama was a democracy and would make its own decisions about overseas visits.
Vega also thanked Taiwan for the invitation, saying his visit had given him an opportunity to learn about the country and see aspects of its development that Panama could draw on.

东京800人集会要求立即遣返朝鲜被绑架者 - 日本时报
东京800人集会要求立即归还朝鲜被绑架者
日本首相高市早苗周日在东京千代田区的一次集会上发表讲话，要求立即归还被朝鲜绑架的受害者。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
周日在东京举行了一场全国集会，呼吁立即集体归还几十年前被朝鲜绑架的所有日本公民，约有 800 人参加，其中包括首相高市早苗。
“被绑架者的父母每天都生活在边缘，”1977 年 13 岁时被绑架到朝鲜的横田惠的弟弟横田卓也在集会上说。 “我希望大家继续与我们一起战斗，坚定决心永不放弃，直到所有被绑架者返回家园。”
58岁的拓哉是朝鲜绑架受害者家属协会会长，也是此次集会的组织者之一。
惠美90岁的母亲横田早惠是政府认定的被绑架者家属中唯一仍在等待亲人归来的父母，她说：“我感到难以形容的心痛和悲伤，因为我精心抚养的一名亲人被带走了。”
“近 50 年来，我们一直无法拯救她。我们必须继续以一颗团结的心表明，我们绝不会允许绑架问题得到解决，”Sakie 说。
49 岁的饭冢晃一郎是被绑架者田口八重子的长子，田口八重子于 1978 年被绑架，时年 22 岁。他说：“新年一开始，我母亲被绑架就已经 49 年了。我绝对不能接受让这个时间延长到 50 年。”
高一在集会上致辞时表示：“我对被绑架者至今未能回家感到非常遗憾。我决心在我的任期内取得突破，直到他们的家人能够再次拥抱亲人的那一天，我的使命才会结束。”
集会通过了一项决议，呼吁朝鲜在父辈还活着的情况下遣返所有被绑架者。

800 Rally in Tokyo to demand North Korea abductees’ immediate return - The Japan Times
800 Rally in Tokyo to demand North Korea abductees’ immediate return
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi addresses a rally in Tokyo's Chiyoda Ward on Sunday, demanding the immediate return of abduction victims held by North Korea. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
A national rally calling for the immediate and collective return of all Japanese citizens abducted by North Korea decades ago was held in Tokyo on Sunday, attended by about 800 people, including Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
“The parents of abductees are living each day on the edge,” Takuya Yokota, the younger brother of Megumi Yokota, who was abducted to North Korea in 1977 at the age of 13, said at the rally. “I want everyone to continue fighting with us with a strong determination never to give up until all abductees return home.”
Takuya, 58, is head of the Association of Families of Victims Kidnapped by North Korea and one of the organizers of the rally.
Sakie Yokota, Megumi’s 90-year-old mother, who is the only remaining parent among the families of government-recognized abductees still awaiting the return of their loved ones, said, “I feel indescribable heartache and sorrow because a family member I raised with great care was taken away.”
“For almost 50 years, we have been unable to save her. We must continue to show, with one united heart, that we will never allow the abduction issue to be left unaddressed,” Sakie said.
Koichiro Iizuka, 49, the eldest son of abductee Yaeko Taguchi, who was kidnapped in 1978 at the age of 22, said: “Once the new year begins, it will be 49 years since my mother was abducted. I absolutely cannot accept allowing that to stretch to 50 years.”
Addressing the gathering, Takaichi said: “I feel very sorry that the abductees have not yet been able to return home. I am determined to make a breakthrough during my tenure, and my mission will not end until the day their families can embrace their loved ones again.”
The rally adopted a resolution calling on North Korea to return all abductees while members of the parents’ generation are still alive.

content:
英伟达周日表示，正在对其首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋展开调查，此前黄仁勋向公司董事会承认，他与一名被美国情报部门确定为“中国间谍”的企业高管关系密切(https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/06/us/politics/chinese-spy-agency-nvidia-jensen-huang.html)。

监视显示，黄先生与这名名叫爱丽丝黄 (Alice Huang) 的女子直接向北京提供信息后，她与她的关系引起了美国政府的关注。这一揭露引发了令人不安的可能性，因为黄先生是人工智能领域最有权势的人物之一。革命以及特朗普总统的[一个有影响力的盟友](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/19/technology/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang.html)。

董事会表示，63 岁的黄先生将在调查期间继续领导公司。作为联合创始人，他在 Nvidia 建立了一个独特的结构，在该结构中，他负责公司业务的各个方面，同时监督直接向他汇报的约 60 名人员。

“今天的消息不会让英伟达放慢脚步，”该公司发言人约翰·里佐(John Rizzo)表示。 “詹森致力于继续担任首席执行官，不间断地领导英伟达。”
《纽约时报》上个月[报道](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/29/us/politics/nvidia-china-jensen-huang-trump.html)称，美国情报机构发现黄先生与一名中国公民和芯片买家建立了密切关系，美国官员断定此人正在为北京收集情报。

芯片买家是黄女士或黄乐，她曾在中国担任电视记者，后来成为一家新加坡数据中心公司的高管，该公司已成为英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一。过去两年它购买了价值 48 亿美元的芯片。

尽管《泰晤士报》去年报道称，美国商务部正在调查该公司是否帮助中国走私受限制的人工智能，但英伟达仍继续与黄女士的公司 Megaspeed 开展业务。筹码。 （黄先生与黄女士没有血缘关系。）

_这是一个正在发展的故事。请回来检查更新。_

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia said on Sunday that it was opening an investigation into Jensen Huang, its chief executive and co-founder, after he acknowledged to the company’s board that he had been intimate with a business executive who U.S. intelligence determined to [be a Chinese spy](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/06/us/politics/chinese-spy-agency-nvidia-jensen-huang.html).

Mr. Huang’s relationship with the woman, who is named Alice Huang, became a U.S. government concern after surveillance revealed that she was feeding information directly to Beijing. The revelation raised troubling possibilities because Mr. Huang is one of the most powerful figures in the A.I. revolution as well as [an influential ally](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/19/technology/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang.html) of President Trump.

Mr. Huang, 63, will continue to lead the company during the investigation, the board said. As a co-founder, he has set up a unique structure at Nvidia where he dictates all aspects of its business while overseeing some 60 people who directly report to him.

“Today’s news will not slow Nvidia,” said John Rizzo, a company spokesman. “Jensen is committed to continuing to lead Nvidia as C.E.O. without interruption.”

The New York Times [reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/29/us/politics/nvidia-china-jensen-huang-trump.html) last month that American intelligence agencies had discovered that Mr. Huang had developed a close relationship with a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, who U.S. officials concluded was gathering intelligence for Beijing.

The chip buyer was Ms. Huang or Huang Le, who worked in China as a TV reporter before becoming a top executive at a Singapore-based data center company that had become one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. It bought $4.8 billion in chips over the past two years.

Nvidia has continued doing business with Ms. Huang’s company, Megaspeed, even after [The Times reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/09/technology/nvidia-chips-china-megaspeed.html) last year that the Commerce Department was investigating whether the company was helping China smuggle restricted A.I. chips. (Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang are not related.)

zh_title: 民主党在对特朗普的“蓝色海啸”谴责中横扫美国中期选举
summary: 民主党在对特朗普的“蓝色海啸”谴责中横扫美国中期选举中国劳工公告牌，星期一，2026 年 11 月 9 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 民主党在对特朗普的“蓝色海啸”谴责中横扫美国中期选举 民主党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中赢得了国会两院的控制权，这是民意调查没有预测到的罕见壮举。这次压倒性胜利被视为对唐纳德·特朗普总统及其政策的谴责，包括伊朗战争、贸易关税和医疗削减。民主党以压倒性优势获胜，令唐纳德·特朗普总统的共和党大吃一惊。
content:
民主党在对特朗普的“蓝色海啸”谴责中横扫美国中期选举中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
民主党在对特朗普的“蓝色海啸”谴责中横扫美国中期选举
民主党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中赢得了国会两院的控制权，这是民意调查没有预测到的罕见壮举。这次压倒性胜利被视为对唐纳德·特朗普总统及其政策的谴责，包括伊朗战争、贸易关税和医疗削减。
据《标准报》迈克尔·楚加尼 (Michael Chugani) 报道，民主党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中以压倒性优势赢得国会两院控制权，令唐纳德·特朗普总统领导的共和党大吃一惊。这场被称为“蓝色海啸”的胜利席卷了倾向共和党的红色州，其中包括深红色的德克萨斯州，民主党推翻了长期担任共和党的州长，并击败了共和党参议院候选人。
选举前的民意调查显示，民主党几乎肯定会赢得众议院，并有机会赢得参议院，但没有人预测胜利的规模。一个政党在中期选举中赢得国会两院的胜利极为罕见。
报道称，这一结果对特朗普来说是羞辱性的一记耳光。民主党候选人将他不受欢迎的政策 — — 包括伊朗战争、贸易关税和医疗削减 — — 与共和党对手联系在一起。富有的捐助者、共和党游说团体和以埃隆·马斯克为首的科技大亨向共和党竞选活动投入了数十亿美元，但愤怒的选民表明他们不会允许亿万富翁购买选举。
民主党将于一月初正式控制国会。他们已明确表示，将就总统及其家人涉嫌腐败的问题举行多次国会听证会，并将盘问他的高级助手。特朗普使用了许多策略来阻止民主党中期胜利，但法院认为这些策略非法。民主党人担心他会干扰选举或声称存在欺诈行为，就像他在 2020 年总统选举中输给乔·拜登时所做的那样。
特朗普告诉多家媒体，他将接受选举结果，并在总统任期的最后两年与民主党合作。他现在是一位跛脚鸭总统，但警告说他将否决民主党通过的他不喜欢的法律。

Democrats sweep US midterms in 'blue tsunami' rebuke to Trump | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Democrats sweep US midterms in 'blue tsunami' rebuke to Trump
Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the 3 November midterm elections, a rare feat that opinion polls did not predict. The landslide victory is seen as a rebuke of President Donald Trump and his policies, including the Iran war, trade tariffs and healthcare cuts.
Democrats stunned President Donald Trump’s Republican Party by winning in a landslide to take control of both Houses of Congress in the 3 November midterm elections, according to a report by Michael Chugani in The Standard. The victory, described as a “blue tsunami”, swept across Republican-leaning red states, including deep red Texas, where Democrats ousted the longtime Republican governor and defeated a Republican Senate candidate.
Opinion polls leading up to the election had shown Democrats would almost certainly win the House of Representatives and had a chance to win the Senate, but none predicted the scale of the victory. It is extremely rare for a political party to win both Houses of Congress in midterm elections.
The outcome was a humiliating slap in the face for Trump, the report said. Democrat candidates tied his unpopular policies – including the Iran war, trade tariffs and healthcare cuts – to their Republican opponents. Wealthy donors, Republican lobby groups and tech tycoons led by Elon Musk pumped billions into Republican campaigns, but angry voters showed they would not allow billionaires to buy elections.
Democrats will formally take control of Congress in early January. They have made clear they will hold multiple Congressional hearings into alleged corruption by the president and his family, and will grill his top aides. Trump had used many manoeuvres to prevent a Democratic midterm victory, but courts dismissed them as illegal. Democrats had feared he would interfere with the elections or claim fraud, as he did when he lost the 2020 presidential election to Joe Biden.
Trump told several media outlets he will accept the election outcome and work with Democrats in his two remaining years as president. He is now a lame duck president but warned he will veto laws the Democrats pass that he does not like.

2026 年美国中期选举：对澳大利亚的影响
当选民主党参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico) 在 2026 年 11 月 3 日选举日向支持者挥手致意。他是 1988 年以来首位当选德克萨斯州参议员的民主党人。
总的来说，北京没有理由庆祝美国中期选举结果。民主党接管国会使中国的战略考量变得更加复杂，威胁到北京从唐纳德·特朗普总统日益交易性的外交政策中获得的一些优势，也许最重要的是，这表明了中国共产党宁愿世界忘记的事情：美国民主仍然有自我纠正的能力。
在解释原因之前，有两个条件是必不可少的。
首先，特朗普背离了长期以来强调联盟、民主价值观、多边机构和捍卫基于规则的国际秩序的美国传统外交政策共识，这不能仅用特朗普的个性来解释。三大结构性发展使美国外交政策的调整不可避免。
美国维持冷战后自由国际秩序的成本越来越高。美国的盟友往往过度依赖美国的安全保障，而华盛顿的国内经济和财政压力却在增加。与此同时，中国非凡的经济、工业和军事崛起从根本上改变了全球力量平衡，使得 20 世纪 90 年代的单极安排越来越不可持续。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰加剧了这两个问题，给华盛顿带来了额外的安全负担，同时暴露了维持国际规则以对抗顽固的修正主义国家的困难。
美国必须做出调整。如果没有特朗普，这种调整可能会更加渐进地进行，理想情况下，随着旧秩序的演变，新的机构和责任会出现。相反，我们正在经历一个国际混乱的危险时期，既定规则的崩溃速度快于替代规则的建立速度。即使特朗普卸任后，美国外交政策也不可能也不应该完全回到特朗普上台前的状态。
第二个资格涉及总统权力。特朗普将继续担任总统两年。美国总统在外交事务上享有相当大的权力，与国内政策制定相比，美国总统通常面临的国会限制更少。民主党国会不能简单地扭转特朗普的对华外交政策，尽管它可以通过立法和预算、加强监督并改变政治激励措施。因此，与立即的战略逆转相比，任何变化都更有可能产生边际后果。
尽管如此，北京有充分的理由看待中期结果

On balance, Beijing has little reason to celebrate the United States’ midterm election results. The Democratic takeover of Congress complicates China’s strategic calculations, threatens some of the advantages Beijing has gained from President Donald Trump’s increasingly transactional foreign policy, and, perhaps most importantly, demonstrates something the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) would rather the world forget: U.S. democracy retains the capacity to correct itself.
Before explaining why, two qualifications are essential.
The first is that Trump’s departure from the traditional U.S. foreign policy consensus – which has long emphasized alliances, democratic values, multilateral institutions, and the defense of a rules-based international order – cannot be explained by Trump’s personality alone. Three structural developments have made an adjustment in U.S. foreign policy unavoidable.
The post-Cold War liberal international order has become increasingly expensive for the United States to maintain. U.S. allies have often depended excessively on U.S. security guarantees, while Washington’s domestic economic and fiscal pressures have grown. Meanwhile, China’s extraordinary economic, industrial, and military rise has fundamentally altered the global balance of power, making the unipolar arrangements of the 1990s increasingly unsustainable. Russia’s invasion of Ukraine has exacerbated both problems, imposing additional security burdens on Washington while exposing the difficulty of maintaining international rules against determined revisionist powers.
The United States must adjust. Without Trump, that adjustment might have occurred more gradually, ideally allowing new institutions and responsibilities to emerge as the old order evolved. Instead, we are experiencing a dangerous period of international disorder in which established rules are breaking down faster than replacements can be constructed. Even after Trump leaves office, U.S. foreign policy neither can nor should return entirely to its pre-Trump form.
The second qualification concerns presidential power. Trump remains president for another two years. U.S. presidents enjoy considerable authority over foreign affairs, generally facing fewer congressional constraints than in domestic policymaking. A Democratic Congress cannot simply reverse Trump’s diplomacy with China, although it can pass legislation and budgets, increase oversight, and change political incentives. Any change is therefore more likely to be consequential at the margins than an immediate strategic reversal.
Nevertheless, Beijing has good reasons to view the midterm results with concern.
China prefers a transactional U.S. president to one guided by enduring principles and institutional commitments. During his first term, Trump surprised Beijing by launching a trade war that challenged decades of U.S. economic engagement. Chinese leaders initially struggled to understand his methods. Over time, however, Trump’s transactionalism became more pronounced, and Beijing learned to negotiate with him.
Trump has embraced the G2 language, signaling recognition of China as the United States’ principal peer competitor. He has treated Taiwan increasingly as a bargaining instrument, including through delays in arms sales. And he has accepted the language of “constructive strategic stability” advanced by Xi Jinping, opening the possibility of an understanding that prioritizes bilateral accommodation over traditional U.S. commitments.
Beijing recognizes the advantages of this approach. On November 2, the day before the midterms, the South China Morning Post, owned by Chinese conglomerate Alibaba Group, published an article titled “Will ‘strategic stability’ with China go out the window if Trump loses the midterms?” It warned that a Republican loss of the House could test the emerging strategic-stability framework. Yet it also expressed confidence that Trump would continue trying to stabilize relations with Beijing. The concern is revealing. Beijing has learned to work with Trump’s approach and would prefer that it remain largely undisturbed.
Congressional pressure could let values retake a place in U.S. China policy. It could also make Taiwan’s security less vulnerable to presidential bargaining. U.S. policy would remain pragmatic, but democratic values would be harder to exclude from relations with China.
Congress could also encourage the repair of the United States’ relationships with allies in Europe, North America, and the Indo-Pacific. Stronger cooperation with Canada, European democracies, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and other partners would reinforce the democratic world’s collective economic, technological, and military strength. Beijing benefits when Washington quarrels with its allies; it faces greater constraints when they coordinate.
The Iran war presents another consideration. Stronger congressional oversight could increase pressure to end the conflict sooner. China has little reason to welcome an early U.S. disengagement from a war that consumes Washington’s military resources, financial capacity, diplomatic attention, and political energy. A prolonged conflict distracts Washington from the Indo-Pacific and its strategic competition with China.
Advanced semiconductor exports provide an especially revealing example of where Congress could make a difference. Despite substantial bipartisan support for restricting China’s access to sensitive U.S. technology, Trump permitted sales of certain advanced Nvidia chips, including the H200, while retaining restrictions on the most sophisticated products. His administration connected these transactions to financial returns for the United States.
Republican congressional majorities had largely avoided directly confronting Trump’s decisions, despite objections from some China hawks. A Democratic Congress could be considerably more assertive, using hearings, legislation, and budgetary authority to tighten export restrictions. Beijing would certainly prefer fewer such constraints.
Trump’s second administration has generated serious controversies over executive power, the Iran war, sweeping tariffs, allegations of corruption and conflicts of interest, the handling of Epstein-related records, and the politicization of law enforcement. Critics see these developments as threats to constitutional government, the separation of powers, and the rule of law. These concerns deserve scrutiny through democratic institutions, with allegations distinguished from established wrongdoing.
As someone who has devoted much of his life to advancing democracy and human rights, I am particularly sensitive to democratic deterioration. I have heard from compatriots inside China that U.S. democracy has lost considerable appeal. Some friends have even joked that China’s official Xinhua News Agency no longer needs to fabricate negative stories about Washington. Its propagandists need only translate U.S. news reports. That observation contains a painful truth. The United Sates’ democratic weaknesses have provided authoritarian propaganda with powerful material.
Yet the midterm elections demonstrate something Beijing’s propagandists cannot easily explain away. Americans dissatisfied with their government’s direction have used the ballot box to change the balance of political power. The midterm elections created new opportunities for oversight and constitutional checks on the presidency.
On specific policy issues, one may agree or disagree with the voters who produced this outcome. That is not the essential point. The essential point is that U.S. democracy works. It retains the capacity to recognize mistakes, restrain power, and correct its course peacefully.
For Beijing, this is not a welcome result at all. A divided U.S. government can complicate Trump’s transactional diplomacy. A united democratic alliance can constrain China’s geopolitical ambitions. But a self-correcting U.S. democracy challenges something more fundamental: the CCP’s claim that authoritarian governance offers a superior political model.

专家：央行在遏制台币波动方面面临问题 - 聚焦台湾
专家：央行在遏制台币波动方面面临问题
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月7日电 市场专家表示，由于外国机构投资者持有大量新台币资产，如果外国投资者继续将资金转移出中国，央行在稳定新台币方面将面临挑战。
国泰世华银行首席经济学家林启超本周早些时候接受中央社采访时表示，随着本地证券交易所规模的扩大，外国机构投资者在本地市场资本中所占的份额已显示出增加的迹象。
政府数据显示，它们在当地市值中的份额从 2024 年底的 43% 上升到 10 月初的近 50%。
此次上涨恰逢台湾证券交易所基准指数从 2025 年 1 月的 23,000 点左右上涨至 10 月 6 日的历史盘中高点 49,968.92 点。
然而，由于担心美国人工智能数据中心的发展可能受到限制，台交所周五下跌1,873.08点，即4.51%，收于39,701.64点，自10月6日以来，该指数已下跌约10,267点，即20.55%。
林说，外国机构投资者在面临股市波动加剧时往往会调整投资组合，由于涉及资金量大，使得央行的工作变得更加困难。
据央行统计，截至10月底，外国投资者持有台湾上市股票、债券和新台币存款1.743万亿美元，相当于台湾外汇储备总额的292%。
林说：“随着他们持有的本地资产不断增加，即使他们只减持1%并将收益转移到海外，央行也将比以往任何时候都更难维持台币的稳定。”
截至10月底，新台币兑美元在2026年已贬值3.2%，并且这种疲软状态一直持续到11月。
周五上午，在股市大幅抛售的影响下，新台币兑美元汇率进一步走弱至新台币33.04元，下午大幅反弹，收于新台币32.768元。
外汇交易商表示，反弹是由于央行干预以及台湾出口商将美元收入兑换成当地货币。
受央行市场干预影响，10月末外汇储备跌破6000亿美元大关，至5964.4亿美元，环比减少43.1亿美元。
央行还表示，10月份境外机构投资者资本净流出约280亿美元。
林说，面对大量资本外流，央行不能仅仅依靠外汇储备作为支撑台币的工具，因为持续的市场干预可能会付出高昂的代价。
他表示，央行需要继续鼓励台湾出口商在暂时不需要外币的情况下将持有的美元兑换成新台币，以帮助缓解本币贬值的压力。
与1-10月期间韩元兑美元升值8.38%相比，台币升值幅度较大。
