content:
本周末依然有不少法国民众在巴黎等地抗议高昂生活成本、教育系统积弊等问题图像来源: Stephanie Lecocq/REUTERS
（德国之声中文网）法国多地民众本周末再次响应工会、青年组织、“黄马甲运动”发出的抗议号召。根据组织者的说法，全国共有25万人参加了11月7日的抗议活动；而法国内政部公布的数据则为14.6万人。而在上周六，抗议人数规模在32万至50万人。11月5日（周四）的罢工示威活动也有约60万人参加（内政部数据）。
在巴黎市中心，警方动用催泪弹试图驱散在禁止示威区域聚集的抗议者图像来源: Geoffroy Van Der Hasselt/AFP
法国内政部表示，在图卢兹、马赛、里昂、波尔多和斯特拉斯堡等主要城市，集会过程中出现了动荡及各类事件。在巴黎，游行本身保持了和平，但傍晚时分局势趋于紧张；现场画面显示出现了催泪瓦斯烟雾和火光。内政部报告称全国共有200余人被捕。
为保护市中心区域，多个城市都在部分街区实施示威禁令。比如在第二大城市里昂，据媒体报道，民众在未经官方许可的情况下聚集抗议，警方随即动用了催泪瓦斯。
在巴黎，“黄马甲运动”原计划举行的一场集会被禁止，而由工会组织的一场示威活动则获准进行。尽管如此，在“黄马甲运动”发出行动号召后，仍有不少人聚集在市中心的协和广场。据法国媒体报道，两名“黄马甲运动”的协调员在巴黎被捕。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
法国民众正在抗议高昂生活成本、教育系统积弊等多项议题。法国全国学生联合会(UNEF)秘书长莫雷(Manon Moret)表示，年轻人依然态度坚决且感到愤怒，并指出政府未能回应他们的诉求。
法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼(Lecornu)计划在11月9日与工会及雇主协会举行一场社会议题会议，并和中学生、大学生代表进行磋商。此外，11月10日也有计划举行进一步的抗议活动。

在欧盟释放信号，表示愿意让加拿大以“准成员”身份成为其特殊伙伴后，美国总统特朗普对此发出嘲讽，并表示，这一设想属于“敌对行为”。
周一，中共为前总书记江泽民举行百岁冥诞纪念大会。周二，前总理朱镕基的遗体在八宝山公墓火化，天安门等地降半旗致哀。江泽民与朱镕基留给习近平怎样的遗产？习近平能否借助已经逝去的时代安抚当下的民心，进一步巩固自己的权力？
德国30多个城市周六举行青年抗议活动，数万名年轻人借此表达对教育资源、生活成本及环境保护等问题的不满。然而，原本大体和平的示威活动在晚间演变为多地暴力骚乱。
意大利数万学生和工人上街，要求增加教育经费、缓解生活成本压力。

title: III MEF Extends Curfew for Junior Members in Okinawa Following Murder Indictment
zh_title: III MEF 在谋杀案起诉后延长冲绳初级成员的宵禁
summary: 2026 年 10 月 31 日，美国军人、冲绳县警察和酒吧老板在冲绳市 Koza Gate 街进行联合巡逻，以促进负责任的基地外行为并加强与当地社区的关系。 III MEF 照片 美国军方延长了原定于周日到期的冲绳初级军人宵禁，并继续对购买和消费酒精实施限制。据报道，E-1至E-4年级的宵禁延长了30天，并限制他们在凌晨12点至凌晨5点呆在自己的私人住宅内。
content:
2026 年 10 月 31 日，美国军人、冲绳县警察和酒吧老板在冲绳市 Koza Gate 街进行联合巡逻，以促进负责任的基地外行为并加强与当地社区的关系。 III MEF 照片 美国军方延长了原定于周日到期的冲绳初级军人宵禁，并继续对购买和消费酒精实施限制。根据美国海军陆战队第三远征军 (MEF) 周四发布的新闻稿，E-1 至 E-4 级人员的宵禁延长了 30 天，并从上午 12 点到凌晨 5 点限制他们呆在个人住房内。宵禁此前曾针对较高级别人员实施，但后来被取消。但是，午夜后禁止所有人员在主要住所外购买或饮用酒精饮料。一名被指控在冲绳那霸抢劫并杀害一名妇女的海军陆战队员被捕，导致行动暂停 48 小时，随后于 10 月 8 日实施宵禁。该海军陆战队队员于 10 月 25 日被起诉。服务新闻稿中写道，在经过详细分析以及联合和跨机构领导人的反馈后，第三海军陆战队远征部队选择延长宵禁。本杰明·T·中将
第三远征军司令兼冲绳地区协调员沃森会见了冲绳地区协调委员会的代表，讨论了降低整个部队风险的前进方向，并在日本驻日美军的同意下发布了更新后的自由指南。该指南涵盖的时期为11月8日至12月。 7. 指挥官保留在条件允许时在各自指挥范围内制定更具限制性的自由政策的能力，并鼓励指挥官向部队明确传达这些决定。 2026 年 10 月 6 日，美国海军陆战队中将、第三海军陆战远征军司令本杰明·T·沃森（中右）在日本冲绳考特尼营举行的参谋会议上与主要领导人发表讲话。沃森向第三海军陆战队远征军领导人发表讲话，强调了海军陆战队的核心价值观以及他对整个部队的标准、纪律和问责制的期望。指导意见中写道：“在未来几周内，冲绳地区协调员将把反思期间制定的更广泛的评估结果和建议转发给驻日美军供考虑。”更新后的自由准则恰逢周六宵禁期间冲绳一名海军陆战队员因涉嫌酒后驾车被捕，这引发了对美军确保冲绳人员纪律的批评。
日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎在周一的新闻发布会上被问到时表示，日本防卫省已要求美国确保其人员严格纪律，采取有效措施防止再次发生，并严格执行夜间宵禁。根据文字记录，小泉表示：“我希望他们认真对待这段反思期间发生的事情，彻底执行纪律，确保此类事件不再发生。”日本防卫大臣表示，美国和日本官员正在讨论如何采取措施防止事件发生。 “我们的目的是尽快得出结论、公布并付诸行动。我们将继续与美方密切合作，彻底解决此事。”

【原文 English Original】
U.S. service members, Okinawa Prefectural Police officers and bar owners conducted a joint patrol at Koza Gate Street in Okinawa City to promote responsible off-base conduct and strengthen relationships with the local community on Oct. 31, 2026. III MEF photo The U.S. military extended a curfew on Okinawa for junior service members that was scheduled to expire on Sunday and is continuing to impose restrictions on the purchase and consumption of alcohol. The curfew for grades E-1 through E-4 was extended for 30 days and restricts them to their personal housing from 12 a.m. to 5 a.m., according to a Thursday news release from the III Marine Expeditionary Force (MEF). The curfew was previously in place for higher grade personnel but was lifted. However, all personnel are prohibited from the purchase or consumption of alcohol outside of their primary residence after midnight. The curfew was implemented on Oct. 8 following a 48-hour operational pause in response to the arrest of a Marine accused in the robbery and death of a woman in Naha, Okinawa. The Marine was indicted on the charges on Oct. 25. The III MEF opted to extend the curfew following a detailed analysis and feedback from joint and interagency leaders, reads the service release. Lt. Gen. Benjamin T. Watson, commanding general of III MEF and Okinawa Area Coordinator, met with representatives from the Okinawa Area Coordinating Committee to discuss the way forward to reduce risk across the force, and with concurrence from U.S. Forces Japan issued the updated liberty guidance. The guidance covers a period from Nov. 8-Dec. 7. Commanders retain the ability to establish more restrictive liberty policies within their respective commands when conditions warrant and are encouraged to clearly communicate those decisions to the force. U.S. Marine Corps Lt. Gen. Benjamin T. Watson, center-right, the commanding general of III Marine Expeditionary Force, speaks with key leaders during a staff meeting on Camp Courtney, Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 6, 2026. Watson addressed III MEF leaders, reinforcing the Marine Corps’ core values and his expectations for standards, discipline, and accountability across the force. US Marine Corps photo “In the coming weeks, the Okinawa Area Coordinator will forward the results of the broader assessment and recommendations developed during the Period of Reflection to U.S. Forces Japan for consideration,” reads the guidance. The updated liberty guidelines coincide with the Saturday arrest of a Marine in Okinawa during the curfew hours on suspicion of drunk driving, which has prompted criticism of the U.S. military’s efforts on ensuring personnel discipline in Okinawa. Japan Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi, when asked in a Monday press conference, said that his Ministry have requested that the U.S. to ensure strict discipline among its personnel, implement effective measures to prevent a recurrence and strictly enforce the nighttime curfew. “I want them to take seriously what happened during this period of reflection and to thoroughly enforce discipline and ensure that such incidents do not recur,” said Koizumi, according to a transcript . U.S. and Japanese officials are in discussions on how to implement measures to prevent incidents from occurring, the Japanese Defense Minister said. “Our intention is to reach conclusions as soon as possible, announce them and put them into action. We will continue to work closely with the U.S. side to thoroughly address this matter,” said Koizumi. For exercise Keen Sword, which ran from Oct. 19-29, the municipal authorities of Yonaguni Island and Ishigaki Island requested the Japan Ministry of Defense to ensure U.S. military personnel carrying out training on their islands during Keen Sword were restricted to the training areas, not allowed liberty, prohibited from consuming alcohol and when moving through civilian areas were accompanied by Japan Self-Defense Force personnel, according to documents posted on municipal government website. Japan Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has also made it a priority to address the issues surrounding the U.S. presence in Okinawa. “Even now, more than 80 years after the end of the war, Okinawa Prefecture still has a large concentration of U.S. military facilities and areas and we take seriously the heavy burden of these bases that the people of Okinawa bear. What is important is to steadily produce results one by one, and we will do our utmost to realize a reduction of the base burden in Okinawa in a tangible way,” the Japanese Prime Minister said during the Okinawa Policy Council meeting on Friday . Friday’s meeting was the first one held in 13 years, which saw Takaichi and her cabinet ministers meeting with Okinawa Governor Genta Koja and prefectural officials to discuss matters pertaining to the island, which included the U.S. military presence as well as economic and development issues. In a Friday post on X , Koja outlined his request in regard to the U.S. military presence in Okinawa. “Regarding the reduction of the burden related to military bases, we called for the removal of the dangers posed by Futenma Air Station as soon as possible, the establishment of a clear timeline for its return, the prevention of any recurrence of incidents involving U.S. military personnel and a fundamental review of the Japan-U.S. Status of Forces Agreement,” reads the post. In his regularly scheduled press conference on Friday , Koizumi said he told Koja that the MOD would take the governor’s request seriously and do its utmost to reduce the burden of U.S. military bases on Okinawa. “The Ministry of Defense will promptly consider what kind of response is possible based on the requests received today,” said Koizumi.

content:
2024年9月4日，巴布亚新几内亚首都莫尔兹比港一家购物中心外的标牌。
最近一个星期，中国与南太平洋岛国巴布亚新几内亚(巴新)因为一件酷似爆炸物的不明物体而引发一场外交风波。中国驻巴新大使馆称那是一个酒瓶，而巴新警方及军方坚持认为那是一枚未引爆的炮弹。
10月30日，有人在巴新首都莫尔兹比港的一个商用集装箱内，发现一枚重达32公斤的军绿色圆柱体物品。警方和军方爆炸物专家到场将这枚看似炮弹的物体妥善控制，并将其带走进行分析研究。
根据澳大利亚广播公司(ABC)的报道，巴新爆炸物专家星期二证实，藏匿在商用集装箱内的不明物体实际上是一枚未引爆的中国产五九式130毫米加农炮的炮弹，而且弹体内装填了化学炸药和引信。
同一天，中国驻巴新大使馆在社交媒体上X发表声明，否认不明物体是一枚未爆炮弹。
“据相关公司反馈，经现场核实，此前被报道为‘炮弹’的物体，实际上是一个炮弹形状的酒瓶，它完全不构成任何危险。”
星期五，中国驻巴新大使馆在X平台重新将这份声明再贴了一遍。
中国大使馆还试图淡化中国制造的军用武器被非法运入巴布亚新几内亚的可能性，声称鉴于中国严格的枪支管制法律，“非法将军用级炮弹从中国走私到巴布亚新几内亚，几乎是不可能的”。
59式130毫米加农炮是中国在1959年仿制苏制 M-46型130毫米加农炮研制成功的一款主力野战加农炮，主要用于杀伤敌方有生力量、摧毁防御工事、反坦克作战或压制敌方炮兵群。
不过，随着2012年中国军队体制编制调整，大部分传统的59式牵引加农炮已从一线精锐部队退役，部分转入封存、民兵预备役或移交至沿海的海防/岸防部队管理与使用。
巴新媒体《信使邮报》(Post-Courier)上星期五率先报道了此事。报道说，该不明物体是在一个建筑工地的集装箱内、建筑材料之间被发现的。
巴新警察局长戴维·曼宁(David Manning)称，警方与军方随后展开了联合调查，并排除了该物体可能是用于训练的“模拟弹”（假弹）的说法。
“警方在接到发现炮弹的消息后迅速采取了行动。相关区域已被封锁，以防对周边地区造成危害，”《每日电讯报》援引曼宁的话说。“这使得警方和军方的爆炸物处置专家得以进入现场，对该装置进行检查，并将其安全转移至一处稳妥的设施内进行存放。”
巴新警方尚未就中国大使馆提出的说法作出回应。不过，一些网民社交媒体上对中方的说法提出了质疑。
目前与此案有关而被捕的中国公民仍被扣押在莫尔兹比港。
近年来，中国持续扩大与包括巴新在内的南太平洋岛国之间的政治、经济和安全关系，不仅推动所罗门群岛与台湾断交，而且还与其签署了一份秘密安全协议。其他与台湾断交并与北京建交的南太国家还有瑙鲁和基里巴斯。
北京在南太平洋岛国扩充影响力的行为，引起美国、澳大利亚、新西兰等国的警觉。
针对此次中国“酒瓶与炮弹”事件，美国驻莫尔斯比港大使馆也在社媒X平台上发表评论说，美国国防官员与负责检查该物品的巴布亚新几内亚爆炸物处理小组进行了直接对接。
“这是一起严重的公共安全事件。巴布亚新几内亚人民有权获得准确的信息，并应进行彻底的调查，”美国大使馆的声明说。
“我们赞赏巴布亚新几内亚警方及国防人员所采取的应对行动，”美方声明又说，“美国与巴布亚新几内亚站在一起，共同维护其人民安全、国家安全及主权。”

content: 2026年9月初，黃之鋒勾結外國勢力案定罪當天，移居英國的攝影記者 Peter Wong 終於打開電腦硬盤內，拍攝學民思潮的舊照片。 與黃之鋒同年、30歲的Peter是攝影師，也曾是學民思潮成員，他在14年前記錄了學民初始誕生的面貌。那是他攝影的起點，也是黃之鋒一代中學生，投身香港社會運動的起點。14年間，他由一個喜歡拍攝的中學生變成攝影記者；同時間，黃之鋒由一個關心社會、國際知名的中學生踏入30歲，變成國安法下被定罪判囚10年的囚犯。 在黃之鋒被判刑的一天，回望14年前「學民思潮」的橙色直幡，它們烙在菲林與像素之間，留下了近十年香港年輕社運參與者的身影。 請他為這輯影像命名，他回答：「Hi Joshua Wong, I hope you are fine」。 2015年12月4日，我不記得是什麼源起，15年我在大學有一份功課我選擇了跟拍黃子悅，這裡是學民思潮第二個會址。攝影：Peter Wong 一個攝影記者的起點 2012年夏天，中四學生 Peter 在 YouTube 看到另一個中四學生黃之鋒對答如流的 訪問 短片。 短片中，黃之鋒以學民思潮召集人的身份接受訪問，反對政府設立「德育及國民教育科」為中小學必修課。短片在兩日間爆紅，在網絡突破10萬點擊率，也是這一條短片吸引 Peter 加入學民思潮。 「當時社會比較思潮起動，就像『民智初開』，別人是大學生太遠，我才中四，中學生（組織）好像近一點。」他說。 學民思潮最初是由「九十後動員」鍾曉晴、兩名直資中學滙基書院學生黃之鋒與林朗彥，於2011年一起創立的反國民教育學生聯盟。翌年，聯盟簡化名字為學民思潮，連英文名「Scholarism」也是由黃之鋒 造字創立 。 十年後再聚：獄中黃之鋒和一代學民的成長 投放青春參與的社會運動時光愈來愈遠，年輕社運參與者的過去，亦不斷消散解體。在「無」之中，還可以怎樣自處？ 就在這個平台，Peter 遇上黃之鋒，許多政治想法相近的年輕人相遇了。Peter 覺得，當時學民思潮聚集的是一班不被主流教育制度完全擁抱的中學生。 很快，這群中學生行動起來——反國教的學民十區街站，從銅鑼灣鵝頸橋、旺角行人專用區，擺到將軍澳、屯門、荃灣。 Peter 記得，當時學民的氣勢與活動密集程度，就像同時期的立法會選舉。他自嘲參與程度不高，因為他忙著在校內籌組中學學生會、玩口琴，一星期只有兩、三天會隨伙伴一起擺街站。有一次，黃之鋒要上教會，Peter先到對方海怡半島的家，幫忙把傳單與橙色直幡帶去街站。 2012年6月，旺角行人專用區的街站；那時沉迷菲林，應該是一隻過期的Kodak Royal Gold 菲林。攝影：Peter Wong 拿著父母剛買給他的 Nikon 單反相機，Peter 與黃之鋒另一個交集，是拍攝記錄同樣喜歡拍照的黃之鋒。一整個夏天，黃之鋒全情投身了學民思潮，從街站、電台訪問、城市論壇，再到公民廣場的9萬人面前。 鏡頭下的黃之鋒影像逐漸鮮活起來：仍一臉稚氣的黃之鋒在已不復在的立法會示威區鐵馬前與保安對峙；黃之鋒在學民辦公室戴上道具眼鏡玩耍，露出自然的微笑；黃之鋒站在陽光下一邊思考，一邊用力吸啜紙包飲品。 相對於當年傳媒和黃之鋒自己共同建構的學生領袖形象，這些影像顯得新鮮而質樸。14年後重看這些照片，Peter知道這是自己當年有意或無意記錄黃之鋒的起點，「自己如果那時多影一些，現在就會很有用了。」那是初踏政壇、仍沒成年的黃之鋒與同齡朋友相處的畫面，鏡頭錯過了就沒有。 90後一代眼中的可能性 回望過去，人生第一次有自主意識參與社會運動的時刻，對 Peter 仍舊具有重量。 「認識貧富差距算不算？」Peter 在港島屋邨 Band 3中學讀書，中學成績不算好。學民思潮完全突破他的生活圈子與慣常認知：有中學生家住半山區、讀國際學校，後來早早出國升學；也有人家住新界公屋，文憑試後留在香港讀大學。這個中學生組織讓他眼界大開，大至一班人聚在一起談Game Theory，小至一起聽本地獨立樂隊my little airport的音樂，不同原石的光折射進Peter的生活。 2012年，黃之鋒在已停刊的《壹週刊》訪問裡，如此總結他們一代年輕人的想法：「我們沒有目睹八九六四，○三七一時是小學雞。但一場反國教，我們和所有香港人都覺醒。⋯⋯八十後追逐香港社區情懷。但當我們九十後懂性時，香港已沒有什麼餘下。我們沒有背負香港的歷史，我們，是來創造歷史。」 可能性是他們本身，也是2010年代的他們所看見的未來。 2012年暑假的《黑紙》。 數年間，香港社會思潮起動，學民思潮縱然是一些年輕人的起點，但也僅是百家爭鳴時代的其中一家。尤其學民最初為關注單一議題組織，當成功爭取擱置國教科後，成員和義工各自為著升學、理念分歧、甚或組織內的派系不同，決定去或留。有人升讀大學後加入院校學生會成為學聯一份子，有人走向更「本土」的組織，也有人加入社民連，形形式式的選項曾經存在。 雨傘運動前，Peter 也因忙於考試、升學，在2014年7月離開學民思潮。「它作為一個春秋戰國時期，尚且比較自由的時期，就好像『做乜都無事』的時空入面存在。」 之後，Peter 在大學裡學習新聞攝影。他想換一個身份去觀察社會變化與人類的走向。他多年沒有向新認識的人提起自己「學民仔」的身份。 「我也是個普通人，也不認為有title有什麼特別。而我又開始有新的事情要去做。」他說。不僅是他，當時的年輕一代，都各自有事要做。 昔日在學民認識的朋友活躍於社運現場，變成他鏡頭攝下的對象。「黃之鋒」是他大學二年級拍攝人像功課的素材，題目是「參與雨傘運動的學生」。2016年，大學生黃之鋒與部分學民思潮、學聯成員創黨成立「香港眾志」，走入參政路。 在Peter心中，2016年是對香港重要的一年：香港出現主權移交以來的首次「暴動」，首次有立法會參選人被DQ（取消參選資格）。「2016年是承載所有事情的起點。」 當時對攝影記者抱有無限憧憬的Peter開始想像，自己會不會像著名攝影師Pete Souza跟拍奧巴馬8年一樣，能持續追縱一個未來立法會議員的成長？ 2012年9月7日，可能我當日入黑後才到，人很多，我看我硬碟內的相底，只有27張，我不太記得發生了什麼。攝影：Peter Wong 打開封塵記憶 反修例運動後，香港社會經歷大規模的移民潮，Peter的家人決定移民英國。父母問他，我們想移民了，你有沒有什麼打算？Peter 當下近乎不加思索：「去啊，我都去啦。」他覺得，自己不過20來歲，他還想見識一下世界。 倒數離港的那段日子，他仍透過鏡頭追蹤著黃之鋒，直至他入獄，因民主派初選案再次被控。 Peter 最後與黃之鋒有關的攝影工作，是爬上九龍荔枝角的山頭，用長鏡拍攝從收押所走入囚車的黃之鋒。Peter本身有畏高症，但他向公司自薦爬上山頭，拍攝準備上庭的黃之鋒。 由組織到行業，建構身份的一切逐一瓦解，當年的中學生早已離「學生」身份遠遠，各自在新的時空建立自己的腳下未來。 判詞速讀：黃之鋒涉勾結外國勢力罪判囚10年，官指與羅冠聰同屬主腦 如今加控及判刑，黃之鋒須服刑至2036年，出獄時他或約已40歲。 2026年，黃之鋒在獄中面對再多10年以上的監禁。學民思潮的眾人，或散落在旁聽席、法庭，或遠離政治，甚至身處海外。Peter數過當年參加過學民思潮、如今身處英國的人應能坐滿兩桌，而加拿大也應該有7、8人。逐漸在英國紮根的他，放下全職攝影新聞的生活，偶有接案香港新聞的攝影工作。 現實逐漸沖淡了他成為Pete Souza的想像，他也很多年沒有提及自己的中學回憶。「阿叔我都30歲人，也沒理由總是強調自己少時參與學生運動，當年參與也不是很多。」 2012年12月21日，那時人們想說2012會有世界末日，有電影災難片，學民思潮舉行了一個末日倒數街站，那時氣氛比較輕鬆。攝影：Peter Wong 但是，黃之鋒被定罪、被判刑，還是讓他內心泛起漣漪。9月初，他把硬盤內青澀的影像上傳到Instagram。老朋友看後對他說，這是文物庫級別的歷史存檔。 Peter說那不過是成長後透過相片話當年的感覺。學民思潮當年帶給他的震撼與充權的感受很強大，以至往後他當攝影記者時，也會覺得自己已退後一步，是做一個社會觀察，用旁觀者的身份去寫一份紀錄。 30歲的他，在短短的訪問裡不斷形容自己已經是「阿叔」。與2019年投身社會運動的一代相比，他常常自覺是個老人」，重看這批學民舊照，「有種在Wikipedia回望高山大會的感覺。」他說。 （按：高山大會是香港民主派團體在1986年假高山劇場合辦的民主集會，商討香港未來政制） 學民思潮對他而言的意義，是擁有一班一輩子的朋友，即使已經過了10多年，即使彼此不再常見。 圖片故事：學民思潮成人禮 學民思潮停運，即將組成新參政團體，這群90後學生在政治運動中走過怎樣的成人禮？未來又可能給香港政治帶來什麼新想像？ 遙遠的起點與今天的關係，30歲的Peter仍然未有明確的答案。他覺得要不是這次判刑，他也不會打開那些封塵的檔案。「以前的事，我從來也沒有梳理過。當我回看舊時，可能會找到新的東西。」 2012年8月14日，到各政黨詢問對國民教育科獨立成科立場，最近看舊文才回想起，應該大約差不多時間，或再數兩三個星期，學民思潮中真的有組成一個攝影組。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年10月1日清晨，我記得那天很早，這張相片，看相機的時間是7:51，印象中應該是學民思潮首次十月一日示威，應該是港灣道的M記出發。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年9月8日金鐘，佔領政總抗議行動的周末；現在回想有點後悔，那時應該用相機多拍多一點相。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年9月1日，記得那年的開學日應該不是9月1日，是過多一兩日。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年9月3日，廣場上的集會。攝影：Peter Wong 2014年1月29日，維園年宵，學民思潮第一次參與，推出了T恤，好像還有Tote Bag。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年5月27日，六四遊行，這次是我第一次參與學民思潮的活動。攝影：Peter Wong

content:
香港前 9 个月记录了超过 21,000 起科技犯罪；攻击中使用的人工智能 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港前 9 个月记录了超过 21,000 起科技犯罪；攻击中使用的人工智能
2026年前9个月，香港警方报告了超过21,000起科技犯罪案件，损失约38亿港元。网络威胁同比增长 32%，犯罪分子利用人工智能进行自动化攻击。当局敦促企业和个人修补漏洞
2026 年 11 月 9 日，香港时间 00:12 · 更新于 11 月 9 日，04:25 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
香港警方在2026年前9个月共录得超过21,000起科技犯罪案件，较去年同期减少近12%。财务损失总额约38亿港元，同比减少约15%。不过，警方表示，案件数量和损失金额仍处于较高水平，令人担忧。
同期，警方侦破针对香港的网络威胁情报130万项，同比增长约32%。这相当于平均每天产生 4,650 条网络情报。
网络安全及科技罪案调查科主管高级警司林卓豪表示，近来犯罪分子利用人工智能全天候监控平台或机构的漏洞。他们还自动化了一些攻击步骤，使他们的攻击更加有效。
警方发现，许多组织对威胁反应缓慢，未能监控第三方供应商的网络安全。各级各类企业和个人要保持警惕，及时修复漏洞，更新系统，加强异常行为监测，切忌自满。
今年前九个月，警方与多个组织和互联网服务提供商合作，修复了超过 44,000 个高风险网络安全漏洞，消除了超过 63,000 个在线威胁。通过情报分析，警方发现 65 所学校使用过时的防火墙，部分设备暴露在互联网上，使学校容易受到黑客入侵和恶意软件的攻击，这些恶意软件可能会将学校服务器变成僵尸网络的一部分。警方主动联系学校并提供技术支持。
早些时候，国际刑警组织在香港警方的技术支持下进行了首次由人工智能主导的跨国网络行动，称为“协同行动”。此次行动删除或屏蔽了超过 51,000 个恶意网站。第二阶段“协同行动2.0”已经启动，并将把参与范围扩大到24个司法管辖区。

Hong Kong records over 21,000 tech crimes in first nine months; AI used in attacks | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong records over 21,000 tech crimes in first nine months; AI used in attacks
Hong Kong police reported over 21,000 tech crime cases in the first nine months of 2026, with losses of about HK$3.8 billion. Network threats rose 32 per cent year-on-year, with criminals using artificial intelligence to automate attacks. Authorities urged businesses and individuals to patch vulnera
9 Nov 2026 at 00:12 HKT · updated 9 Nov, 04:25 · 2 min read
Hong Kong police recorded more than 21,000 technology crime cases in the first nine months of 2026, a decrease of nearly 12 per cent compared with the same period last year. The total financial losses amounted to about HK$3.8 billion, down approximately 15 per cent year-on-year. However, police said the number of cases and the amount of losses remained at a high level and were a cause for concern.
During the same period, police detected 1.3 million cyber threat intelligence items targeting Hong Kong, an increase of about 32 per cent year-on-year. This equated to an average of 4,650 items of cyber intelligence per day.
Senior Superintendent Lam Cheuk-ho, head of the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau, said that recently criminals have been using artificial intelligence to monitor vulnerabilities in platforms or organisations around the clock. They have also automated some attack steps, making their assaults more efficient.
Police found that many organisations responded slowly to threats and failed to monitor the cybersecurity of third-party suppliers. The force urged enterprises of all sizes and individuals to remain vigilant, patch vulnerabilities promptly, update systems, and step up monitoring of abnormal activities, warning against complacency.
In the first nine months, police worked with multiple organisations and internet service providers to fix more than 44,000 high-risk cybersecurity vulnerabilities and remove over 63,000 online threats. Through intelligence analysis, police discovered that 65 schools were using outdated firewalls, with some equipment exposed to the internet, leaving them vulnerable to hacker intrusion and malware that could turn school servers into part of a botnet. Police proactively contacted the schools and provided technical support.
Earlier, Interpol conducted its first artificial-intelligence-led multinational cyber operation, known as Operation Synergia, with technical support from Hong Kong police. The operation removed or blocked more than 51,000 malicious websites. The second phase, Operation Synergia 2.0, has been launched and will expand participation to 24 jurisdictions.

Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
1:00 PM PST · November 8, 2026
Nvidia’s board of directors announced Sunday that it’s launching an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation.
Nvidia also published a message that Huang sent to the company admitting that he had an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed (though he didn’t mention her by name). A memo circulating among U.S. policymakers earlier this year claimed that Alice Huang had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia’s CEO.
“I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Jensen Huang wrote. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”
Huang added that he’d “fallen short” of his responsibility to the company.
“To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me,” he said.
As the AI race between the United States and China heats up, chips, especially Nvidia’s chips, have been a major focus. Huang also seems to have a close relationship with President Donald Trump, who’s been a cheerleader of the AI (or “superintelligence”) industry.
In its announcement, Nvidia’s board said that it has “no reason to believe” that either national security or company secrets were compromised. It also said that Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it,” and that the board has “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team.”
The investigation will be conducted by independent directors working with outside legal counsel.
In response to earlier reports about the CEO’s relationship with Alice Huang, Nvidia had said that the pair’s interactions were “not unusual,” and that the company does not share classified information with customers.
Other companies involved in the AI boom have warned employees to be wary of possible spies, including those offering sex or romance.

Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

title: The ‘Invade the World, Invite the World’ Election
zh_title: “入侵世界，邀请世界”选举

content:
政治 “入侵世界，邀请世界”的选举 如果不颠覆一个国家的政治，就无法改变一个国家的人口结构。由于选民对伊朗战争及其经济后果感到沮丧，共和党在中期选举中遭受重创，甚至包括副总统 J.D. 万斯在内的许多共和党人也承认这一点。但民主党取得如此规模的压倒性胜利是由另一个因素促成的：过去几十年来，美国的种族人口结构转型主要是由大规模移民推动的。如果只有白人投票，共和党就会加强对参议院、众议院和州级办公室的控制。如果只有非白人投票的话，那么，连中共都会羡慕民主党的绝对统治地位。正如右翼社会评论家史蒂夫·塞勒（Steve Sailer）的名言，“入侵世界，邀请世界”，他总结了我们无能的领导层的军事和移民政策。这就是这次选举的故事。佐治亚州曾经是一个红宝石色的州，已经从 1990 年白人占绝对多数的州变成了今天白人占少数的州。因此，尽管乔治亚州白人大幅支持共和党候选人，桃州还是将乔恩·奥索夫送回参议院，并选举凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯担任州长，两人都是民主党人。德克萨斯州——传统上由共和党控制的人口最多的州——的结果更加令人震惊。但数据讲述了相同的基本情况。
德克萨斯州只有37%是白人，这也是民主党在孤星州占据主导地位的一个重要原因。倾向相当保守的德克萨斯州拉美裔不仅变蓝，而且人数众多。堪萨斯州、俄亥俄州、南卡罗来纳州，这样的例子不胜枚举，但你明白了。可以肯定的是，如果特朗普政府在过去两年里治理得更有能力——特别是如果它没有发动灾难性的伊朗战争——那么白人和非白人就不会像他们那样强烈地转向民主党，共和党也可能保住参议院。但这还不是故事的全部。美国的种族多样性为其选举奠定了背景，而这种背景对共和党来说越来越难以驾驭。我在印刷品和网络上（以及再次在网上）指出，由于美国人口结构的变化，民主党正在走向永久多数。很少有人同意我的分析——甚至经典著作《新兴的民主多数》（2002）的作者也否认了他们书中的论点——但我毫不怀疑。如果您仍然持怀疑态度，请思考一下这两个事实：1）自赫伯特·胡佛以来，还没有共和党总统候选人赢得过任何非白人种族群体的多数选票，2）到 2045 年左右，美国将成为非白人占多数的国家。反思完了吗？这是另一个事实：两党之间白人的分歧仍然比其他种族群体更大。
由白人自由主义者和非白人组成的民主党联盟如果成立，将在美国选民变成少数派之前数年实现稳定的统治。有几个因素减缓了民主党永久多数派的出现。投票的选民比一般人口更白。红队偶尔可以赢得超过 40% 的拉美裔选民，这是美国最大的少数族裔群体。许多未受过大学教育的白人已经逃往共和党，部分原因是对民主党的跨性别主义等精品文化迷恋的反应。以及反多数主义机构——格里姆

【原文 English Original】
Politics The ‘Invade the World, Invite the World’ Election You can’t transform a nation’s demographics without upending its politics. The Republican Party got smacked in the midterm elections because of voter frustration over the Iran War and its economic consequences, as even many Republicans, including Vice President J.D. Vance, have acknowledged. But the scale of the Democrats’ sweeping victory was enabled by another factor: America’s racial-demographic transformation over the past several decades, driven largely by mass migration. If only whites had voted, the Republican Party would have strengthened its hold on the Senate, the House of Representatives, and state-level offices. If only nonwhites had voted, well, even the Chinese Communists would envy the Democratic Party its utter dominance. “Invade the world, invite the world,” as the right-wing social commentator Steve Sailer famously put it, summarizing our inept leadership’s military and immigration policies. That’s the story of this election. Georgia, once a ruby-red state, has gone from being supermajority white in 1990 to minority white today. So even though white Georgians favored the Republican candidates by wide margins, the Peach State sent Jon Ossoff back to the Senate and elected Keisha Lance Bottoms as governor, both Democrats. The results in Texas—the most populous state traditionally held by the GOP—were even more shocking. But the data tell the same basic story. Only 37 percent of Texans are white, which is a big reason why Democrats dominated in the Lone Star State. Texas Hispanics, who tend to be fairly conservative, not only shifted blue but turned out in large numbers. Kansas, Ohio, South Carolina, the list goes on and on, but you get the idea. To be sure, if the Trump administration had governed more competently during the past two years—and especially if it hadn’t launched the disastrous Iran War—then whites and nonwhites alike wouldn’t have swung as sharply as they did toward the Democrats, and Republicans might have held onto the Senate. But that’s not the whole story. America’s racial diversity sets the context for its elections, and that context is an increasingly difficult one for Republicans to navigate. I’ve argued in print and online (and online again) that the Democrats are heading toward a permanent majority because of America’s changing demographics. Few people agree with my analysis—and even the authors of the classic text The Emerging Democratic Majority (2002) have disavowed their book’s thesis—but I harbor little doubt. If you remain skeptical, reflect on these two facts for a while: 1) No Republican presidential candidate since Herbert Hoover has won a majority of votes from any nonwhite racial group, and 2) America will be majority nonwhite by around 2045. Done reflecting? Here’s another fact: Whites remain more divided than other racial groups between the two parties. A Democratic coalition of white liberals and nonwhites, if it holds, will achieve stable domination years before America’s electorate turns majority-minority. Several factors have slowed the emergence of a permanent Democratic majority. The voting electorate is whiter than the general population. The Red Team can occasionally win more than 40 percent of Hispanics, America’s largest minority group. Many non-college-educated whites have fled to the GOP, partly in reaction to the Democrats’ boutique cultural fixations like transgenderism. And countermajoritarian institutions—gerrymandering in the House, malapportionment in the Senate, and the electoral college—mostly benefit the Republicans. Some analysts, after Donald Trump’s dramatic victory in 2024, posited a new “multiracial coalition” that would keep the GOP in the game. It was wishful thinking. Trump made inroads with nonwhites, but he merely brought the GOP back to its George W. Bush numbers, more or less. The margin of error for Republican presidential candidates is apparently slim. In 2024, Trump mobilized blue-collar whites and did reasonably well among minorities. And yet, facing a disastrous candidate installed at the 11th hour, Trump won the popular vote by a smaller margin than Hillary Clinton in 2016. What transpired this week was a different matter altogether—an electoral backlash that some thought impossible in our age of polarization—and it will have long-lasting political consequences. The Dems will probably maintain their Senate majority over several election cycles, and if Texas just became solidly blue, Republicans won’t stand a chance at winning the White House in 2028. Of course, a permanent Democratic majority doesn’t mean an eternal one. Perhaps the Democratic Party will splinter between its moderate and progressive factions, or maybe a viable third party will emerge that, over time, replaces the GOP. On the other hand, in cities and states that long ago became majority nonwhite, the Democrats enjoy one-party rule, and governance generally suffers. A nation is its people, as right-wingers often say. And you can’t transform a nation without upending its politics. The Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Carl Vinson (CVN 70) and the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Sterett (DDG 104) transit the Strait of Malacca, July 16, 2025.
Credit: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Jacob I. Allison
In October 2026, China’s Liaoning carrier group transited the Basilan Strait toward the Celebes Sea, at least its second reported passage since December 2025. The deployment also included a transit through the Luzon Strait. Its significance lies in demonstrating additional routes through the First Island Chain. A CSIS analysis of Japanese observations recorded Liaoning and Shandong beyond the First Island Chain for a combined 58 days in 2025, up from 32 in 2024.
For China, those options have implications beyond mere navigation. China’s expanding naval and air reach gives it more opportunities to impose costs on forces seeking to interrupt its seaborne energy supply. A blockade coalition would have to protect its own operations and its members’ trade while sustaining pressure on China.
In China’s case, the Malacca dilemma refers to its exposure to disruption of the large share of its seaborne energy imports and trade that passes through the Strait of Malacca, as well as to the coercive leverage that this vulnerability gives others. The Diplomat has already examined the strategic importance of the Strait of Malacca in previous analyses, along with and the disruptive potential of sanctions and compliance pressure. With its broader naval and air presence, however, China is making the Malacca dilemma no longer one-directional. Any blockade coalition must now account for the increased reach of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA).
One concrete way that PLA presence complicates coalition planning is surveillance. The southern Philippine approaches illustrate the burden. USNI News reported that BRP Sarangani shadowed Liaoning, while BRP Diego Silang and BRP Emilio Jacinto also monitored the group.
Yet successful local shadowing does not establish continuous coverage. Japan’s Joint Staff documented carrier flight operations on October 14 and the formation’s movement toward the South China Sea on October 15; Philippine monitoring records obtained by Bilyonaryo News Channel described tracking on October 22-23. The intervening week was not accounted for in those reports. Operational intelligence may remain undisclosed, so that gap does not establish lost contact, but the public record doesn’t support an assumption of uninterrupted Philippine surveillance.
USNI described the Philippine military’s force posture in Mindanao as focused on counter-piracy and counterinsurgency missions, while PLA Tracker’s Ben Lewis characterized the Sulu Sea as less closely watched than Luzon. Separately, Chinese ships have used the Sibutu Passage in 2019, well before the Liaoning deployment. Such activity broadens the area in which U.S. partners may need to maintain contact with Chinese forces. If Philippine coverage proves insufficient, additional U.S. or allied surveillance assets would be required, reducing what remains available for other missions.
The surveillance burden created by these southern transits matters even if the coalition does not intend to intercept ships there. A coalition need not patrol every Philippine passage to stop tankers west of Malacca. However, it would have to account for Chinese forces operating elsewhere in the theater and the additional protection required by exposed ships and support facilities. This competition for resources connects the southern transits to blockade sustainability.
Selectivity adds another burden: restricting China-bound cargo while allowing other trade requires more than identifying a vessel’s flag or next port. U.S. maritime sanctions guidance already calls for scrutiny of cargo documentation, counterparties, and ownership. Transshipment through an intermediate hub can complicate the determination of a cargo’s ultimate destination. In a blockade scenario, inspections and disputed records would consume time while Chinese military activity increases force-protection requirements. Shipowners or insurers might withdraw before an interception occurred. Such uncertainty could increase pressure on China, but it could also undermine the credibility of the U.S. promise that allied trade would remain unaffected. China’s regional presence creates leverage by making that promise harder and more expensive to keep.
The United States would face these requirements with a fleet whose sustained availability is already constrained. A 2025 Government Accountability Office review identified shortages of spare parts and qualified maintenance personnel, alongside deferred surface-ship maintenance. An August 2026 report found that maintenance delays and idle time had cost active attack submarines more than 15,000 operational days during fiscal years 2016-2025.
USS Benfold’s July 2026 engineering casualty illustrated the immediate consequences. The destroyer lost power and required towing to Subic Bay before repairs were completed. During a blockade, replacing a disabled ship’s surveillance or escort functions would draw on other assets. The problem is cumulative: more protection against Chinese interference increases demand for ships already needed for rotations, among other additional maintenance and crew-recovery demands. A coalition’s initial strength therefore says little about how much capability it can keep available month after month.
American naval constraints would increase pressure on allies to contribute, but Japan and South Korea have vulnerabilities of their own. U.S. Energy Information Administration data identify both countries as major destinations for crude oil passing through Malacca. Their governments would need assurances that participation would not jeopardize the supplies their economies require. Chinese operations across the wider region could increase the escorts and surveillance needed to protect that shipping route, further draining forces available for coalition enforcement.
The Liaoning’s operation beyond the First Island Chain does not establish an ability to threaten every tanker supplying Northeast Asia, but it illustrates the geographic breadth planners must consider when assessing possible Chinese responses. China could seek to discourage participation in any blockade by increasing the expected cost to coalition members. Allied participation therefore cannot be assumed. Japan’s Reciprocal Access Agreement with the Philippines facilitates defense cooperation, but it does not constitute advance consent to joining a blockade. Contributions to an interdiction operation would also compete with each country’s other defense requirements.
Support from the states bordering the strait is equally consequential. In April, Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan ruled out participation in attempts to close, interdict, or impose tolls in Singapore’s neighborhood. He described Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia as strategically aligned in keeping the straits open, and said Singapore had conveyed its position on transit passage to both China and United States. The statement directly challenges any assumption that existing security relationships guarantee local support for maritime interdiction. Without cooperation, an enforcing coalition could face longer support routes and more demanding arrangements for access and resupply. Singapore’s position and the Philippines’ surveillance challenge are different constraints: one concerns partner alignment, the other resources and capacity. Together, they show why regional partnerships cannot be treated as ready-made reserve of enforcement capacity.
China nevertheless remains exposed beyond its immediate region. Peacetime transits do not demonstrate the ability to keep ships, aircraft, and replenishment vessels operating under attack.
A 2020 Naval War College study identified PLA logistics, air-defense, and antisubmarine limitations in the Indian Ocean. Rather than establish China’s current capability ceiling, the assessment identifies the functions that distant operations must sustain. Interdiction farther west would stretch Chinese support and protection requirements, rendering the military options demonstrated by operations around the first island chain less feasible. The regional deterrent is therefore conditional and geographically uneven, with its value lying in raising the cost of coercing China rather than eliminating China’s vulnerability to economic pressure.
Only when a coalition seeks to blockade the Malacca Strait or enforce selective interdiction against China do Chinese operations create additional force-protection requirements for coalition forces and exposed shipping. U.S. availability constraints then limit the capacity to meet those requirements, while partners’ exposure makes assurances about permitted trade harder to sustain. These interactions make coalition participation harder to justify. The Malacca dilemma, therefore, increasingly runs both ways. For the United States, the central question is whether a coalition can maintain selective interdiction long enough to meaningfully change China’s calculations while absorbing Chinese counterpressure against its own forces and its most exposed partners.

title: Police say linking mall cameras to AI facial recognition network complies with Hong Kong privacy laws
zh_title: 警方表示，将商场摄像头连接到人工智能面部识别网络符合香港隐私法
summary: 警方表示，为香港的闭路电视网络配备人工智能面部识别软件并将其连接到购物中心的安全摄像头不会违反当地的隐私法。旺角的闭路电视摄像机。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据当地媒体周五报道，警方表示，人工智能面部识别功能最早将于本月添加到该市的 SmartView 监控系统中，今年将有四家私人购物中心连接到该网络。据了解，这四间商场分别为大角咀奥海城、屯门市广场、葵涌商场及四二商场
content:
警方表示，为香港的闭路电视网络配备人工智能面部识别软件并将其连接到购物中心的安全摄像头不会违反当地的隐私法。旺角的闭路电视摄像机。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据当地媒体周五报道，警方表示，人工智能面部识别功能最早将于本月添加到该市的 SmartView 监控系统中，今年将有四家私人购物中心连接到该网络。据当地媒体报道，这四家商场分别是大角咀的奥海城、屯门市广场、葵涌商场和粉岭的Sierra Life。警方行动科高级警司梁明亮表示，人工智能面部识别系统不会全天候运行，而是需要督察或以上级别的警官批准。 “我们首先要问的是，使用SmartView对于破案是否至关重要。必须审查多少个摄像头和多少镜头？这个范围是否符合调查目标？在批准任何申请之前，必须解决这些问题，”梁用粤语说。他表示，该技术将通过自动识别嫌疑人或失踪人员的面部是否在特定时间范围内的特定区域被摄像机捕捉到，帮助警察追查嫌疑人或失踪人员。梁补充说，或者，该系统可以实时追踪一个人的脸部，提醒警察他们出现的时间和地点。
闭路电视录像将在捕获后30天自动删除，而时间戳和位置等元数据将保留长达180天。“额外好处”梁还表示，根据警方法律团队和个人资料私隐专员的评估，与购物中心的连接不会违反隐私法。旺角的闭路电视摄像机。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “这些商场已经配备了安全摄像头，通常与我们的 SmartView 系统具有相同的公共安全目的。连接到它们只是一个额外的好处，”他说。 SmartView项目于2024年启动，截至上个月，已帮助破获2,000起犯罪案件，并逮捕了约2,800名涉嫌谋杀和纵火等罪名的嫌疑人。当局的目标是到 2028 年，通过安装新摄像头并将私人系统和其他政府部门运营的系统连接到警察网络，将全市 60,000 个监控摄像头纳入该系统。 SmartView 第三阶段计划在 2028 年至 2031 年间再安装 6,500 个监控摄像头。

【原文 English Original】
Equipping Hong Kong’s CCTV network with AI facial recognition software and connecting it to shopping mall security cameras would not breach local privacy laws, police have said. A CCTV camera in Mong Kok. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police have said that the AI facial recognition feature will be added to the city’s SmartView surveillance system as early as this month, with four private shopping malls set to be connected to the network this year, local media reported on Friday. The four malls are understood to be Olympian City in Tai Kok Tsui, Tuen Mun Town Plaza, Kwai Chung Shopping Centre, and Sierra Life in Fanling, local media reported . Leung Ming-leung, a senior superintendent in the police’s Operations Bureau, said the AI facial recognition system would not operate round-the-clock, but would instead require sign-off from an officer ranked inspector or above. “We first ask whether using SmartView is essential to solving the crime. How many cameras and how much footage must be reviewed? Does that scope align with the investigation’s objectives? These points must be settled before any application is approved,” Leung said in Cantonese. He said the technology would help officers track down suspects or missing persons by automatically identifying whether their faces had been caught on camera in a particular area during a specific timeframe. Alternatively, the system could trace an individual’s face in real time, alerting officers to when and where they appear, Leung added. The CCTV footage will be automatically deleted 30 days after capture, while metadata such as timestamps and locations will be retained for up to 180 days. ‘Added bonus’ Leung also said that the connections to shopping malls would not breach privacy laws, based on assessments by the police’s legal team and the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data. A CCTV camera in Mong Kok. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “These malls are already equipped with security cameras, often serving the same public safety purpose as our SmartView system. Linking into them is merely an added bonus,” he said. The SmartView project was launched in 2024 and, as of last month, had helped solve 2,000 crimes and led to the arrest of about 2,800 suspects on charges including murder and arson. Authorities aim to incorporate 60,000 surveillance cameras across the city into the system by 2028, by installing new cameras and linking private systems and those operated by other government departments to the police network. A further 6,500 surveillance cameras are planned between 2028 and 2031 under SmartView’s third phase.

title: Hong Kong installs HK$5m ‘anti-terrorism’ crash bollards outside Causeway Bay dep’t store
zh_title: 香港在铜锣湾百货商店外安装价值 500 万港元的“反恐”防撞柱
summary: 香港当局在香港最繁忙的购物区之一铜锣湾的一家百货公司外安装了“反恐”防撞柱，该项目耗资 500 万港元。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，铜锣湾的“反恐”交通路柱。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周四早上，这些护柱仍被泡沫板包裹着，最初是由警方、运输部和路政部在一月份作为反恐工作组的一部分提出的。 500万港元的临时预算还包括维修费用
content:
香港当局在香港最繁忙的购物区之一铜锣湾的一家百货公司外安装了“反恐”防撞柱，该项目耗资 500 万港元。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，铜锣湾的“反恐”交通路柱。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周四早上，这些护柱仍被泡沫板包裹着，最初是由警方、运输部和路政部在一月份作为反恐工作组的一部分提出的。根据提交给湾仔区议会的一份文件，500万港元的临时预算还包括护柱的维护费用。这些护柱计划安装在轩尼诗道 555 号外和百德新街沿线。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，铜锣湾崇光百货外的“反恐”交通标杆。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。会议记录显示，工作组建议安装60个防撞柱，其中固定式柱43个，伸缩式柱17个。 “护柱之间将留有足够的间距，以便轮椅、婴儿车和担架可以顺利通过，而不会受到阻碍，”它说。警方指出，铜锣湾是港岛区的“核心商业区和旅游区”，人流繁忙，“如果车辆在该地区冲撞人群，可能会造成严重伤亡。” 2026年11月6日，铜锣湾的“反恐”交通路柱。
照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。“通过这些设施，可以采用最直接的物理隔离方法，有效防止车辆故意冲撞行人专用区，从而最大限度地降低人员伤亡的风险。”崇光百货外的区域历史上曾是香港抗议活动的主要聚集区，距离天安门广场镇压守夜活动的旧址维多利亚公园仅一箭之遥。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，铜锣湾崇光百货外的“反恐”交通标杆。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。近年来，在6月4日镇压周年纪念日当天，警察在维多利亚公园和铜锣湾周围保持大量警力，拦截和拘留活动人士和进行象征性哀悼活动的个人。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong authorities have installed “anti-terrorism” collision bollards outside a department store in Causeway Bay, one of the city’s busiest shopping districts – a project with a HK$5 million price tag. “Anti-terrorism” traffic bollards in Causeway Bay on November 6, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The bollards, which were still wrapped in foam sheeting on Thursday morning, were initially proposed in January by the police, the Transport Department, and the Highways Department as part of a counter-terrorism working group. The provisional budget of HK$5 million also includes maintenance costs for the bollards, according to a document submitted to the Wan Chai District Council. The bollards were planned for installation outside 555 Hennessy Road and along Paterson Street. “Anti-terrorism” traffic bollards outside Sogo in Causeway Bay on November 6, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Meeting records show that the working group proposed installing 60 anti-collision bollards, including 43 fixed bollards and 17 retractable ones. “Sufficient spacing would be left between the bollards so that wheelchairs, baby strollers and stretchers could pass through smoothly without being obstructed,” it said. Noting that Causeway Bay is a “core business district and tourist area” on Hong Kong Island with heavy foot traffic, the police said that “[i]f vehicles were to ram into crowds at the location, serious casualties could result.” “Anti-terrorism” traffic bollards in Causeway Bay on November 6, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Through these facilities, the most direct physical separation method could be used to effectively prevent vehicles from deliberately ramming into pedestrian areas, thereby minimising the risk of casualties,” it said. The area outside the Sogo department store historically served as a major gathering zone for protests in Hong Kong, and is a stone’s throw away from Victoria Park, the former site of the city’s Tiananmen Square crackdown vigils. “Anti-terrorism” traffic bollards outside Sogo in Causeway Bay on November 6, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In recent years, police officers have maintained a heavy presence around Victoria Park and Causeway Bay on the anniversary of the crackdown on June 4 , stopping and detaining activists and individuals who engaged in symbolic acts of mourning.

content:
以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。在新加坡 西奥多·罗斯福号航母战斗群于周五驶入新加坡进行港口访问。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）以及保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-60）和迪凯特号（DDG-73）。西奥多·罗斯福号、长津号和保罗·汉密尔顿号停靠在樟宜海军基地，而迪凯特号则停靠在三巴旺。预计该打击群将在港口访问后穿过马六甲海峡前往中东。上周末，西奥多·罗斯福号CSG与舰队加油船USNS Tippecanoe (T-AO-199)在菲律宾和南中国海与日本海上自卫队(JMSDF)驱逐舰JS Onami (DD-111)进行了跨甲板和通信演习。 2026 年 11 月 4 日，尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 在南海与澳大利亚皇家海军供应级补给油船 HMAS Stalwart (A304) 进行海上补给。美国海军照片澳大利亚皇家海军舰队加油船 HMAS Stalwart (A304) 正在南海执行澳大利亚皇家海军的区域存在部署。周三，西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰与“坚定”号进行了海上补给。美国海军还发布了一段 RAS 的视频。在菲律宾海 十一月发布的一张图片
2026 年 12 月 3 日，台湾国家安全委员会秘书长吴钊燮发表。 台湾国家安全委员会图片 根据台湾国家安全委员会秘书长吴钊燮发布的图片，截至周三，辽宁舰航母战斗群正在吕宋岛东北部的菲律宾海执行任务。辽宁舰CSG包括辽宁号航空母舰（16艘）、鞍山号巡洋舰（101艘）和无锡号巡洋舰（104艘）以及淮南号驱逐舰（123艘）。日本横须贺 日本海上自卫队上尉 Nakazawa Noriya，巡逻和防卫第一中队指挥官，印度海军中将 A.N.美国海军副参谋长普拉莫德、美国海军第七舰队司令帕特·汉尼芬中将、日本海上自卫队多任务隐形护卫舰最上号（FFM 1）舰长吉田胜也、澳大利亚皇家海军少将澳大利亚舰队司令安妮塔·威廉姆斯和日本海上自卫队总司令、自卫队中将大町克志在船上会面2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间，最上位于日本横须贺，2026 年 11 月 5 日。美国海军照片 美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度于周四拉开了 2026 年马拉巴尔四方演习的序幕，参与演习的舰艇目前停靠在港口，进行岸上演习阶段。日本海上自卫队派出直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM-1)、一艘潜艇和一架 P-1 海上巡逻机参加演习。
印度海军部署了 INS Sahyadri (F49) 护卫舰，澳大利亚将部署 HMAS Stuart (FFH153) 护卫舰和澳大利亚皇家空军 P-8A Poseidon MPA。美国将派出两栖运输船坞舰 USS Anchorage (LPD-23) 和 USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) 以及 P-8A Poseidon MPA 参加。安克雷奇和约翰·P·穆萨号两栖攻击舰以及马金岛号两栖攻击舰 (LHD-8) 和组成马金岛两栖准备大队的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队，该部队自 10 月 26 日起一直停靠在横须贺进行港口访问。拉尔夫·约翰逊号驱逐舰 (DDG-114) 返回其指挥官舰队活动的母港

【原文 English Original】
The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In Singapore The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group pulled into Singapore on Friday for a port visit. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). Theodore Roosevelt, Chosin and Paul Hamilton docked into Changi Naval Base while Decatur docked into Sembawang. The strike group is expected to transit the Malacca Strait to head to the Middle East following the port visit. Last weekend , the Theodore Roosevelt CSG with fleet oiler USNS Tippecanoe (T-AO-199) carried out cross deck and communication exercises with Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) destroyer JS Onami (DD-111) in the Philippine and South China seas. In the South China Sea Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) conducts a replenishment-at-sea with Royal Australian Navy Supply-class replenishment oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304), Nov. 4, 2026. US Navy photo Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304) is operating in the South China Sea for the Royal Australian Navy’s regional presence deployment. On Wednesday, aircraft carrier Theodore Roosevelt conducted a replenishment at sea with Stalwart . The U.S. Navy also released a video of the RAS. In the Philippine Sea A graphic posted Nov. 3, 2026, by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. Taiwan’s National Security Council graphic The Liaoning Carrier Strike Group was operating in the Philippine Sea northeast of Luzon as of Wednesday, according to a graphic posted by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. The PLAN Liaoning CSG includes aircraft carrier CNS Liaoning (16) cruisers CNS Anshan (101) and CNS Wuxi (104) and destroyer CNS Huainan (123). In Yokosuka, Japan Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force CAPT NAKAZAWA Noriya, commander of Patrol and Defense Squadron 1, Indian Navy Vice Adm. A.N. Pramod, Deputy Chief of Naval Staff, U.S. Navy 7th Fleet Commander Vice Adm. Pat Hannifin, JMSDF CDR YOSHIDA Katsuya, commanding officer of Multi-Mission Stealth Frigate JS Mogami (FFM 1), Royal Australian Navy Rear Adm. Anita Williams, Commander Australian Fleet, and JMSDF Commander in Chief, Self Defense Fleet Vice Adm. OMACHI Katsushi meet aboard Mogami in Yokosuka, Japan during Exercise Malabar 2026, Nov. 5, 2026. US Navy photo The U.S., Japan, Australia and India opened Quad Exercise Malabar 2026 on Thursday with participating ships currently docked in the port for the shore phase of the exercise. The JMSDF is participating with helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182), frigate JS Mogami (FFM-1), a submarine and a P-1 Maritime Patrol Aircraft for the drills. The Indian Navy deployed frigate INS Sahyadri (F49) and Australia will deploy frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH153) and a Royal Australian Air Force P-8A Poseidon MPA. The U.S. is participating with amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) and a P-8A Poseidon MPA. Anchorage and USS John P. Murtha with amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) and the embarked 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit form the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group, which has been docked in Yokosuka for a port visit since Oct. 26. Destroyer USS Ralph Johnson (DDG-114) returned to its homeport of Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY) on Tuesday , according to local ship spotters. In North Korea North Korea conducted a firepower demonstration exercise on Nov. 4, 2026. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea tested its missile strike capabilities Saturday and Monday from undisclosed locations, according to reports by state media Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) . On Saturday, North Korea test fired the Standard Type 2 cluster-bomb warhead for tactical ballistic missiles. On Monday, North Korea tested a strategic cruise missile’s cluster munitions warhead and conducted a vertical strike flight characteristics test. North Korea uses the term “strategic” to denote nuclear weapon capability. North Korea test fired a newly-designed advanced air defense surface-to-air missile and carried out a firepower demonstration exercise with cruise missiles striking a mock airfield target on Wednesday, KCNA reported. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff said that North Korea fired multiple missiles into the Sea of Japan from the Sondok area. Near South Korea The Republic of Korea Navy Task Fleet Command conducted fleet-level maritime drills in South Korea’s East, West and South Seas from Nov. 1-6, 2026. ROKN photo The Republic of Korea Navy Task Fleet Command conducted fleet-level maritime drills in South Korea’s East, West and South Seas from Sunday to Friday to strengthen the command’s operational capabilities and readiness. The drills include air defense, anti-submarine warfare, anti-surface warfare and the detection and tracking of ballistic missiles with 10 ROKN ships, including destroyers ROKS Yulgok Yi I (DDG-992) and ROKS Jeongjo the Great (DDG-995) and ROKN and Republic of Korea Air Force aircraft. At Jinhae Naval Base, South Korea The Republic of Korea Navy Joint Cruise Training Task Force departed Nov. 3, 2026, from Jinhae. ROKN photo The Republic of Korea Navy Joint Cruise Training Task Force departed Tuesday from Jinhae for a cruise training voyage that will last until Nov. 20 and include port visits to Jeju, South Korea and Guam. The task group includes amphibious assault ship ROKS Marado (LPH-6112), amphibious landing ships ROKS Ilchulbong (LST-688) and ROKS Nojeokbong (LST-689) as well as embarked Republic of Korea Marine Corps MUH-1 Marineon helicopters and 741 second year cadets from three service academies and the Armed Forces Nursing Academy. In Pohang, South Korea The Republic of Korea Marine Corps 1st Marine Division participated in a counter-terrorism and aircraft incident response exercise held at Pohang-Gyeongju Airport on Nov. 4, 2026. ROKMC photo The Republic of Korea Marine Corps 1st Marine Division participated in a counter-terrorism and aircraft incident response exercise held at Pohang-Gyeongju Airport on Wednesday . This year’s exercise involved 15 organizations, including the 1st Marine Division’s counter-terrorism unit, the Korea Airports Corporation, various airlines and local police, fire and medical agencies. The counter terrorism unit conducted a boarding and hostage rescue mission on an airliner in a hijacked aircraft scenario and in a subsequent scenario, a drone carrying explosives that approached the aircraft was jammed and neutralized. “The [Republic of Korea] Marine Corps will continue to strengthen its joint operational capabilities – built upon close coordination with relevant agencies – to respond swiftly and accurately to a wide range of threats,” the ROKMC said. In Kure, Japan Royal Canadian Navy frigate HMCS Regina (FFH334) arrived Nov. 1, 2026, at Kure Naval Base, Japan. JMSDF photo Royal Canadian Navy frigate HMCS Regina (FFH334) arrived Sunday at Kure Naval Base for a port visit. Regina is on deployment under Operation Horizon, the Canadian Armed Forces’ ongoing presence and engagement deployment to the Indo-Pacific. Near Amami Oshima PLAN frigate CNS Jingzhou (532) was sighted Saturday sailing northwest 80 kilometers – 50 miles – northeast of the island of Amami Oshima. The frigate subsequently sailed southwest between Amami Oshima and Yokoate Island to enter the East China Sea. Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force fleet oiler JS Tokiwa (AOE-423) shadowed the PLAN frigate, which previously sailed east through the Osumi Strait between the main island of Kyushi and Tanegashima Island from Oct. 19-20 to enter the Pacific Ocean. In the Miyako Strait Russian Navy surveillance ship Kareliya (535) sailed south between Miyako Island and Okinawa to enter the Philippine Sea on Saturday. The surveillance ship was previously sighted south 50 kilometers – 31 miles – northwest of Kume Island in the East China Sea and subsequently was observed maneuvering northwest and west of Kume Island. JMSDF minesweeper JS Takashima (MSC-603) and a JMSDF P-3C Orion Maritime Patrol Aircraft (MPA) shadowed the Russian ship. Kareliya transited south through the Tsushima Strait from Oct. 27-28 to enter the East China Sea. PLAN destroyer CNS Qiqihar (121) and fast combat support ship CNS Hulunhu (901) on Nov. 1, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo On Sunday, PLAN destroyer CNS Qiqihar (121) and fast combat support ship CNS Hulunhu (901) were sighted sailing northwest 210 kilometers – 130 miles – southeast of Miyako Island and subsequently sailed northwest through the waters between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the East China Sea. The two PLAN ships previously sailed east through the Osumi Strait on Oct. 17 to enter the Pacific Ocean. On Monday, Qiqihar and fleet oiler CNS Chaohu (890) were sighted moving southeast 70 kilometers – 43 miles – southwest of Kume Island. Subsequently, the two PLAN ships sailed southeast between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. A JMSDF P-1 MPA and a JMSDF P-3C Orion MPA carried out surveillance on the PLAN ships. Qiqihar returned Wednesday to the East China Sea, having sailed northwest between Miyako Island and Okinawa. The ship was previously sighted sailing north 130 kilometers – 81 miles – northeast of Miyako Island. A JMSDF Fleet Air Wing 1 P-1 MPA tracked its movements. Chinese UAV flights on Nov. 2, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office map On Monday, a Chinese WZ-7 reconnaissance Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) flew in from the East China Sea, passing between Okinawa and Miyako Island, to enter the Philippine Sea. The drone carried out circuit flights in the Philippine Sea waters south of Miyako Island to south of Okinawa. The UAV then flew back through the waters between Okinawa and Miyako Island to return to the East China Sea and subsequently headed back to China. A second WZ-7 also flew in from the East China Sea on Monday and flew between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. The drone carried out circuit flights before returning back the same way to the East China Sea. In response, fighter aircraft from the Japan Air Self-Defense Force’s Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled. Near Taiwan On Saturday, a suspected Chinese UAV flew in from the East China Sea and passed between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan to enter the Philippine Sea. Fighter aircraft from the JASDF Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled in response. In the East China Sea A Chinese TB-001 reconnaissance UAV in the East China Sea on Nov. 5, 2026. summary: 香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公正判决 zevans@freedom… 星期四，11/05/2026 - 15:23 键入联合声明 国家香港页面屏蔽 我们，以下签名组织，谴责香港高等法院 11 月 5 日对香港民主倡导者黄之锋判处 10 年徒刑。这是他第二次根据北京实施的国家安全法被判刑，该法导致香港基本自由的迅速恶化。三周前，约书亚在监狱里度过了自己的 30 岁生日，现在他晋升为承诺
content:
香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公正判决 zevans@freedom… 星期四，11/05/2026 - 15:23 输入联合声明 国家香港页面屏蔽 我们，以下签名组织，谴责香港高等法院 11 月 5 日对香港民主倡导者黄之锋判处 10 年徒刑。这是他第二次根据北京实施的国家安全法被判刑，该法导致香港基本自由的迅速恶化。三周前，约书亚在监狱里度过了自己的 30 岁生日，十几岁时，他作为学生团体学民思潮的联合创始人而声名鹊起，该团体反对将亲北京的宣传引入香港学校。他帮助领导了 2014 年历史性的雨伞运动，并于 2016 年创建了亲民主的众志党，该党在 2020 年《国家安全法》获得批准后被迫解散。他因其民主行动主义而获得国际赞誉，包括多次获得诺贝尔和平奖提名。由于这种宣传，约书亚一再入狱，自2020年11月以来一直被拘留。2024年，他因参加第一次也是唯一一次全市民主初选而被以阴谋颠覆罪判处四年零八个月监禁。
他预计将于 2027 年 1 月获释，但在 2025 年 6 月面临额外指控，罪名是因之前的活动而与外国势力合谋。 作为这些指控的一部分，检察官提到了约书亚与美国政府官员（包括当时的参议员马可·卢比奥）的会面。这是中国共产党一系列令人担忧的尝试之一，不仅限制和控制中国公民和香港人可以会见哪些人，还限制和控制外国政府官员可以联系谁以及他们可以收到哪些信息。此外，北京支持的香港政府强烈劝阻居民观看并考虑对获奖纪录片《约书亚：青少年与超级大国》采取进一步行动，该片记录了约书亚早期的活动，进一步表明其压制香港民主运动独立报道的努力。约书亚的拘留也凸显了中共如何继续藐视《中英联合声明》。该条约是 1997 年香港主权移交过程​​中谈判达成的，其中规定了“一国两种制度”的原则，该原则本应持续到 2047 年。中共对这一原则的漠视——约书亚因行使基本自由而被拘留就证明了这一点——令人质疑中共在贸易或其他问题上谈判达成的协议是否会得到遵守。
我们呼吁香港当局立即无条件释放约书亚，并要求民主政府更有力地要求释放他。具体来说，我们要求白宫和国务院承诺在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平即将举行的双边会晤中提出约书亚的案件并呼吁释放他，特别是在我们即将于11月在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议和12月在佛罗里达州举行的20国集团（G20）峰会之际。特朗普政府在优先释放世界各地政治犯方面做了值得称赞的工作。政治犯金明日牧师从中国拘留所获释

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong: Human Rights Organizations Condemn Unjust Sentencing of Joshua Wong zevans@freedom… Thu, 11/05/2026 - 15:23 Type Joint Statement Countries Hong Kong Page blocks We, the undersigned organizations, condemn the November 5th sentencing of Hong Kong prodemocracy advocate Joshua Wong to a 10-year sentence by the Hong Kong High Court. This is the second time he has been sentenced under the Beijing-imposed National Security Law (NSL), which has contributed to the rapid deterioration of basic freedoms in Hong Kong. Joshua, who marked his 30th birthday in prison three weeks ago, rose to prominence as a teenager as the cofounder of the student group Scholarism, which opposed the introduction of pro-Beijing propaganda into Hong Kong's schools. He helped lead the historic 2014 Umbrella Movement and in 2016 created the prodemocracy Demosistō party, which was forced to disband after the approval of the NSL in 2020. He has received international acclaim for his democratic activism, including multiple nominations for the Nobel Peace Prize. As a result of this advocacy, Joshua has been repeatedly imprisoned, and has been detained continuously since November 2020. In 2024, he was sentenced to four years and eight months’ imprisonment on charges of conspiracy to commit subversion in connection with him taking part in the first and only city-wide democratic primary. He was expected to be released in January 2027, but faced additional charges in June 2025 of conspiring to collude with foreign forces for his earlier activism. As part of these charges, prosecutors referred to meetings that Joshua had with US government officials, including then Senator Marco Rubio. This is among a worrying series of attempts by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to restrict and control not only who Chinese citizens and Hong Kongers may meet, but also who foreign government officials may contact and what information they can receive. Additionally, the Beijing-backed Hong Kong government is strongly discouraging residents from viewing and considering further action on the award-winning documentary Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower, which chronicles Joshua's early activism, further demonstrating its efforts to suppress independent accounts of Hong Kong's prodemocracy movement. Joshua's detention also highlights how the CCP continues to flout the Sino-British Joint Declaration. That treaty, negotiated as part of Hong Kong's 1997 handover, enshrines the "one country, two systems" principle that was supposed to prevail until 2047. The CCP's disregard for that principle—demonstrated by Joshua's detention for exercising his fundamental freedoms—calls into question whether deals the CCP negotiates on trade or other issues will be honored. We call on Hong Kong authorities to release Joshua immediately and unconditionally, and we ask that democratic governments more forcefully demand his release. Specifically, we request that the White House and the State Department commit to raising Joshua’s case and calling for his release in the upcoming bilateral meetings between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, particularly as we look to the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in November in Shenzhen, and the Group of 20 (G20) Summit in Florida in December. The Trump administration has done a commendable job prioritizing the release of political prisoners around the world. The release of political prisoner Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri from detention in China earlier this year demonstrates that when the president of the United States intervenes directly, it can make a real, lifesaving difference. 安斯泰来在中国监狱的日本员工将于 12 月获释
- 2026年11月7日 - 21:16 全部,日本,世界
图为2025年3月北京人民大会堂前的监控摄像头。（共同社）==共同社
熟悉日中关系的消息人士周六表示，因从事间谍活动而被关押在中国监狱的安斯泰来制药公司一名日本员工预计将于 12 月获释。
日本制药公司男员工，60多岁，2023年3月被拘留，2025年7月被北京市第二中级人民法院判处有期徒刑三年零六个月。
他将服完全部刑期，其中包括从他被拘留到作出裁决之间的部分时间。消息人士称，他可能会在预期释放后立即被驱逐到日本。
自日本首相高市早苗涉台言论引发外交争端以来，中日关系持续紧张。
该男子在计划返回日本之前被拘留。一名旁听庭审的日本外交官表示，应被定罪男子的要求，他无法透露裁决的细节。
其他知情人士称，在中国当局向他解释了认罪并从轻判刑的法律程序后，他承认了有罪。
他曾担任该制药公司中国部门的高管以及中国日本商工会议所的高级官员。
今年早些时候，富士电机公司的两名日本员工在中国被拘留，可能是因为试图将稀土相关产品运往海外，此前北京方面加强了对运往日本的包括稀土在内的民用和军用两用物品的控制。
日本政府后来证实，他们于 5 月在东北港口城市大连被拘留，原因是涉嫌违反走私违禁货物进出日本的法律，但出于隐私原因，没有透露更多细节。

Astellas' Japanese employee in Chinese prison to be released in Dec.
- Nov 07, 2026 - 21:16 All,Japan,World
Photo shows security cameras in front of the Great Hall of the People in Beijing in March 2025. (Kyodo)==Kyodo
A Japanese employee of Astellas Pharma Inc. held in a Chinese prison for spying is expected to be released in December, sources close to Japan-China relations said Saturday.
The male employee of the Japanese pharmaceutical company, who is in his 60s and was detained in March 2023, was sentenced by Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court in July 2025 to three years and six months in prison.
He would be serving his entire sentence, which includes part of the period between his detention and the ruling. He is likely to be deported to Japan immediately after the expected release, according to the sources.
Sino-Japanese tensions have remained high since a diplomatic row over Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's remarks on Taiwan.
The man was detained just ahead of his scheduled return to Japan. A Japanese diplomat who attended the trial had said that he could not reveal details of the ruling at the request of the convicted man.
Other sources familiar with the matter have said he pleaded guilty after Chinese authorities explained to him the legal process of a guilty plea leading to a lighter sentence.
He had served as an executive at the pharmaceutical company's Chinese unit and a senior official of the Japanese Chamber of Commerce and Industry in China.
Earlier this year, two Japanese employees of Fuji Electric Co. were detained in China possibly over attempts to take rare earth-related products overseas, after Beijing strengthened controls on Japan-bound shipments of dual-use items that can be used for both civilian and military purposes, including rare earths.
The Japanese government later confirmed their detention in May in the northeastern port city of Dalian for allegedly violating a law on smuggling prohibited goods into or out of the country, without disclosing further details for privacy reasons.

summary: 花样滑冰：千叶赢得中国杯，延续日本女子大奖赛连胜 花样滑冰：千叶赢得中国杯，延续日本女子大奖赛连胜 - 2026年11月7日 - 23:07 所有,Sports Japan 选手千叶萌根于2026年11月7日在中国深圳举行的中国杯上表演自由滑。（共同社）日本选手千叶萌根在自由滑后的反应2026 年 11 月 7 日，在中国深圳举行的中国杯滑冰比赛。（共同社）2026 年 11 月 7 日，日本选手千叶萌根在中国深圳赢得中国杯冠军后合影。（共同社）日本选手长冈尤奈（上）和森口纯忠在深圳举行的自由滑比赛中表演双人滑。
content:
花样滑冰：千叶赢得中国杯延续日本女子大奖赛连胜纪录
花样滑冰：千叶赢得中国杯延续日本女子大奖赛连胜纪录
- 2026年11月7日 - 23:07 全部,体育
日本选手千叶萌根于2026年11月7日在中国深圳举行的中国杯上表演自由滑。（共同社）
2026 年 11 月 7 日，日本选手千叶萌根在中国深圳举行的中国杯自由滑比赛中完成自由滑比赛后的反应。（共同社）
2026年11月7日，日本选手千叶萌根在中国深圳赢得中国杯冠军后合影。（共同社）
2026 年 11 月 7 日，日本选手永冈尤奈（上）和森口纯忠在中国深圳举行的中国杯上表演双人自由滑。（共同社）
2026 年 11 月 7 日，在中国深圳举行的中国杯上，日本选手永冈尤奈（左）和森口纯忠在获得铜牌后合影。（共同社）
中国深圳 - 日本选手千叶萌根周六夺得中国杯冠军，将日本女子在大奖赛系列赛季开始时的连胜纪录扩大到三场。
周五的短节目比赛结束后，上赛季世锦赛亚军千叶在深圳自由滑比赛中以总分224.48分的成绩获得148.40分，获得了职业生涯的第三场大奖赛胜利。
过去两周，这位 21 岁的选手与日本冠军中井亚美 (Ami Nakai) 一起参加了法国大奖赛，并与岛田真央 (Mao Shimada) 一起参加了加拿大国际滑冰锦标赛。
“我真的很紧张，但我记得我有多喜欢花样滑冰，”千叶说，除了在最后的组合中以四分之一轮的距离完成三重鲁兹之外，她表现得完美无缺。
“在表演过程中，我能够相信自己并始终保持专注。我能够展示我在训练中所做的努力。”
来自俄罗斯的 2022 年冬奥会银牌得主、个人中立运动员亚历山德拉·伊格纳托娃 (Alexandra Ignatova) 在首场四人组鲁兹 (Lutz) 比赛中以 148.90 的成绩夺得自由滑冠军。她以221.27分获得总成绩第二名，韩国选手李海仁以210.79分获得第三名。
千叶在米兰-科尔蒂纳冬奥会上获得第四名，她在七月份扭伤了右脚踝，缺席了大约一个月的时间，然后最近才康复。
“我很欣慰地度过了难关，”她说。 “我的焦虑在表演时仍然会渗透出来。我想做出调整，这样我就可以充满信心地滑冰。”
日本选手山下真子以193.32分排名第六，渡边凛香以12杆成绩排名第11。
日本选手永冈尤奈 (Yuna Nagaoka) 和森口纯忠 (Sumitada Moriguchi) 在周五的短节目比赛中获得第四名，在周六的自由滑比赛中以 181.50 的总成绩获得第三名，最终获得铜牌，这是她们在大奖赛系列赛中首次登上领奖台。
“我们一直在练习，不惜一切代价获得奖牌，希望能够进入大奖赛决赛。登上领奖台真是太好了，”长冈说。她在四月份右脚跟应力性骨折，八月份在一场交通事故中左脚骨折。
来自俄罗斯的Anastasia Mishina和Aleksandr Galliamov以209.84分获得冠军，格鲁吉亚的Anastasiia Metelkina和Luka Berulava以198.27分获得第二名。

Figure skating: Chiba wins Cup of China to extend Japan women's GP streak
Figure skating: Chiba wins Cup of China to extend Japan women's GP streak
- Nov 07, 2026 - 23:07 All,Sports
Japan's Mone Chiba performs her free skate at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Mone Chiba reacts after her free skate at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Mone Chiba poses for a photo after winning the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Yuna Nagaoka (top) and Sumitada Moriguchi perform their pairs' free skate at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Yuna Nagaoka (L) and Sumitada Moriguchi pose for a photo after winning bronze at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
SHENZHEN, China - Japan's Mone Chiba won the Cup of China on Saturday to extend Japanese women's winning streak to three events at the start of the Grand Prix Series season.
Top after Friday's short program, last season's world championships runner-up Chiba scored 148.40 points in the free skate for a total of 224.48 in Shenzhen, claiming the third Grand Prix victory of her career.
The 21-year-old joined fellow Japanese winners Ami Nakai at the Grand Prix de France and Mao Shimada at Skate Canada International over the past two weeks.
"I was really nervous, but I remembered how much I love figure skating," said Chiba, who was flawless apart from landing her triple Lutz a quarter rotation short in a late combination.
"During the performance, I was able to trust myself and stay focused throughout. I was able to show what I've been working on in training."
Individual Neutral Athlete Alexandra Ignatova, the 2022 Winter Olympics silver medalist from Russia, topped the free skate on 148.90 after landing her opening quadruple Lutz. She came second overall on 221.27 and South Korea's Lee Hae In third on 210.79.
Chiba, who finished fourth at the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics, sprained her right ankle in July and was sidelined for about a month before her recent resurgence.
"I'm relieved to be over the hump," she said. "My anxiety still seeps out during performances. I want to make adjustments so I can skate with full confidence."
Japan's Mako Yamashita was sixth on 193.32 and Rinka Watanabe 11th in the field of 12.
In pairs, Japan's Yuna Nagaoka and Sumitada Moriguchi won bronze for their first podium finish in the Grand Prix Series after finishing fourth in Friday's short program and third in Saturday's free skate for 181.50 overall.
"We've been practicing to get a medal at any cost, hoping to go for a place at the Grand Prix Final. It was really nice to be on the podium," said Nagaoka, who suffered a stress fracture in her right heel in April before fracturing her left foot in August in a traffic accident.
Anastasia Mishina and Aleksandr Galliamov from Russia won on 209.84, with Georgia's Anastasiia Metelkina and Luka Berulava second on 198.27.

summary: 能说中文的电话中心（Callcenter）遍布世界各地图像来源: Tim Goode/PA Wire/picture alliance （德国之声中文网）今年9月2日，林（化名）的手机突然响起，来电告知是“中国大使馆”。接通后，电话那头声称，林的身份在中国被盗用，请赶紧报警。 20多岁的林同父母一道生活在德国西部城市波恩，是中国公民，但她的中国身份证放在国内，多年未使用。林想，身份证在国内被盗是可能的。 对方随即安排了报警，通过Microsoft Teams与一位自称“警官”
content:
能说中文的电话中心（Callcenter）遍布世界各地图像来源: Tim Goode/PA Wire/picture alliance
（德国之声中文网）今年9月2日，林（化名）的手机突然响起，来电告知是“中国大使馆”。接通后，电话那头声称，林的身份在中国被盗用，请赶紧报警。
20多岁的林同父母一道生活在德国西部城市波恩，是中国公民，但她的中国身份证放在国内，多年未使用。林想，身份证在国内被盗是可能的。
对方随即安排了报警，通过Microsoft Teams与一位自称“警官”的男子通话。打开摄像头后，画面中出现一位身穿警服、胸前印有编号的警察，男子实录下林的报案。当林说出真实姓名后，对方关掉摄像头，紧接着，对方问：“你为何不主动说自己卷入了这起案件？”
林开始怀疑对方的真实身份，第二天，男子又打开摄像头，带林“参观”了警察局。林看到办公桌，其他警员，门厅里有警察局徽章，门外的路牌上显示警察局的方向。
对方告诉林，一名持有600张银行卡的嫌疑人在一个机场被捕，其中一张卡写着林的姓名。他说，林的银行卡已被用于跨国洗钱。他要求林不要关闭手提电脑，称随时可以视讯通话。惶恐当中的林，甚至显示了她的银行流水单，“我没有什么可以隐瞒的”。
两周后，对方告知，上面发出对林的逮捕通知，若想不被逮捕，只能向检察官申请押金保释。按照林后来的叙述，对方向林显示对方当场向上级汇报的场景。
林害怕极了，开始借钱、贷款并汇往对方指定的香港和越南的账号。对方说，中国腐败太严重，而现在进行的调查必须保密。林还透露了她即将回国探亲，对方称，鉴于林的风险增大，还需另加赎金。林一共三次汇款，加起来约5.5万欧元。
一个巧合，让林有一天在德国电视一台看到一个诈骗报道，其中的诈骗术跟她自己的经历非常相似，都是假冒中国官员进行电话诈骗。于是，9月24日，林来到波恩一个警察局报案。
故事的结局还是多少有点令人欣慰，林汇给骗子的金额没有全部丢失，三笔汇款中有两笔被当地银行拒绝。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
波恩警察局证实了以上案件的真实性，提醒在德国上学、工作的中国背景的人士，遇到类似事件立即报警，寻求咨询，不要继续接触可疑的对方。
据媒体报道，德国联邦刑警局在一份回复信函中指出，作案者说中文并假冒中国官员，并不能证实诈骗人员一定来自中国。能说中文的电话中心（Callcenter）遍布世界各地。
根据北威州的犯罪记录，说中文并针对中国背景的公民的诈骗活动，没有单独进行归类统计。在北威州，2023年至2026年的不完全统计记录了数起此类案件，总体呈下降趋势。
DW中文有Instagram！欢迎搜寻dw.chinese，看更多深入浅出的图文与影音报道。

在欧盟释放信号，表示愿意让加拿大以“准成员”身份成为其特殊伙伴后，美国总统特朗普对此发出嘲讽，并表示，这一设想属于“敌对行为”。
周一，中共为前总书记江泽民举行百岁冥诞纪念大会。周二，前总理朱镕基的遗体在八宝山公墓火化，天安门等地降半旗致哀。江泽民与朱镕基留给习近平怎样的遗产？习近平能否借助已经逝去的时代安抚当下的民心，进一步巩固自己的权力？
北京香山论坛多国代表对军用人工智能的潜在风险深表担忧。在美中两国准备举行高层会晤之际，武器自主化正急剧压缩决策时间，大国在此类技术管控上的分歧再度引发广泛讨论。
德国30多个城市周六举行青年抗议活动，数万名年轻人借此表达对教育资源、生活成本及环境保护等问题的不满。然而，原本大体和平的示威活动在晚间演变为多地暴力骚乱。
意大利数万学生和工人上街，要求增加教育经费、缓解生活成本压力。
校服已成为色情影片中极为常见的装扮元素。对此，英国女学生们希望做出改变。

Fundraiser by Nurnisa Kurban : Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Nurnisa Kurban is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Uyghur Academic Foundation.
Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.
In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.
During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.
Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.
The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.
Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.
