content:
在 11 月 8 日星期日晚间的一份长声明中，外交部 (DFA) 发出提醒，“所有政府官员，无论是文职官员还是军警官员，都应与总统的政策方向保持一致”，并且“虽然国家安全机构和军警部门提供不可或缺的行动评估和记录实地进展，但文职当局指导国家的国际关系。” “专业建议属于适当的内部渠道，”该部门表示。 “将外交对话描述为不充分、适得其反或次要于公众曝光，会在外交和透明度之间做出错误选择。破坏政府外交方针的公开声明不仅使我们外交官的工作复杂化。它们有可能损害该国在国际事务中的信誉，并塑造出可供外部各方利用的内部分裂形象。此类行动最终可能会削弱菲律宾的谈判地位，”该部门补充道。该信函旨在为该部门辩护，但缺乏具体细节。 DFA到底是在为谁辩护呢？该声明似乎是对西菲律宾海发言人、菲律宾海岸警卫队（PCG）发言人杰伊·塔里拉（Jay Tarriela）海军中将的一种毫不掩饰的回应。塔里拉周末在《询问者报》上发表了一篇评论文章。
他在剖析外交部长马特蕾莎·拉扎罗最近与中国外交部长王毅的通话时，大力支持他的创意——菲律宾的透明度倡议。官方通讯社新华社称，王毅声称“当前中菲关系面临恶意干扰”，“菲律宾少数政客出于政治偏见和私利，屡次攻击抹黑中国”，暗指2026年中北京制裁的国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗。外交部将这次通话描述为“坦诚、务实和建设性”，两人在通话中详细讨论了“双边关系状况”。这次通话是在菲律宾主办东南亚国家联盟 (ASEAN) 峰会以及中国在 11 月中旬主办亚太经合组织 (APEC) 领导人非正式会议之前进行的，马尼拉和北京均声称对方首先推翻了这一通话。
必读 随着东盟峰会临近，菲律宾试图缓解与中国的紧张关系，塔里埃拉在展示透明度倡议时断言：“北京只是要求我们的政府封住本国人民的嘴，特别是那些向公众展示西菲律宾海发生了什么的人。”  外交部在声明中表示：“因此，令人遗憾的是，某些政府官员最近发表的公开评论错误地融合了三个不同的要素：文件证据、公开言论和官方外交信息……但透明度不能取代治国之道。发布视频或塑造在线叙事本身并不能充当海上的物理威慑或法律策略。”  这是一次非常公开的交流，不仅如外交部所说，“投射出内部分裂的形象，供外部各方利用”；它实际上证实了这一点。必读马尼拉观点：总统先生，请在你的西菲律宾海之家下达命令，因为政策甚至个性上存在分歧

【原文 English Original】
In a long statement late Sunday, November 8, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) issued a reminder that “all government officials, both civilian and uniformed, are expected to align with the President’s policy directions” and that “while the national security establishment and the uniformed services provide indispensable operational assessments and document developments on the ground, civilian authority directs the country’s international relations.” “Professional advice belongs in appropriate internal channels,” said the department.  “Portraying diplomatic dialogue as inadequate, counterproductive or secondary to public exposure creates a false choice between diplomacy and transparency. Public statements that undermine the government’s diplomatic approach do more than complicate the work of our diplomats. They risk eroding the country’s credibility in international affairs and project an image of internal division that external parties can exploit. Such actions can ultimately weaken the Philippines’ negotiating position,” the department added.  The missive was pointed in its defense of the department but bereft of specifics.  Just who exactly was the DFA defending itself against?  The statement seems to have been a response — a barely-veiled one, at that, to Vice Admiral Jay Tarriela, spokesperson of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) for the West Philippine Sea. Tarriela, over the weekend, had published an opinion piece in the Inquirer . He advocated for his brainchild, the Philippines’ transparency initiative, in dissecting Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro’s recent phone call with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi. State news agency Xinhua said that Wang claimed that “China-Philippines relations are facing malicious interference at present” and that “a few Philippine politicians, out of political prejudice and self-interest, have repeatedly attacked and smeared China,” an allusion to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr., whom Beijing sanctioned in mid-2026. The DFA characterized the call as “frank, pragmatic, and constructive” where the two talked about “the state of bilateral ties at length.” The phone call — both Manila and Beijing claimed the other made the first overturns — came just before the Philippines hosts the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and China hosts the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting just days after in mid-November. Must Read Philippines tries to ease tensions with China as ASEAN Summit nears Tarriela prefaced his showcase of the transparency initiative by asserting: “Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea.”  The DFA said in their statement: “It is therefore regrettable that recent public commentary made by certain government officials have incorrectly merged three distinct elements: documentary evidence, public rhetoric and official diplomatic messaging…. Yet transparency cannot substitute for statecraft. Releasing footage or shaping an online narrative does not, by itself, act as a physical deterrent at sea or a legal strategy.”  It’s a very public exchange that does not merely “project an image of internal division that external parties can exploit,” as the DFA says; it practically confirms it.  Must Read View from Manila: Mr. President, put order in your West Philippine Sea house That there is disagreement over policy and even personalities in the different agencies — from the uniformed, the diplomatic, the civilian, and even the political — is nothing new. Nor should it be really surprising. The strangeness, perhaps, is on how outward it can be. During the 10th anniversary of the 2016 Arbitral Award, experts and analysts publicly wondered why the DFA and defense community didn’t commemorate the landmark ruling jointly, or at least shared spaces in the same room. Both sectors downplayed the painfully obvious elephant in the room.  Both defense and foreign affairs officials, in varying degrees, have had to downplay or dodge talks about dissonance not just in the approach to China, but, in some cases, the West Philippine Sea, too. External parties will undoubtedly try to exploit any division within the government. They — whoever they are — would be foolish not to do so. But even more foolish are those within who let that division fester. – Rappler.com

川普淡化再空襲可能 布蘭特上周重挫逾16%後續跌向97美元 | 全球財經 | 全球 | 聯合新聞網

儘管航經荷莫茲海峽的船隻屢遭攻擊，波斯灣原油出口已回升至接近戰前水準。路透
國際油價延續上周跌勢，布蘭特原油期貨跌向每桶97美元。美國總統川普表示，若伊朗核子計畫和重開荷莫茲海峽的談判取得進展，美方極不可能再度空襲伊朗。但美國國務卿盧比歐表示，伊朗提出的條件無法接受，談判離突破還很遠。與此同時，荷莫茲海峽又傳出油輪遇襲。
新加坡時間上午7時，布蘭特原油1月期貨下跌0.9%，報每桶97.40美元，西德州中級原油12月期貨下跌0.5%，報90.42美元。布蘭特上周重挫逾16%，創下2020年4月以來最大單周跌幅。民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝後，交易者認為戰火進一步擴大的可能性降低，油價也從10月底的六個月高點回落。
川普周日接受CNN電話訪問時說，是否再度動武，取決於能否簽署一份有力的協議，必要時仍會下令攻擊。他已承認，伊朗戰爭推高油價和汽油價格，是共和黨期中選舉慘敗的原因之一。
盧比歐啟程前往巴黎出席七大工業國集團（G7）外長會議前表示，儘管多國仍在斡旋，談判進展有限，伊朗部分要求也不切實際。伊朗先前要求美方解除對波斯灣港口的海上封鎖並撤銷制裁，才願展開和談。華府則要求伊朗重開荷莫茲海峽，並在核子計畫上讓步。
主要斡旋國卡達表示，伊朗正研究核子活動相關方案。川普近日也和卡達元首通話，討論如何緩和緊張局勢。但伊朗外長阿拉奇周日說，美國期中選舉後，斡旋方近幾天沒有動作。
英國海事貿易行動辦公室表示，接獲通報指出，一艘油輪周末駛出荷莫茲海峽時遭不明物體擊中。伊朗支持的葉門叛軍青年運動組織（Houthi或譯胡塞）也攻擊沙烏地阿美石油公司位於利雅德的辦公室，沙國隨後摧毀兩座飛彈發射裝置。
儘管航經荷莫茲海峽的船隻屢遭攻擊，波斯灣原油出口已回升至接近戰前水準。彭博調查顯示，石油輸出國組織（OPEC）產量也已回升至同一批成員國2月產量的88%。另一方面，烏克蘭一周內已襲擊第六座俄羅斯煉油廠，加大對俄國能源設施的攻勢。
輝達董事會表示，正調查執行長黃仁勳是否成為外國情治機關的目標。黃仁勳也另行發信，承認婚外情。以下是輝達董事會11月8日聲明，以及黃仁勳致全體員工的電子郵件全文。
Axios報導，人工智慧（AI）晶片巨頭輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳在致公司員工的訊息中，承認與一名涉嫌為中國大陸從事間諜活動的女子有婚外情。輝達董事會8日宣布，將對此事展開獨立調查。
輝達執行長黃仁勳近期捲入桃色風波，遭爆疑似曾與中國大陸女間諜黃樂交往之際，長女黃敏珊突然取消原訂八日展開的南韓訪問。美國新聞網站Axios報導，相關疑雲引發美國國會關切，民主黨參議員昆斯說，將針對川普政府與黃仁勳報導展開調查。
輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳坦承與涉嫌替中國從事間諜活動的女子發生婚外情，董事會宣布展開獨立調查，消息衝擊股價。
國際油價延續上周跌勢，布蘭特原油期貨跌向每桶97美元。美國總統川普表示，若伊朗核子計畫和重開荷莫茲海峽的談判取得進展，美方極不可能再度空襲伊朗。但美國國務卿盧比歐表示，伊朗提出的條件無法接受，談判離突破還很遠。與此同時，荷莫茲海峽又傳出油輪遇襲。

content:
Fundraiser by Hillary Johnson : Hong Kong Photojournalism Trip
Hillary Johnson is organizing this fundraiser.
Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong. I have two main threads to my photography practice, photojournalism and fine art.
Though it feels awkward, I confess, I’m pushing ahead because I need your help.
I’m going to Hong Kong on November 12 to cover the protest and the election of a new cabinet in Hong Kong.
You might wonder why bother giving money to me or why my voice particular needs to be added to this news event, or even why this matters to you at all. I hear that and I’ll do my best to answer your questions. I’ll also explain what you can do if you’re interested in helping out.
A little bit about me: in addition to being a photographer I’m also someone who studies a martial art called Ving Tsun. This art is extremely popular in Hong Kong for various reasons that I won’t go into right now but if you’re curious you can ask me and I’ll be happy to answer. It was the practice of this martial art that introduced me to my husband, Matt Johnson who runs a kung fu school here in Chicago.
This martial art has a code of ethics that involves being a good citizen, being humble, promoting peace, and standing up for what is right and protecting those who need protection from bullies and so forth.
I made my first trip to Hong Kong a couple of years ago and I’ve been back a few times since then. Though I’m someone who likes spend a lot of time in remote locations being quiet and letting the busyness of my mind and heart settle down, I felt 100% in love with the city of Hong Kong, it’s culture, it’s people, and of course with my kung fu family there.
As a result it has been difficult watching the news and worrying about this place I love so much and the people who live there.
My concern for all of this led me to do a story for the Chicago Reader.
Here's a link to that: https://www.chicagoreader.com/chicago/photos-hong-kong-protest-freedom/Content?oid=73815391
I’m extremely grateful to the reader for giving me the time and space that it did. I made all the photographs, did all the interviews, and wrote all the text with guidance from the amazing Reader staff. In the process of working on that story I began to see, that much that was going on in Hong Kong seems to not quite be making it into the news. This made me want to go to Hong Kong and do more.
The stories we have been seeing her only the tip of the iceberg. I’m interested in the stories of ordinary people, their everyday life, and what they do.
How do they support each other in the midst of such extreme difficulty?
I want to understand the impact of what’s happening in this interaction between the Beijing mainland Chinese government in the city of Hong Kong in the Hong Kong people.
It’s interesting that Hong Kong has roots and connections stretching out from the city, all over the globe. While working on the story I’ve met many people here in Chicago who have a deep connections to Hong Kong.
I want to go and photograph an interview to help amplify the voices of those people not being heard as much as they might be.
Why do the events Hong Kong matter to you wherever you might live?
Number one. Hong Kong people are simply asking for fundamental human rights to be recognized.
Number two. The Hong Kong people are asking for the promises made by the Chinese government to be kept.
Number three. The Hong Kong people want their freedom.
All people everywhere around the world want their fundamental human rights, they want promises to be kept and they want freedom.
If we all look into our own hearts I believe we will see this truth is self evident.
What’s happening in Hong Kong matters to all of us, because all of us want the same things; freedom, respect- both given and received, dignity, and agency.
Further, for those of us living in other parts of the world, if we think that what’s happening in Hong Kong cannot happen to us wherever it is that we happen to live, I think if you forgive me, that view is naïve.
The road to tyranny is a slippery slope.
First one right is eroded, then another, then another.
For this trip to Hong Kong all the groundwork is in place.
Because of the network being built up over the years and as a result of my recent work, there are people on the ground in Hong Kong ready to help with making connections, translation, safety and getting around and so forth.
My intention is to get to Hong Kong do my work at the photographer and then do my best to get those stories out into the world so that everyone can know what is going on.
But I need help with the expenses.
Airfare and hotel around $2100-2400 depending on flight details
Transportation in Hong Kong When the MTR is shut down taxis may be necessary - estimating maybe $300
Money to pay translators and other fixtures and facilitators estimating $300-500
A laptop to process photos while I’m there so I can send them out to editors at various news outlets - around $200-300
I’m hoping to raise $3500. to cover all of that as well as some of my bills while I’m away so that the lights and heat are still on when I return home.
Addition I’ll provide links to news outlets as well as the story I did for the reader so that you can get more information about the situation over there.
I’ll also link or attach a video that I made about the story.
As things when I’m planning to offer in addition to publicly thinking everyone who supports this is the creation of a private Facebook group where I post updates photos and video from my time in Hong Kong.
This content will be exclusively for anyone who supports this trip.
I’m excited to announce that someone already made a first donation of $500 before even launched this campaign which let me adjust the amount needed to $3500
Honestly I wasn’t even planning on doing this but so many people said to me that they wanted to support the trip and believe in the mission of supporting truth and openness and democracy, that I pushed past my own discomfort and jumped in.
I want to thank all of you in advance for your support and help.
Please know that even if you can’t donate money to this trip, I’d be very grateful for your repeated sharing of the campaign. We all know how this works, and whether we like it or not it requires a certain diligence. A lather rinse and repeat process.
For those of you who can donate, please know how grateful I am for your support. And that no donation is too small or too large.
Again my heartfelt thanks. You should know also that I’ve never felt more sense of mission or purpose in going after story. This has my whole heart and I hope very much but I’ll find out that’s for publishing material of the world to know what is going on in Hong Kong at this critical time in history.
As a final note, I want to add that one of the things I’ve heard lately, is that China may be starting to crack down on the practice of martial arts.
This truly is history repeating itself. This happened during the period of conflict between the Ming and Qing dynasty.
It happened again during the cultural revolution.
And now it’s happening once again.
Why does China always clamp down on martial artists?
Because martial artists, as part of their training, learn how important it is to stand up and fight when it’s necessary. The core of traditional martial arts is about values that respect all people and offer protection to those who need it.
I like to think that with my camera I’m bringing the spirit of kung fu, of the Ving Tsun I love, to my practice using my camera to help protect and defend those in Hong Kong.
I hope that you’ll join me in this fight.
Let me know what questions you may have.
Happy to try my best to answer.
May all be safe, happy, strong and at ease. ❤️

title: Hong Kong to launch paperless securities regime on 16 November
zh_title: 香港将于11月16日推出无纸化证券制度
summary: 香港将于11月16日推出无纸化证券制度 |中国劳工布告栏 星期一, 2026 年 11 月 9 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港将于 11 月 16 日推出无纸化证券制度 香港将于 11 月 16 日推出无纸化证券市场制度，让散户投资者能够以电子方式直接以自己的名义持有股票。首次公开募股将首先实现无纸化，现有上市公司将在五年内完成转型。香港将于11月16日推出无证证券市场制度，允许散户投资者持有
content:
香港将于11月16日推出无纸化证券制度 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港将于11月16日推出无纸化证券制度
香港将于11月16日推出无证证券市场制度，让散户投资者可以通过电子方式直接以自己的名义持有股票。首次公开募股将首先实现无纸化，现有上市公司将在五年内完成转型。
香港将于11月16日推出无证证券市场制度，允许散户投资者以自己的名义直接以电子方式持有股票。此举消除了对实物股票的需求，并引入了一种名为 USI（未经认证的证券基础设施）的新设施。
在新制度下，首次公开募股将首次实现无纸化。根据政府的计划，现有上市公司将在未来五年内分阶段向无纸化股票过渡。
瑞致达董事总经理Pamela Chung Kong-hung表示，虽然新机制赋予股东更大的自主权，并取消银行或经纪托管费，但电子持股仅限于持有而非交易。 “除非你从不打算出售，否则你就离不开经纪账户，”她在电视节目中说道。
Chung 指出，虽然 IPO 投资者通过 USI 收到股票后，可以当日转让给经纪人进行出售，但这并不是即时的。她补充说，这可能会影响希望在上市后立即翻转股票的短期 IPO 交易者。
Chung 表示，即使持有实物证书的投资者最终也可能需要一个 USI 账户，以便在发行人转型后接收以股代息或红股，因为纸质证书将不再打印。

Hong Kong to launch paperless securities regime on 16 November | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong to launch paperless securities regime on 16 November
Hong Kong will launch its uncertificated securities market regime on 16 November, enabling retail investors to hold shares directly in their own names electronically. IPOs will go paperless first, with existing listed firms transitioning over five years.
Hong Kong will launch its uncertificated securities market regime on 16 November, allowing retail investors to hold shares directly in their own names electronically. The move eliminates the need for physical share certificates and introduces a new facility called USI (Uncertificated Securities Infrastructure).
Initial public offerings will be the first to go paperless under the new regime. Existing listed companies will transition to paperless shares in phases over the next five years, according to the government's plan.
While the new mechanism gives shareholders greater autonomy and eliminates bank or brokerage custody fees, the electronic holdings are strictly for holding rather than trading, said Pamela Chung Kong-hung, managing director of Vistra. “Unless you never plan to sell, you cannot do without a brokerage account,” she said at a TV programme.
Chung noted that while same-day transfers to brokers for sale are possible after IPO investors receive shares via USI, they are not instantaneous. This may affect short-term IPO traders looking to flip shares immediately on debut, she added.
Even investors keeping physical certificates may eventually need a USI account to receive scrip dividends or bonus shares once an issuer transitions, as paper certificates will no longer be printed, Chung said.

content:
中国首型舰载隐身无人机“攻击-21”在076型两栖攻击舰四川舰上成功起降。 （央视视频截图）
中国首型舰载察打一体隐身无人机“攻击-21”在076型两栖攻击舰四川舰上成功起降后，中国军事专家提出，四川舰未来可与航母福建舰协同作战，形成由航母负责主要攻击任务、两栖攻击舰承担兵力投送或无人机支援任务的海上作战体系。
据央视新闻星期天（11月8日）报道，中国中央广播电视总台军事观察员魏东旭指出，同样采用电磁弹射技术的福建舰与四川舰，未来可采取两种搭配作战的模式。
第一种是由福建舰负责主要攻击任务，四川舰承担兵力运输和投送。航母编队可在两栖作战期间争夺制空权、制海权和制电磁权，为四川舰投送登陆部队提供掩护。
第二种是福建舰主攻、四川舰辅助。四川舰可搭载更多“攻击-21”隐身无人机，转变为“无人机航母”，和福建舰构成“1+1＞2”的海上作战体系。
魏东旭认为，“攻击-21”未来也可在福建舰上起降，与歼-35隐身舰载战斗机进行联合作战。无人机可先行深入敌方防御区域，把对方的防御体系、预警体系打掉，歼-35则可提供掩护、共享情报及下达作战指令。
他也提出，福建舰上的歼-35或歼-15T战斗机，未来可能直接指挥从四川舰起飞的“攻击-21”，对远距离目标实施打击。
中国官媒此前报道，“攻击-21”于10月下旬首次在四川舰上成功起降。这款无人机采用无尾飞翼设计，具备隐身侦察及打击能力，去年9月在北京阅兵式上首次公开亮相。
中国国防部上星期五（11月6日）证实上述起降试验，称这是中国军队发展新型作战力量取得的重要阶段性成果。
福建舰则于去年11月5日正式入列，是中国第三艘航空母舰，也是首艘采用电磁弹射技术的中国航母。舰载机包括歼-35隐身战斗机、歼-15T战斗机、歼-15DT电子战飞机和空警-600预警机等。
魏东旭认为，空警-600可扩大航母编队的预警和指挥能力，歼-15DT则可通过电子干扰压制对方雷达及通信系统，进一步提升福建舰编队的综合作战能力。

中新网台北11月8日电 波兰克拉科夫市发生大规模枪击事件，造成至少6人死亡、15人受伤，台湾政府周日向遇难者及其家人表示哀悼。
外交部在给中央社的一份声明中表示，外交部长林佳龙向遇难者及其家属表示哀悼和慰问，并祝愿伤者早日康复。

外交部表示，如遇紧急情况，在波兰的台胞可拨打外交部免费热线0800-085-095寻求紧急援助。
据外媒报道，周六下午（当地时间），一名枪手驾车驶入克拉科夫主广场并随机开枪，造成至少6人死亡、15人受伤。
报道称，警方在交火中开枪打伤嫌疑人，然后将其拘留。

Taiwan sends condolences after mass shooting in Polish city of Kraków
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 8 (CNA) Taiwan's government on Sunday extended its condolences to the victims of a mass shooting in the Polish city of Kraków and their families, after the incident left at least six people dead and 15 injured.
Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) expressed condolences and sympathy to the victims and their families and wished those injured a speedy recovery, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said in a statement to CNA.
According to Taiwan's representative office in Poland, there have so far been no indications that any Taiwanese nationals were among the casualties, MOFA said.
The representative office has activated emergency response measures and is maintaining close contact with Polish police and relevant authorities to obtain the latest updates about the incident, the ministry said.
In the event of an emergency, Taiwanese nationals in Poland can call the ministry's toll-free hotline at 0800-085-095 to seek urgent assistance, MOFA said.
At least six people were killed and 15 others injured after a gunman drove into Kraków's Main Square and opened fire at random on Saturday afternoon (local time), according to foreign media reports.
Police shot and wounded the suspect during an exchange of gunfire before taking him into custody, the reports said.

东北风将导致台湾北部气温下降 - 焦点台湾
东北风将导致台湾北部气温下降
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月8日电 据中央气象局称，随着秋季最强东北风的到来，预计从周日晚上开始，台湾北部和宜兰县气温将下降10摄氏度。
CWA预报员王品翔告诉中央社，本季迄今为止最重要的天气系统将影响台湾至周三。
预计周一台湾北部白天最高气温将下降约 10 度，至 21-22 摄氏度，周二进一步降至 19-20 度。王说，预计周二清晨最低气温将达到 17-18 度。
台湾中部和南部也将降温，周一最高气温约为 25 度，隔夜最低气温接近 20 度。
从周三开始，气温将逐渐回升，台湾中部、南部和东部地区最高可达28-30度，台湾北部和宜兰最高可达26-28度。预计这些气温将在整个周末保持稳定。
气象局预计，周一台湾全境有降雨，其中大台北、宜兰等地局地有大雨，花莲、台东可能有零星阵雨。
该机构表示，周二和周三，桃园以北地区以及台湾东部和东北部地区将持续阵雨。
从周四到下周日，东风将带来更加稳定的天气和逐渐干燥的天气。预计东海岸只会有零星阵雨，而周末台湾大部分地区将出现晴到部分多云的天气。
与此同时，2026年太平洋风暴季节第31个命名风暴热带风暴千百卡于周日下午位于台湾最南端鹅銮鼻岬以东约1,690公里处。
王说，预计周一将转向东北，不会对台湾构成直接威胁。

Taipei, Nov. 8 (CNA) Temperatures in northern Taiwan and Yilan County are expected to drop by up to 10 degrees Celsius starting Sunday night as the strongest northeasterly winds of the fall move in, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).
CWA forecaster Wang Pin-hsiang (王品翔) told CNA that the weather system, the most significant of its kind so far this season, will affect Taiwan through Wednesday.
Daytime highs in northern Taiwan are forecast to fall by about 10 degrees to 21-22 degrees Celsius on Monday, before dropping further to just 19-20 degrees on Tuesday. Early morning lows on Tuesday are expected to reach 17-18 degrees, Wang said.
Central and southern Taiwan will also cool, with highs on Monday of around 25 degrees and overnight lows near 20 degrees.
Temperatures will gradually rebound starting Wednesday, with highs climbing to 28-30 degrees in central, southern and eastern Taiwan and 26-28 degrees in northern Taiwan and Yilan. These temperatures are forecast to remain steady through the weekend.
The CWA forecast some rainfall around Taiwan on Monday, with localized heavy rain expected for Greater Taipei and Yilan and scattered showers likely in Hualien and Taitung.
Showers will persist Tuesday and Wednesday in areas north of Taoyuan and across eastern and northeastern Taiwan, the agency said.
From Thursday through next Sunday, easterly winds will bring more stable weather and gradually drier conditions. Only isolated showers are expected along the east coast, while most of Taiwan will see sunny to partly cloudy skies over the weekend.
Meanwhile, Tropical Storm Cempaka, the 31st named storm of the 2026 Pacific storm season, was located about 1,690 kilometers east of Cape Eluanbi, Taiwan's southernmost point, on Sunday afternoon.
It is forecast to turn toward the northeast on Monday and poses no direct threat to Taiwan, Wang said.

（中央社記者王鴻國新北8日電）國民黨新北市長參選人李四川今天參加「董事長開講粉絲見面會」表示，沒有想過到了68歲才要選舉。很多人說他年紀大，這個是缺點，其實，年紀大是優點，有對手所沒有的經驗。
國民黨新北市長參選人李四川、台北市長蔣萬安及國民黨立委徐巧芯、羅智強、洪孟楷、葉元之等人參加由媒體人吳子嘉主持的「董事長開講粉絲見面會」。
蔣萬安表示，他忍痛割愛把無價之寶的李四川送到新北市，所以拜託大家一定要好好的珍惜川伯（李四川）、愛護川伯，讓川伯帶領新北繼續的往前邁進。
蔣萬安表示，台北有萬安，新北有川伯，讓萬川連線一起贏得勝選。讓雙北共榮、共好。希望雙北繼續的攜手努力、並肩作戰，讓兩座城市一起進步，一起為所有的市民打造更大的福祉，台北要贏，新北要贏，雙北一起往前行。
李四川表示，他從漁村長大，實在不知道、也沒有想過要來選舉，而且到了68歲才要選舉。很多人說他年紀大，這個是缺點，但他要說「我年紀大，所以這個是優點。因為我的年紀大，我的經驗是我對手沒有的」。
李四川細數推動大巨蛋、小巨蛋及和蔣萬安把輝達引進台灣、台北市，「我的對手有這個能力嗎？」所以經驗是重要的，有經驗就會有方法。
李四川說，他今天有一點動怒，為什麼立法院三讀通過健保費補助的修法來照顧長輩，行政院不副署卻又要新北市民投票給他的對手，這樣公平嗎？呼籲大家用選票來讓行政院長卓榮泰來副署。
他表示，他今天說明為什麼要在68歲時還希望投入選舉，就是要告訴所有的鄉親，除了建設是他的專業外，也要給所有的年輕人一個希望，讓他們看到從漁村出來、從基層公務人員出身的他，有一天，大家也可以像他一樣來選新北市的市長，只要努力，就有機會。
李四川表示，他對於選舉是外行，真的不會選舉。但仍呼籲大家一定要出來投票，因為大家的一票，才能改變新北市，也會改變台北市，只有用大家的一票，才能決定新北市跟台北市的未來。（編輯：張國政）1151108

10 月 25 日，支持者和退伍军人在悉尼举行集会，反对联邦政府出售历史悠久的维多利亚军营的提议。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 8 日 09:30
更新于 2026 年 11 月 8 日 03:07 PM
在因出售 60 多处国防财产的计划遭到强烈反对后，澳大利亚将把悉尼维多利亚兵营和其他历史悠久的军事遗址保留在公众手中。
总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯表示，军营“在我们国家的历史上占有特殊的地位”；国防部称其拥有“重要遗产”，其历史可以追溯到 1840 年。
随着澳大利亚对中国军事力量的崛起作出反应，取消的销售预计将筹集 30 亿澳元，并帮助资助更强大的国防。
悉尼—在剥离未充分利用的国防财产的计划遭到强烈反对后，澳大利亚将保留包括悉尼军营在内的数个历史性军事遗址。
澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 11 月 8 日表示，政府出售全国 60 多个军事基地的提案将排除悉尼维多利亚军营等设施之一。
他说，该网站将保留在“公众手中”，并可供“所有悉尼人使用”。
他说：“在对国防地产进行审查后确定的 67 个国防基地中，这是四个国防基地之一，这些国防基地将保留为公有制。”
阿尔巴尼斯说，其他禁止出售的地点包括墨尔本维多利亚兵营、维多利亚的昆斯克利夫堡和墨尔本边缘库克角的一处空军设施。
这一逆转是在寻求保护澳大利亚军事历史的团体对撤资努力提出批评之后发生的。
此次销售预计将产生 30 亿澳元（26.4 亿新元），这可能有助于为提高澳大利亚国防能力的计划提供资金，部分原因是为了应对中国不断增强的军事能力。
“我们面临着二战以来最复杂、在某些方面最具威胁的战略格局，因此我们的政府大幅增加了国防开支，”国防部长理查德·马勒斯在与阿尔巴内塞一起发言时说道。
Marles 表示，政府已将 67 个地点中的 11 个移交给财政部。
澳大利亚国防部表示，悉尼军营建于 1840 年，最初是英国陆军的驻地，该部门将这里视为“重要遗产”。彭博社

Published Nov 08, 2026, 09:30 AM

Australia will keep Victoria Barracks Sydney and other historic military sites in public hands after backlash over plans to sell more than 60 defence properties.
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the barracks has “a special place in our nation’s history”; Defence says it has “significant heritage” and dates to 1840.
The scrapped sales were expected to raise A$3 billion and help fund stronger defence, as Australia responds to China’s rising military power.
SYDNEY – Australia will retain several historic military sites including barracks in Sydney, following a backlash over plans to divest underused defence properties.
Victoria Barracks Sydney is among a group of facilities that will be excluded from a government proposal to sell more than 60 military sites across the country, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Nov 8.
The site will remain in “public hands,” and be available “for all Sydneysiders to enjoy,” he said.
“This is one of four defence sites out of the 67 that were identified by the review into the defence estate that will be kept in public ownership,” he said.
Other sites to be shielded from sale include Victoria Barracks Melbourne, Fort Queenscliff in Victoria and an air force facility in Point Cook on Melbourne’s fringe, Albanese said.
The reversal follows criticism of the divestment efforts from groups seeking to preserve Australia’s military history.
The sales will generate an estimated A$3 billion (S$2.64 billion), which could help fund plans to increase Australia’s defence capacity, partly in response to China’s rising military capabilities.
“We face the most complex, in some ways the most threatening strategic landscape that we have faced since the Second World War and as a result of that our government has significantly increased defence expenditure,” said Minister for Defence Richard Marles, speaking alongside Albanese.
The government has transferred 11 of the 67 sites to the Department of Finance, Marles said.
The Sydney barracks was established in 1840 and initially housed the British Army, according to Australia’s Defence department, which attributes “significant heritage” to the site. BLOOMBERG

Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture’ after $6.3 billion hack
Binance’s chief financial officer Kaiser Ng is leaving the cryptocurrency exchange.
According to Bloomberg, co-CEO Yi He said in a statement that Ng’s departure will allow him to “pursue a new venture after more than five years at Binance,” and that a transition plan has been “implemented over the last half year.”
The announcement comes barely more than a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of cryptocurrency from Binance users. The company froze withdrawals for several days; after accounts were unfrozen, users withdrew a net $3.6 billion in the first few hours.
Binance and the FBI blamed a North Korean group called TraderTraitor for the hack. The company also said that it would cover all losses, promising, “Binance will bear the financial impact of the stolen funds. These losses will not be passed on to users.”
Ng will be replaced as CFO by Justin Yek.

Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
A memo circulated earlier this year claimed that technology executive Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to multiple media reports.
The New York Times, which had previously said Nvidia’s chief executive had been the target of Chinese intelligence, was the first to report on the memo. The Financial Times subsequently reported that the memo — supposedly based on U.S. intelligence — also claimed Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed.
An Nvidia spokesperson told the NYT that Jensen Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang were “not unusual,” and that the company does not share classified information with its customers.
A separate NYT report examined New Matrix, a Chinese company authorized by the U.S. Commerce Department to buy advanced Nvidia chips. But at the office address listed by New Matrix, reporters only found “a hollow gray shell,” raising concerns that it could be a front for a blacklisted private equity firm.
The Nvidia spokesperson said the company sells “the first, best and most of our technology in America.”

Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 是一个经常参加大量会议的人，今天他繁忙的日程中又增加了一次会议。美国国会希望就国家安全日益加剧的担忧与黄进行闭门会谈。争取他的时间的国会议员表示，上周的报告促使他可能成为据报道的中国资产间谍活动的目标：Megaspeed 执行官 Alice Huang（与家人无关）。深入了解 TH Premium：AI 和数据中心（图片来源：Microsoft） 数据中心冷却现状 定制 AI ASIC 现状 美国的 AI 芯片规则不断变化 - 世界其他地区正在付出代价 GTC 2026：Ian Buck 新闻问答记录 - 超大规模和 HPC 副总裁就今年搁置 CPX 和运输 LPU 解码发表讲话 对数据中心 CPU 的需求激增，AI 代理负责 该会议由共和党众议院代表 John 组织穆勒纳尔、布莱恩·马斯特和里克·克劳福德分别担任众议院中国委员会、外交事务委员会和情报委员会主席。在众议院关于此事的信函中，议员们表示，上述报道“引发了对中国获取美国技术和信息的重大国家安全担忧”。此前报道的说法是，Alice Huang 是新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的中国工厂，正在向北京窃取信息。
《华尔街日报》进一步声称，她因与黄仁勋的现有关系而被中国当局招募。 据《纽约时报》报道，Megaspeed 购买并继续购买价值数十亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片，并自 2024 年以来被美国商务部指控向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的先进芯片。这种情况的背景是，美国长期以来实行出口管制，阻止英伟达和AMD最先进的人工智能加速器芯片进入中国和其他一些国家。这些指控上周首次在《纽约时报》上发表，据报道来自未透露姓名的美国情报官员。众议院表示，与黄仁勋举行简报的目的是讨论“英伟达针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议以及[他]与[...]爱丽丝·黄的互动。”据《纽约时报》报道，首席执行官从未收到过“防御简报”，本质上是对外国间谍活动的潜在目标的警告，让他们熟悉此类活动的迹象。该出版物指出，情报官员常常不愿告知潜在的间谍目标，因为这样做可能会让间谍意识到他们正在接受调查。 《纽约时报》补充说，特朗普总统一年前曾获悉有关 Megaspeed 和 Alice Huang 的情况，但选择不采取行动。
据《华尔街日报》报道，新加坡当局对 Megaspeed 展开了自己的调查，甚至据报道直接询问了 Alice Huang。不过，该国的官方回应告诉《华尔街日报》，新加坡“不执行外国司法管辖区实施的单方面出口管制”，并补充说，在调查 Megaspeed 时，并不是针对 Alice Huang 本人，也不是检查她声称与黄仁勋或中国的关系。 《新加坡人》确实指出，该国对商业欺诈采取“零容忍立场”，并指出该国已因此类不当行为对四家公司和四名个人提出指控，他们可能面临最高 20 年的监禁。与此同时，台湾似乎也在密切关注A

The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) further claims that she was recruited by Chinese authorities due to her existing relationship with Jensen Huang. Megaspeed reportedly bought and continues to buy billions' worth of Nvidia's chips, according to The New York Times (NYT), and stands accused by the Department of Commerce since 2024 of smuggling $2 billion worth of advanced silicon to China. The backdrop for the situation is that the U.S. has long-standing export controls blocking Nvidia and AMD's most advanced AI accelerator chips from reaching China, among a number of other nations. The allegations were first published last week in the NYT, and are reportedly sourced from unnamed U.S. intelligence officials. The House says the purpose of the briefing with Jensen Huang is to discuss "Nvidia's security protocols against foreign adversary espionage and [his] interactions with [...] Alice Huang." According to the NYT, the CEO never got a "defensive briefing," essentially a warning for potential targets of foreign espionage, to acquaint them with signs of such activities. The publication notes that intelligence officials often hesitate to inform potential targets of espionage, as doing so may make the spy aware they're being investigated. The NYT adds that President Trump was briefed on the situation surrounding Megaspeed and Alice Huang a year ago, but chose not to act on it. According to the WSJ, Singaporean authorities opened their own probe into Megaspeed, and even reportedly questioned Alice Huang directly. However, an official response from the country told the WSJ that it "does not implement unilateral export controls imposed by foreign jurisdictions," adding that while it's investigating Megaspeed, it's not targeting Alice Huang herself or inspecting her claimed ties with Jensen Huang or China. The Singaporean does note that the country has "a zero-tolerance stance" on commercial fraud, pointing out that it's charged four companies and four individuals over such wrongdoings, and that they may face up to 20 years in prison. Meanwhile, Taiwan is also seemingly keeping a close eye on Alice Huang, by inspecting her visits to the nation. The WSJ says that the country's authorities are probing her involvement with China and have her under physical surveillance. As for Nvidia, the company seemingly reposted today the same comments it offered us last week, stating that "meetings with customers are part of a CEO's job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year." The firm adds that "[its] regional cloud customers receive ordinary business information — not sensitive NVIDIA trade secrets — and zero information relevant to national security."

title: Analysis: China’s quarterly CO2 falls 3% in largest drop since Covid
zh_title: 分析：中国季度二氧化碳排放量下降 3%，创新冠疫情以来最大降幅
summary: 由于霍尔木兹危机继续打击石油需求，煤炭使用量也下降，2026年第三季度中国二氧化碳（CO2）排放量下降了3.1%。这篇客座文章作者：Lauri Myllyvirta，能源与清洁空气研究中心首席分析师 这是自 2022 年新冠疫情封锁以来最大的季度减排量，意味着中国的二氧化碳排放量今年迄今已估计下降了 0.5%。 Carbon Brief 根据官方数据和商业数据进行的新分析显示，2026 年第三季度煤炭使用量同比下降 3%，而石油使用量则同比下降 3%。
content:
由于霍尔木兹危机继续打击石油需求，煤炭使用量也下降，2026年第三季度中国二氧化碳（CO2）排放量下降了3.1%。这篇客座文章作者：Lauri Myllyvirta，能源与清洁空气研究中心首席分析师 这是自 2022 年新冠疫情封锁以来最大的季度减排量，意味着中国的二氧化碳排放量今年迄今已估计下降了 0.5%。 Carbon Brief基于官方数据和商业数据的新分析显示，2026年第三季度煤炭使用量同比下降3%，而石油使用量下降4%。主要驱动因素是电力行业煤炭消费下降、交通运输油消费持续大幅下降以及煤化工增速放缓。中国二氧化碳排放量的大幅下降延续了自2024年3月开始至今已持续两年多的“持平或下降”趋势，如下图所示。本分析的先前迭代中列出的数据源。中国二氧化碳排放的前景取决于不断增长的能源需求、清洁能源增长和政府对GDP放缓的反应之间的平衡。下降驱动因素 2026 年第三季度二氧化碳排放量下降的主要驱动因素包括煤炭发电量下降 3.3%，原因是需求增长放缓以及“浪费”的风能和太阳能发电量下降。
太阳能、风能和核能发电量同比增长110太瓦时（TWh），是总电力需求增长量的两倍多。这相当于德国同期总发电量。尽管中国继续以接近创纪录的速度建设新的煤电产能，但煤电产量和二氧化碳排放量仍出现下降。这意味着燃煤电厂的平均运行时间下降速度甚至超过总发电量下降速度，从而侵蚀了它们的利润。与此同时，运输石油消耗继续大幅下降，2026年第三季度同比下降9%。电动汽车(EV)继续扩大市场份额，9月份创下了乘用车销量的67%和重型卡车销量的50%的纪录。电动汽车的用电量增长了 53%，远远快于道路上电动汽车的数量，这表明现有车队的使用量比燃油汽车的使用量有所增加。其他方面，煤化工行业增长在2026年第三季度继续放缓。该行业一直是排放增长的主要来源，但煤炭价格高企削弱了盈利能力，而较高的产出价格损害了下游需求。最后，随着建筑量收缩加速，水泥和钢铁生产的二氧化碳排放量在第三季度继续下降。
排放展望新冠疫情期间经历了一段时期的异常高增长后，能源消费增长一直在下降，而清洁能源增长强劲。这使得今年清洁发电的增长可能超过能源需求总量的增长，从而维持化石燃料使用的结构性下降。展望未来，这种平衡还依赖于消除新太阳能和风能并网障碍的进展，这会导致一些清洁电力被“浪费”。最近能源需求增长放缓的部分原因（但并非全部原因）是第三季度异常温和的天气。另一个关键因素是GDP增长疲软。然而，由于报告的GDP增长仍在目标范围内

【原文 English Original】
China’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions fell by 3.1% in the third quarter of 2026, as the Hormuz crisis continued to hit oil demand and coal use also dropped. This guest post is by: Lauri Myllyvirta, lead analyst at the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air This was the largest quarterly reduction since the 2022 Covid lockdowns and means that China’s CO2 emissions have now fallen by an estimated 0.5% in the year to date. The new analysis for Carbon Brief, based on official figures and commercial data, shows that coal use fell by 3% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, while oil was down 4%. The main drivers were a fall in power-sector coal consumption, a continued sharp reduction in transport oil consumption and slowing growth in the coal-to-chemical industry. The sharp decline in China’s CO2 emissions extends a “ flat or falling ” trend that began in March 2024 and has now lasted more than two years, as shown in the figure below. Data sources as listed in previous iterations of this analysis. The outlook for China’s CO2 emissions depends on the balance between rising energy demand, clean-energy growth and the government response to a GDP slowdown . Decline drivers Key drivers of the fall in CO2 in the third quarter of 2026 included a 3.3% drop in coal-power generation, after demand growth slowed and the amount of “ wasted ” wind and solar fell. Power generation from solar, wind and nuclear increased by 110 terawatt hours (TWh) year-on-year, more than twice as much as the growth in total electricity demand. This added clean-power generation equal to Germany’s total power output in the same time period. The fall in coal-power output and CO2 emissions came despite the fact that China continues to build new coal-power capacity at near-record rates . This means that average running hours for coal plants are falling even faster than total generation, eroding their profits. Meanwhile, transport oil consumption continued to fall sharply, down 9% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026. Electric vehicles (EVs) continued to gain market share, hitting a record 67% of passenger car sales and 50% of heavy trucks in September. The amount of electricity used by EVs grew by 53%, much faster than the number of EVs on the road, showing increased usage of the existing fleet in preference to fuelled vehicles. Elsewhere, growth in the coal-to-chemical industry continued to slow down in the third quarter of 2026. The sector has been a key source of emissions growth, but high coal prices have weakened profitability and higher output prices hurt downstream demand . Finally, CO2 emissions from cement and steel production continued to fall in the third quarter, as the contraction in construction volumes accelerated . Outlook for emissions Energy consumption growth has been falling after a period of exceptionally high growth during Covid, while clean-power growth has been robust . This makes it likely that the growth in clean-power generation will exceed total energy demand growth this year, maintaining the structural fall in fossil-fuel use. Looking ahead, this balance also relies on progress in removing barriers to new solar and wind power being added to the grid, which result in some clean electricity being “ wasted ”. The recent slowdown in energy demand growth is partly – but not fully – explained by exceptionally mild weather in the third quarter. Another key factor is weaker GDP growth . Since reported GDP growth remains within target , however, there is reduced pressure for further stimulus policies. The focus of the economic stimulus announced to date is “six networks”, which includes the power grid and the transportation network. Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Taiwanese table tennis player Chen Min-hsin (陳忞昕) won the women's singles title at the 2026 Dakar Youth Olympic Games on Thursday (local time), securing Taiwan's first-ever table tennis gold medal at the Youth Olympics.
Chen, 17, defeated Singapore's Loy Ming Ying in the gold medal match in Dakar, Senegal.
After taking a 2-1 lead in games, Chen struggled in the fourth game, which she eventually lost to Loy.
Chen regained control in the fifth game, converting one of three game points to take a 3-2 lead.
The two players were tied at 10-10 in the sixth game before Chen won the next two points to clinch the gold medal.
The victory marked Taiwan's first table tennis gold medal at the Youth Olympics and its fourth medal in the sport since making its debut at the Games in 2010.
Chen said the final was difficult, but she tried to maintain a steady pace and focus on one point at a time.
She also kept reminding herself to push through despite feeling exhausted.
Her coach, Huang Sheng-cheng (黃聖盛), said Loy, the tournament's 10th seed, delivered high-quality serves, but Chen eventually adjusted her tactics and disrupted her opponent's rhythm.
The Youth Olympic Games is an international sporting event organized by the International Olympic Committee for athletes generally aged 14 to 18.

content: ——当国家安全成为打压民主的工具 失去的将不仅是一个人的自由 从少年学生到民主运动的代表人物，从街头抗争到铁窗生涯，黄之锋的人生经历，折射出香港过去十多年来政治环境发生的巨大变化。资料图片。（孙明国／大纪元） 【大纪元2026年11月07日讯】2026年11月5日，香港民主运动人士、前香港众志秘书长黄之锋，被香港高等法院判处监禁10年。 这个消息令人震惊，也令人心痛。 一个年仅30岁的年轻人，从十几岁开始投身香港社会运动，经历了2014年的雨伞运动、2019年的反送中运动，最终却在自己人生最宝贵的青春岁月中，长期被关押在监狱里。 从少年学生到民主运动的代表人物，从街头抗争到铁窗生涯，黄之锋的人生经历，折射出香港过去十多年来政治环境发生的巨大变化。 这不仅仅是黄之锋一个人的悲剧，更是香港民主自由不断萎缩的历史缩影。 一、从雨伞运动到反送中：一代香港青年的民主理想 2014年，香港爆发雨伞运动。无数年轻人走上街头，要求真正的民主选举，要求香港人能够决定自己的未来。 当时的黄之锋还是一名年轻学生。他与许多香港青年一样，相信民主、自由、法治和公民权利，相信一个社会应当允许不同声音存在。 2019年，反送中运动再次席卷香港。 数以百万计的香港市民走上街头，表达对修订《逃犯条例》的担忧，也表达对香港自治、法治和自由前景的忧虑。 这场运动让全世界重新关注香港。 然而，运动之后，香港的政治环境发生了深刻变化。2020年6月30日，《香港国安法》实施，民主派组织相继解散，许多民主人士被捕、被起诉，新闻媒体和公民社会也受到巨大冲击。 香港曾经引以为傲的自由开放形象，正在发生根本性的变化。 二、十年刑期背后：国家安全与公民自由的冲突 根据中央社报导，黄之锋此次被控的罪名，是串谋勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全罪。 案件涉及他与罗冠聪等人，在2020年期间呼吁外国采取制裁等措施。 黄之锋此前已经因为香港民主派立法会初选案，被判处4年8个月监禁。此次又被判处10年。 值得注意的是，法院裁定其中2个月2日与原有刑期同期执行。 对于这一判决，我们不能只停留在法律条文和刑期数字上，更应该追问一个根本问题： 一个社会究竟应当如何界定国家安全？公民表达政治诉求、寻求国际社会关注，是否就应该被视为危害国家安全？ 国家安全固然重要，但国家安全不应成为无限扩大权力、压制公民基本权利的理由。 真正有信心的政府，应当允许社会批评，接受公众监督，尊重不同政治意见。 如果一个政府无法容忍批评，甚至将政治异见视为国家安全威胁，那么受到损害的，不只是个人自由，更是整个社会的法治基础。 三、香港的悲剧 是中共承诺与现实之间的巨大落差 香港回归之初，国际社会关注的核心问题之一，就是香港能否保持原有的生活方式和制度。 一国两制的承诺，曾经让香港人对未来抱有希望。 香港之所以能够成为国际金融中心，不仅因为它拥有优越的地理位置和经济条件，更因为它曾经拥有相对独立的司法制度、开放的信息环境、自由的新闻媒体以及受到保障的公民权利。 这些制度优势，是香港最宝贵的财富。 然而，当政治权力不断扩大，当新闻自由受到压缩，当民主人士因为政治活动而长期失去人身自由，香港原有的制度优势也必然受到冲击。 一个国际城市的竞争力，不能仅仅依靠高楼大厦、金融市场和经济数据来维持。 自由、法治、诚信和制度保障，同样是不可替代的基础。 失去这些，香港失去的将不仅是过去的光环，更可能是未来的国际信任。 四、压制可以让街头安静 却无法消灭人民对自由的向往 历史一再证明，强权可以控制一时的社会秩序，却无法永远控制人的思想。 香港民主运动经历了挫折，许多参与者被迫离开家园，有人身陷囹圄，有人流亡海外，也有人选择沉默。 但是，民主、自由和人权并不是某一个政治组织的专利，而是人类社会共同追求的基本价值。 黄之锋被判刑10年，令人看到一个年轻人的人生被长期监禁所改变，也让世界重新思考香港的自由究竟走向何方。 我们不应该因为一个人身陷囹圄，就认为他的理想也随之消失。 历史不会因为监狱的大门关闭，就停止记录一个时代的真相。 五、香港的今天 也应该成为中国未来的警示 香港曾经是中国与自由世界之间重要的桥梁。 它向世界证明，华人社会同样能够拥有自由、法治、民主和繁荣。 香港的民主运动，也让更多中国大陆民众看到，追求公民权利、要求政府接受监督，并不是所谓的西方专利，而是每一个现代社会公民都应当享有的权利。 今天香港所经历的一切，也值得中国大陆人民深思。 一个国家真正的强大，不是让所有人只说一种声音，而是能够容纳不同意见；不是让人民对权力保持恐惧，而是让权力接受人民监督。 一个政府的合法性和社会公信力，不应建立在恐惧和沉默之上，而应建立在人民的信任、法律的公正以及公民权利的保障之上。 香港的自由不能成为历史，中国的民主也不应该成为遥不可及的梦想。 黄之锋案再次提醒我们：民主的道路可能曲折，自由的代价有时沉重，但一个民族不能因为恐惧而放弃对尊严的追求。 十年铁窗，锁住的是一个人的身体，却不应该成为一个时代思想的牢笼。 对于香港，我们希望有一天能够重新拥有真正的新闻自由、司法独立、民主选举和公民权利。 对于中国，我们期待一个不再以政治恐惧统治人民、不再把不同声音视为敌人的民主社会。 自由不应当是罪名，民主不应当是禁忌，人权更不应当成为任何政权可以随意剥夺的东西。 这是黄之锋案留给香港、留给中国，也留给整个自由世界的一道严肃考题。

content:
Fundraiser by Hong Kong Forum : 自由雕塑公園之『香港地』香港抗爭者雕像金屬牌匾 及 新壁畫
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
Hong Kong Forum is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles.
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
5年過去了，彷彿一切烽煙已經在時間中沈沒，然而有些人仍然選擇不去遺忘。
Five years have passed since Hong Konger's last attempt to maintain their freedom, and it seems that all dust has settled. However, some people still choose not to forget.
經過多方努力，我們在Yermo的自由雕塑公園（Liberty Sculpture Park）建立起了香港地，用藝術去銘記香港人的意志不滅。
After many efforts, we have established Hong Kong Corner in the Liberty Sculpture Park in Yermo, using art to remember the unyielding will of the Hong Kongers.
香港地的維護和創作需要長期的投入，我們亟需你的支持。不論捐款多少，都代表著你對香港所出的一分力。
The maintenance and creation of Yermo's "Hong Kong Corner" requires long-term investment, and we urgently need your support. Any donation, no matter the amount, represents your contribution to the undying spirit of Hong Kongers.
We hope to meet in a free Hong Kong someday.
Donation serves 3 main purposes.
1. 現時香港地有四件展品，沙漠氣候極端，冬寒夏焰，烈日風沙，我們要定期維修，提供防曬材料予連儂牆， 令他們可以日久維新。
1. Currently, Hong Kong Corner has four exhibits. We need to perform regular maintenance for some of the art works and provide sun & water protection sealants in the harsh desert weather condition.
2. 香港抗爭者的雕像現時沒有任何解釋。 在我們維修的過程當中，經常見到美國本地人到訪，但他們對於2019抗爭一事並不了清楚。希望可以籌款建立一塊金屬牌匾， 刻上中英文描述，令到到訪者了解究竟發生了什麼事。
2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened.
3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。
3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.

此案导致日中关系紧张，日本称这一裁决“极其令人遗憾”，台湾和贸易问题的紧张局势加剧。
东京 - 据日本媒体 11 月 7 日晚报道，安斯泰来制药公司的一名日本员工因在中国从事间谍活动被判处三年零六个月监禁，将于 12 月中旬获释并返回日本。
共同社和读卖新闻等援引消息人士的话说，报道了这一消息。
该男子于 2023 年 3 月因涉嫌从事间谍活动而被拘留。他于 2024 年 8 月被起诉，并于 2025 年 7 月被判刑。
日本内阁官房副长官在宣判后表示，这一裁决“极其令人遗憾”，但没有透露个人或隶属关系。
安斯泰来制药、日本外务省和中国驻东京大使馆没有回复路透社寻求置评的电话。中国外交部没有回应置评请求。

Published Nov 08, 2026, 11:53 AM
Updated Nov 08, 2026, 12:34 PM
Astellas employee jailed in China for espionage is expected to be released in mid-December and return to Japan, Japanese media reported, citing sources.
He was detained in March 2023, indicted in August 2024, and sentenced to three years and six months in July 2025.
The case has strained Japan-China ties, with Japan calling the ruling "extremely regrettable" and tensions rising over Taiwan and trade.
TOKYO - A Japanese employee of Astellas Pharma sentenced to three years and six months in prison for espionage in China is set to be released in mid-December and returned to Japan, Japanese media reported late on Nov 7.
Kyodo news agency and Yomiuri newspaper among others reported the news, citing sources.
The man was detained in March 2023 on suspicion of spying. He was indicted in August 2024 and sentenced in July 2025.
The ruling was "extremely regrettable", Japan's deputy chief Cabinet secretary said after the sentencing, without identifying the individual or affiliation.
Astellas Pharma, Japan's foreign ministry and the Chinese embassy in Tokyo did not respond to telephone calls from Reuters seeking comment. China's foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment.
The case has been an irritant in Japan-China relations.
Ties between the two have deteriorated since Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in 2025 said a hypothetical Chinese attack on democratically governed Taiwan could trigger a military response from nearby Japan.
China subsequently urged its citizens not to travel to Japan, saying their safety was at risk. It also throttled exports to Japan of rare earths, minerals vital to the manufacture of products as varied as cars and weapons. REUTERS

title: ¿Espía enamorada? EU señala que mujer cercana a Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, trabajaría para China
zh_title: 间谍恋爱了？美方表示一名与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋关系密切的女性将在中国工作
summary: 据《纽约时报》周五报道，美国情报官员告诉特朗普政府，一名曾与英伟达公司首席执行官黄仁勋接触过的女性正在为一家中国间谍机构工作，该机构招募她是为了收集有关他的信息。该报援引匿名消息人士的话称，他们已获悉美国对这名女子进行监视，她是一家名为 Megaspeed International 的亚洲科技公司的高管。政府官员获悉这些指控
content:
据《纽约时报》周五报道，美国情报官员告诉特朗普政府，一名曾与英伟达公司首席执行官黄仁勋接触过的女性正在为一家中国间谍机构工作，该机构招募她是为了收集有关他的信息。该报援引匿名消息人士的话称，他们已获悉美国对这名女子进行监视，她是一家名为 Megaspeed International 的亚洲科技公司的高管。据《泰晤士报》报道，政府官员通过一份情报报告了解到了这些指控。据《泰晤士报》报道，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）在北京国家安全部工作，该部正在设法获取有关美国人工智能芯片的更多信息，并可能说服英伟达向中国提供其最先进的半导体。目前尚不清楚她何时或如何认识黄仁勋。据英国《金融时报》周五晚间发表的一篇文章称，美国当局认为这段关系是浪漫的。在本周美国中期选举之后，这个问题变得更加紧迫，这将使民主党控制国会。共和党人也在调查黄与被指控的间谍的关系。
🚨突发新闻：NVIDIA 首席执行官已于 11 月 18 日在国会被传唤，解释与涉嫌中国间谍的关系。根据美国情报部门的备忘录，美国政府现在怀疑 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋与一名被指控的中国间谍有恋爱关系。美国情报… pic.twitter.com/r0qwXVvGNr — Coin Bureau (@coinbureau) 2026 年 11 月 7 日 美国国会因涉嫌中国间谍活动向黄仁勋发出传票 众议院中国特别委员会周四表示，已致函黄仁勋“要求他参加闭门联合通报会”。该委员会在声明中表示：“这封信详细说明了立法者对黄与中国情报举报人 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的互动以及该公司针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议的担忧。” Megaspeed 是 Nvidia 云合作伙伴网络的一部分。这家总部位于新加坡的公司从芯片制造商那里购买设备，并向人工智能开发商出租处理能力。主席@RepMoolenaar、主席@RepBrianMast 和主席@RepRickCrawford 已致函 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋，要求他本月出席他们的三个委员会的会议。
这封信表达了对 NVIDIA 针对外国对手的安全协议的担忧…… pic.twitter.com/0HO0qAFUEM — 中国特别委员会 (@ChinaSelect) 2026 年 11 月 5 日 Nvidia 否认与中国合作伙伴共享机密信息 Nvidia 在《纽约时报》文章发表后表示，其云合作伙伴“并没有要求我们寻求美国立法的改变或促进对中国的销售。”该公司补充说，“无论谁通过我们的 NCP 客户寻求机密信息，都会陷入死胡同。当被问及《金融时报》有关相关报道时

【原文 English Original】
Según informó el New York Times el viernes, funcionarios de inteligencia estadounidenses comunicaron a la administración Trump que una mujer que se había acercado al director ejecutivo de Nvidia Corp., Jensen Huang , trabajaba para una agencia de espionaje china , que la reclutó para recopilar información sobre él. El periódico citó fuentes anónimas que, según afirmó, habían sido informadas de la vigilancia estadounidense realizada a la mujer, Alice Huang , ejecutiva de una empresa tecnológica asiática llamada Megaspeed International . Funcionarios del gobierno se enteraron de las acusaciones a través de un informe de inteligencia, según el Times . De acuerdo con el Times , Alice Huang trabajaba para el Ministerio de Seguridad del Estado de Pekín , que maniobraba para obtener más información sobre los chips de inteligencia artificial estadounidenses y, posiblemente, persuadir a Nvidia para que pusiera a disposición de China sus semiconductores más sofisticados. No está claro cuándo ni cómo conoció a Jensen Huang. Según un artículo publicado el viernes por la noche por el Financial Times , las autoridades estadounidenses creen que la relación era romántica . El asunto ha cobrado mayor urgencia tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato celebradas esta semana en Estados Unidos , que darán a los demócratas el control del Congreso. Los republicanos también están investigando los vínculos de Huang con el presunto espía. 🚨BREAKING: NVIDIA CEO has been summoned before congress on Nov 18 to explain ties to alleged Chinese spy. U.S Government now suspects NVIDIA chief Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with an alleged Chinese spy based on American Intelligence memo. U.S. intelligence… pic.twitter.com/r0qwXVvGNr — Coin Bureau (@coinbureau) November 7, 2026 Congreso de EU cita a Jensen Huang por presunto espionaje chino El Comité Selecto de la Cámara de Representantes sobre China declaró el jueves que había enviado una carta a Jensen Huang “solicitando su participación en una reunión informativa conjunta a puerta cerrada”. “La carta detalla las preocupaciones de los legisladores con respecto a las interacciones de Huang con la ejecutiva de Megaspeed, Alice Huang, una informante de la inteligencia china de la que se tiene constancia pública, y los protocolos de seguridad de la empresa contra el espionaje de adversarios extranjeros”, dijo el panel en el comunicado. Megaspeed forma parte de la red de socios en la nube de Nvidia . Esta empresa con sede en Singapur compra equipos al fabricante de chips y alquila capacidad de procesamiento a desarrolladores de IA. Chairman @RepMoolenaar , Chairman @RepBrianMast , and Chairman @RepRickCrawford have sent a letter to NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang asking him to appear before their three committees this month. The letter expresses concerns over NVIDIA’s security protocols against foreign adversary… pic.twitter.com/0HO0qAFUEM — Select Committee on China (@ChinaSelect) November 5, 2026 Nvidia niega compartir información clasificada con sus socios de China Nvidia declaró tras la publicación del artículo del New York Times que sus socios de la nube “no nos piden que busquemos cambios en la legislación estadounidense ni que promovamos las ventas a China”. La compañía añadió que “quien buscara información clasificada a través de nuestros clientes de NCP se habría topado con un callejón sin salida. No poseemos ni compartimos información clasificada con nuestros clientes”. Al ser consultada sobre el informe del FT relativo a una posible relación sentimental, Nvidia se remitió a comentarios anteriores de Jensen Huang en los que afirmaba mantener una relación comercial típica con Alice Huang. La Agencia Central de Inteligencia y la Oficina del Director de Inteligencia Nacional no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios el viernes por la noche. En una entrevista la semana pasada , Jensen Huang defendió sus tratos con Megaspeed, calificándolos de “normales y nada inusuales”, al tiempo que recalcó que la empresa se ha asegurado de que Megaspeed no haya enviado ilegalmente los procesadores de inteligencia artificial de Nvidia a China .

据报道，来自三星和 SK 海力士的 HBM 正在通过利用美国出口管制漏洞的走私活动到达中国人工智能芯片开发商。据 The Information 报道，中间商将 HBM​​ 与低性能服务器处理器打包，将组合后的组件运往中国，然后拆下内存进行转售，其中包括转售给华为的客户。据路透社报道，大约 60 万个 Nvidia H200 AI 芯片被存放在香港，等待批准运往中国大陆。北京限制进口，以减少对美国技术的依赖并鼓励采用国内开发的处理器。据彭博社报道，据彭博社报道，由于长期劳资纠纷，美光暂停了在台湾建设价值 4.5 亿美元的存储芯片工厂。美光尚未确认暂停，对其长期台湾制造计划的影响仍不清楚。据报道，三星电子计划在两个地点扩大 HBM 基础芯片的先进代工产能。据报道，该公司计划在韩国 Giheung 建立一座新的铸造厂，配备 2nm 和 4nm 生产线，预计投资约 17B 美元，并可能进行先进封装扩张。另外，据报道，三星还获得了 AMD 和 Nvidia 的 2 纳米 HBM 基础芯片订单，这些芯片将在德克萨斯州泰勒拟建的第二家代工厂生产，目标是在 2030 年实现量产。
注：三星尚未证实报道中的 Giheung 投资或 Taylor 客户订单。 据英国《金融时报》报道，在特朗普政府的压力下，甲骨文取消了一项价值约 70 亿美元的 5 年期协议，该协议旨在通过东南亚数据中心向腾讯提供多达 10 万个先进 AI 芯片。美国官员对中国公司通过海外云服务获取先进处理器表示担忧，而中国广东省官员则敦促腾讯使用国产芯片。博世计划于2028年1月成立专门的半导体部门，扩大其代工业务并向外部客户开放更多制造能力。该公司的目标是到 2030 年半导体销售额达到 50 亿欧元，并计划到 2030 年代中期扩大其位于马来西亚槟城的半导体测试中心。 Marvell 即将收购 Lumentum（最初估值为 $115B）引起了不同的反应，分析师看到了在 AI 光学互连领域挑战 Broadcom 的机会，但也引发了对供应商集中度和客户关系的担忧。有关收购价格和监管审批的问题加剧了投资者的担忧。美国选举结果引发了人们对数据中心发展更严格的限制的担忧，特别是在德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州等主要市场，以及国会对人工智能的监督力度加大，包括人工智能安全、网络安全和行业实践。
推迟或减少数据中心建设的限制可能会削弱对 AI 加速器、HBM 和网络芯片的需求，而监管审查的加强可能会给 AI 基础设施投资带来额外的不确定性。（请参阅此处的芯片库存影响。）更多收购和交易 Onsemi 确认其计划以 6 亿美元现金以及高达 1.75 亿美元的里程碑付款收购集成电压调节器开发商 Ferric。 Entegris 收购了 Advanced Abrasives，并宣布计划在台湾建立一条新的 SiC 材料生产线。该公司还与

Top Of The Week HBM from Samsung and SK hynix is reportedly reaching Chinese AI chip developers through smuggling operations that exploit U.S. export-control loopholes . According to The Information, intermediaries package HBM with low-performance server processors, ship the combined components to China, and then remove the memory for resale, including to customers of Huawei . Approximately 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are being held in Hong Kong awaiting approval for shipment to mainland China, according to Reuters. Beijing has limited imports in an effort to reduce reliance on U.S. technology and encourage adoption of domestically developed processors. Micron reportedly paused construction of a $4.5B memory-chip plant in Taiwan due to a prolonged labor dispute, according to Bloomberg. Micron has not confirmed the suspension, and the effect on its longer-term Taiwan manufacturing plans remains unclear. Samsung Electronics is reportedly planning to expand advanced foundry capacity for HBM base dies at two locations. In South Korea, the company reportedly plans a new foundry facility at Giheung , with 2nm and 4nm production lines and an estimated ~US$17B investment, along with a possible advanced packaging expansion. Separately, Samsung reportedly secured orders from AMD and Nvidia for 2nm HBM base dies to be produced at a proposed second foundry in Taylor, Texas, with mass production targeted for 2030. Note: Samsung has not confirmed the reported Giheung investment or Taylor customer orders. Oracle canceled a 5-year agreement worth an estimated $7B to provide Tencent access to up to 100,000 advanced AI chips through data centers in Southeast Asia, following pressure from the Trump administration, according to the Financial Times. U.S. officials raised concerns about Chinese companies accessing advanced processors through overseas cloud services, while officials in China’s Guangdong province urged Tencent to use domestically developed chips. Bosch plans to establish a dedicated semiconductor division in January 2028, expanding its foundry business and opening more manufacturing capacity to external customers. The company is targeting €5B in semiconductor sales by 2030 and plans to expand its semiconductor test center in Penang, Malaysia, by the mid-2030s. Marvell ‘s pending acquisition of Lumentum, initially valued at $115B , is drawing mixed reactions, with analysts seeing opportunities to challenge Broadcom in AI optical interconnects, but also raising concerns about supplier concentration and customer relationships. Questions about the purchase price and regulatory approval have added to investor concerns. U.S. election results raised concerns about tighter restrictions on data center development , particularly in major markets such as Texas and Ohio , as well as increased congressional oversight of AI , including AI safety, cybersecurity, and industry practices. Restrictions that delay or reduce data center construction could weaken demand for AI accelerators, HBM, and networking chips, and increased regulatory scrutiny could create additional uncertainty for AI infrastructure investment. (See chip stock impacts here .) More acquisitions and deals Onsemi confirmed it plans to acquire Ferric, developer of integrated voltage regulators, for $600M in cash, plus up to $175M in milestone payments. Entegris acquired Advanced Abrasives and announced plans for a new SiC materials manufacturing line in Taiwan. The company also partnered with Element Six to develop diamond-based thermal-management materials for advanced packaging and expanded its deal with Kioxia on BiCS Flash 3D flash memory . Supermicro is initially planning to use 10,000 SambaNova SN50 RDUs for its new AI disaggregated inference systems as part of a strategic collaboration. China’s biggest EDA company, Empyrean , plans to acquire a ~50.4% stake in Easy-Logic for US$33M. Unconfirmed : Mitsui Chemicals reportedly plans to buy JSR , semiconductor materials maker, for at least $8B. Two acquisitions finalized: ADI ‘s purchase of Alif Semiconductor, adding its AI-native MCU and fusion processors, and Forge Nano ‘s acquisition of HZO for its nanoscale coating platforms. Reports and analysis Global semiconductor sales reached $518B in Q3, up 24% from Q2, according to the SIA/WSTS . September sales were up 147% year over year. Worldwide silicon wafer shipments increased 13.4% year over year in Q3, reports SEMI . Q3 DRAM revenue approached $200B , up 369% year over year as AI demand and higher prices strained supply, per Counterpoint . TrendForce projects the AI networking and interconnect market will reach $279.8B in 2027. AI data centers are moving toward 800 VDC power distribution as rack power rises toward megawatt levels, with Nvidia, Google, Microsoft and other industry participants working through OCP on common architectures and interfaces. Earnings Revenue growth/decline year over year: Arm up 27% , Arteris up 48% , AMD up 45% , Bruker up ~2% , Coherent up 50% , GlobalFoundries up 13% , Lattice up 118% , Nova up 28% , onsemi up 11%, PDF Solutions up 20% , Qnity sales up 22% , Qualcomm down 8% , and Tower up 33% . Quick Links To More News In-Depth — Auto, Security and AI newsletter, shift left becoming a system-level problem, and who verifies AI. Global — Europe boosts chip-design funding; Asia expands materials and test capacity; U.S. advances AI-driven chip design R&D. New Technologies — RISC-V automotive MCUs, high-bandwidth compute, high-density testing, and ceramic data storage. Security — 3D-stacked HW shield against side channel attacks; AMD vulnerabilities, compromised Android devices, secure-element certification. Trending Video — Chiplets: shared resources, a mix of tools, and multiple dies add new challenges for design teams. Research — AI chip inspection; cryogenic transistors; edge AI efficiency; ferroelectric memory. Quantum Hardware — New QPUs; error-correction platforms; CMOS-based qubit readout; reliability and error suppression. Workforce | Education — Apprenticeship funding; semiconductor doctoral fellowships; AI’s impact on engineering careers. Events and Webinars — ACM/IEEE ICCAD, Electronica & SEMICON Europe. Webinars on shift left, verification, and debug of high-power motor controllers. Global Americas UC San Diego and Qualcomm launched a $750K AI-driven chip-design research initiative, funded by a $500K Qualcomm gift and $250K in UCSD matching funds, focused on AI methods for SoC design, processor architectures, hardware accelerators, memory systems, and interconnects. CSIS examines Albany NanoTech as a model for semiconductor technology clusters, highlighting shared R&D infrastructure, industry partnerships, and workforce development supporting sub-2nm technologies, advanced packaging, photonics, and quantum systems. The OCP Foundation is opening nominations for project leads across all 12 top-level OCP Projects, ranging from hardware management to the AI computing continuum. Europe The European Semiconductor Industry Association (ESIA) called for dedicated semiconductor funding under the EU’s 2028–2034 budget, including support for R&D, pilot production, advanced packaging, and industrial deployment. The association urged policymakers to coordinate national and EU funding, preserve the Chips Joint Undertaking’s cross-sector role, and ease restrictions on intellectual property transfers within multinational companies. The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was formally launched to advance fabless semiconductor design within the EU. The EU launched a European Chip Design Platform ( EuroCDP ) with €525M to stimulate new chip design companies . Synopsys and the EU Chips JU signed a deal to expand access to its EDA software for semiconductor startups and research teams through the EuroCDP. Asia South Korea reaffirmed plans to spend ₩21.3T (US$16B ) on AI and major initiatives covering semiconductors, physical AI, and data centers, in its proposed 2027 budget, nearly doubling this year’s allocation. Panasonic Industry plans to invest about ¥92B ($583M) to expand AI-related materials production and R&D, including circuit-board materials, capacitors and semiconductor packaging materials. Two workers were killed and five injured in an explosion and fire at Panasonic Industrial Devices Materials ‘ factory in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The facility produces PCB and semiconductor packaging materials. The cause and production impact have not been determined yet. South Korea’s Techwing plans to invest approximately ₩52.6B ($39M) in a new semiconductor equipment factory in Cheonan to expand production of memory test handlers and HBM cube probers. In-Depth Semiconductor Engineering published the Automotive, Security and AI newsletter, including: Fitting AI Models To Edge Applications Physical AI Pushes The Limits Of Hardware College Grads And AI Plus : Shift Left Is Becoming A System-Level Problem Video: Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs Perspective: Putting AI To The Test New Technologies Automotive and physical AI Infineon introduced its first automotive MCU platform based on the RISC-V architecture , adding hardware-based physical protection and crypto agility, with support planned for post-quantum security requirements. Infineon and Qualcomm are collaborating on a microcontroller-based subsystem for Snapdragon Ride reference platforms used in central car computers for automated driving and digital cockpit applications. STMicro announced a new microcontroller portfolio covering industrial, automotive, and physical AI applications. Test, measurement Keysight released XR3, a low-profile 14-bit oscilloscope designed to increase measurement capacity in rack-based test systems. Siemens introduced an automated component model extraction solution developed with Bosch that cuts frequency-response-function measurement time by up to 93% and produces ISO 20270-compliant models for virtual NVH development. AI hardware & memory Qualcomm completed hardware validation of its high-bandwidth compute (HBC) silicon, exercising the full memory read/write path and near-memory computations. Cerabyte completed S3 integration testing of its ceramic data storage within established object-storage workflows, in collaboration with CERN openlab. Design Arteris exceeded 1,000 customer silicon design starts using its interconnect IP, and released a report showing the evolution of SoC, ASIC, FPGA, and MCU designs across key markets. Research MCL , PVA TePla and ASE researchers developed an AI-based image-enhancement method for detecting flip-chip interconnect defects . By improving scanning acoustic microscopy images, the method increased detection of cracks and delamination in extreme-low-k dielectric layers from 5.2% to 100% in tests involving 19 defects across three packages. TU Munich , Applied Materials et al. evaluated cryogenic 2nm GAA transistors and superconducting interconnects for energy-efficient AI computing. Using a calibrated chip-design flow, they reported a 3x performance increase and 7.7x improvement in energy efficiency for a modeled AI accelerator’s compute fabric, excluding memory, data movement, and refrigeration power. ETH Zurich -led researchers benchmarked 10 commercial sub-watt edge AI devices , comparing inference performance and energy consumption across convolutional neural networks and small vision transformers. The study found that memory traffic, rather than computational workload, was the primary factor determining latency on the tested neural-network accelerators, highlighting the importance of data movement in low-power AI hardware design. HUST and PolyU researchers developed annealing-free ferroelectric transistors with ultrathin oxide-semiconductor channels for NVM and neuromorphic computing . The devices achieved a memory window of up to 20.6V, endurance of 10⁶ cycles, and stable 6-bit operation across 64 states. A neuromorphic network evaluation achieved 93.02% recognition accuracy. Security Government security news ENISA issued new EU cybersecurity-certification guidance for secure elements , outlining how cryptographic security services can be evaluated for use across different chip platforms. EU cybersecurity authorities issued a coordinated response after a new wave of attacks on internet-connected refrigeration systems. Japan ’s METI and IPA are participating in a new effort to align security requirements for connected hardware under Japan’s JC-STAR program and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Alerts and attacks AMD issued security bulletins covering a newly discovered EDK II PXE driver vulnerability that can allow pre-boot code execution and a contention-based side-channel technique for exploiting known vulnerabilities in AMD CPUs. Dell issued BIOS updates for a critical Qualcomm chipset vulnerability affecting five Latitude, Inspiron, and XPS systems. The flaw can cause memory corruption when a malformed RSA key is imported into Qualcomm’s Keystore. Google banned Videostrong Technology from making certified Android devices after its security researchers determined that the company was responsible for creating an XCPE backdoor that enrolled 1.3 million set-top boxes into a criminal botnet. CISA ’s alerts for the week are here . Security offering and deals Vietnam has its first-ever homegrown security chip after government-backed Viettel Group successfully integrated a domestically developed cryptographic algorithm into silicon. u-blox announced that it will integrate Kudelski Labs ’ embedded security IP into its future chipsets. Chinese tech giant Tencent released Hy4, its powerful new open-source AI model . Amid growing concerns about agentic hacking, the company said it limited the model’s cybersecurity training data to defensive material only. Security technical papers NC State and Princeton researchers proposed a 3D-stacked hardware shield to protect post-quantum cryptography accelerators from side-channel attacks. The design stacks a guard layer above the cryptographic hardware, using decoy-key activity and physical shielding to obscure power leakage from NTT computations. Randomized Caches in HW : Challenges/Trade-offs ( RUB, Max Planck et al.) Toward Deployable HW Roots of Trust for Edge AI ( U. of Groningen ) Return-Oriented Programming on Commercial PIM Architectures ( Syracuse ) High-Throughput Private Information Retrieval with on-CPU Accelerators ( Yonsei) Trending Video Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs : Purna Mohanty, CEO of SignatureIP , talks about the impact of chiplets and shared memory resources, the challenges of version control across multiple flavors of I/O, and the challenges engineering teams face when hardware-accelerated tools are running at different speeds than the actual design. Quantum Hardware New launches Universal Quantum launched its iQPU quantum processor , combining a large trapped-ion compute surface, ultra-low-noise integrated control electronics, and chip-to-chip interfaces designed to scale quantum computing systems. The processor is manufactured on a commercial 200mm semiconductor production line. IBM , ORNL , and AMD opened a new co-design platform for quantum error correction at IBM’s quantum facility in New York , co-locating the 120-qubit IBM Quantum Nighthawk with ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Fig. 1: ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Source: Oak Ridge National Lab Advances Researchers from Quantum Motion , UCL , and others demonstrated a superconducting circuit element fabricated using a commercial CMOS process . The titanium-nitride device functions as a compact superinductor and was integrated with a silicon quantum dot to enable sensitive RF charge detection, potentially supporting more compact readout hardware for semiconductor spin qubits. University of Regensburg -led researchers demonstrated a real-time feedback technique that reduced superconducting-qubit operation errors by approximately 54%, from 0.14% to 0.065%. The approach identifies changes in qubit resonance frequency associated with material defects and adjusts control signals to improve reliability. Alice & Bob reported extended bit-flip lifetimes in superconducting cat qubits , averaging 44 minutes on a single-qubit test device and reaching 189 to 252 minutes on selected qubits in its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor. The preliminary results demonstrate strong suppression of bit-flip errors during idle operation, with performance during error-correction operations still to be validated. Workforce, Education The U.S. Department of Labor opened applications for a $40M apprenticeship incentive fund that includes semiconductor fabrication among several high-growth sectors. Registered apprenticeship sponsors can receive up to $6K per eligible new apprentice. UCLA named the first 10 doctoral fellows in its Semiconductor Hub , with research spanning 3D ICs, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, compute-in-memory, and AI hardware. Fellows will also intern with one of the Hub’s industry partners, including Synopsys , GlobalFoundries , and others. In a new Semiconductor Engineering roundtable , industry experts discuss how AI is changing expectations for new engineering graduates. Demand for electrical engineers remains strong, but AI agents are taking over some traditional junior-level tasks, raising expectations for practical experience, AI fluency, and the ability to tackle higher-level engineering work earlier in their careers. U.S. community colleges are expanding semiconductor technician training programs as the industry faces a potential shortage of 157,000 workers by 2030, according to the Associated Press. More than 200 colleges and universities are coordinating with semiconductor manufacturers, including TSMC , Intel , Samsung , and SK hynix , to develop hands-on training programs supporting new U.S. fabs.
